book.title: Rig Veda
book.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary
book.license: Public domain translation (Griffith, 1896); transcription from Wikisource. Griffith’s commentary and notes are not included.
book.notes: Complete translation in Griffith’s arrangement: ten Maṇḍalas, one chapter per hymn, one verse per stanza. The Sanskrit text and Griffith’s commentary are not included. Hymn 1.179, which the 1896 edition prints only as an appendix note, is absent.

verses.translation: GREAT art thou, Agni, sacrifice's Herald: not without thee are deathless Gods made joyful. Come hither with all Deities about thee here take thy seat, the first, as Priest, O Agni.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Men with oblations evermore entreat thee, the swift, to undertake an envoy's duty. He on whose sacred grass with Gods thou sittest, to him, O Agni, are the days propitious.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Three times a day in thee are shown the treasures sent for the mortal who presents oblation. Bring the Gods hither like a man, O Agni: be thou our envoy, guarding us from curses.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Lord of the lofty sacrifice is Agni, Agni is Lord of every gift presented. The Vasus were contented with his wisdom, so the Gods made him their oblation bearer.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Agni, bring the Gods to taste our presents: with Indra leading, here let them be joyful. Convey this sacrifice to Gods in heaven. Ye Gods, preserve us evermore with blessings.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: WE with great reverence have approached The Youngest who hath shone forth well-kindled in his dwelling, With wondrous light between wide earth and heaven, well-worshipped, looking forth in all directions.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Through his great might o'ercoming all misfortunes, praised in the house is Agni Jatavedas. May he protect us from disgrace and trouble, both us who laud him and our noble patrons.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Agni, thou art Varuna and Mitra: Vasisthas with their holy hymns exalt thee. With thee be most abundant gain of treasure. Ye Gods, preserve us evermore with blessings.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: BRING song and hymn to Agni, Asura-slayer, enlightener of all and thought-bestower. Like an oblation on the grass, to please him, I bring this to Vaisvanara, hymn-inspirer.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou with thy flame, O Agni, brightly glowing, hast at thy birth filled full the earth and heaven. Thou with thy might, Vaisvanara Jatavedas, settest the Gods free from the curse that bound them.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni, when, born thou lookedst on all creatures, like a brisk herdsman moving round his cattle. The path to prayer, Vaisvanara, thou foundest. Ye Gods, preserve us evermore with blessings.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: WITH reverence and with offered gifts serve we the God whose flame is bright: Let us bring Jatavedas fuel, and adore Agni when we invoke the Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni, may we perform thy rites with fuel, and honour thee, O Holy one, with praises: Honour thee, Priest of sacrifice! with butter, thee, God of blessed light! with our oblation.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come, Agni, with the Gods to our invoking, come, pleased, to offerings sanctified with Vasat. May we be his who pays thee, God, due honour. Ye Gods, preserve us evermore with blessings.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: OFFER oblations in his mouth, the bounteous God's whom we must serve. His who is nearest kin to us:
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Who for the Fivefold People's take hath seated him in every home Wise, Youthful, Master of the house.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: On all sides may that Agni guard our household folk and property; May he deliver us from woe.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: I have begotten this new hymn for Agni, Falcon of the sky: Will he not give us of his wealth?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Whose glories when he glows in front of sacrifice are fair to see, Like wealth of one with hero sons.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May he enjoy this hallowed gift, Agni accept our songs, who bears Oblations, best of worshippers.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Lord of the house, whom men must seek, we set thee down, O Worshipped One Bright, rich in heroes, Agni! God
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Shine forth at night and morn: through thee with fires are we provided well. Thou, rich in heroes, art our Friend.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The men come near thee for their gain, the singers with their songs of praise: Speech, thousand fold, comes near to thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Bright, Purifier, meet for praise, Immortal with refulgent glow, Agni drives Raksasas away.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As such, bring us abundant wealth, young Child of Strength, for this thou canst May Bhaga give us what is choice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou, Agni, givest hero fame: Bhaga and Savitar the God, And Did give us what is good.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni, preserve us from distress: consume our enemies, O God, Eternal, with the hottest flames.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: And, irresistible, be thou a mighty iron fort to us, With hundred walls for man's defense.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Do thou preserve us, eve and morn, from sorrow, from the wicked men, Infallible! by day and night.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: WITH this my reverent hymn I call Agni for you, the Son of Strength, Dear, wisest envoy, served with noble sacrifice, immortal messenger of all.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: His two red horses, all-supporting, let him yoke: let him, well-worshipped, urge them fast. Then hath the sacrifice good prayers and happy end, and heavenly gift of wealth to men.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The flame of him the Bountiful, the Much-invoked, hath mounted up, And his red-coloured smoke-clouds reach and touch the sky: the men are kindling Agni well.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thee, thee Most Glorious One we make our messenger. Bring the Gods hither to the feast. Give us, O Son of Strength, all food that feedeth man: give that for which we pray to thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou, Agni, art the homestead's Lord, our Herald at the sacrifice. Lord of all boons, thou art the Cleanser and a Sage. Pay worship, and enjoy the good.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Give riches to the sacrificer, O Most Wise, for thou art he who granteth wealth. Inspire with zeal each priest at this our solemn rite; all who are skilled in singing praise.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Agni who art worshipped well, dear let our princes be to thee, Our wealthy patrons who are governors of men, who part, as gifts, their stalls of kine.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: They in whose home, her hand bearing the sacred oil, Ila sits down well-satisfied- Guard them, Victorious God, from slander and from harm. give us a refuge famed afar.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Do thou, a Priest with pleasant tongue, most wise, and very near to us, Agni, bring riches hither to our liberal chiefs, and speed the offering of our gifts.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: They who bestow as bounty plenteous wealth of steeds, moved by desire of great renown- Do thou with saving help preserve them from distress, Most Youthful! with a hundred forts.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The God who gives your wealth demands a full libation poured to him. Pour ye it forth, then fill the vessel full again: then doth the God pay heed to you.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Him have the Gods appointed Priest of sacrifice, oblation-bearer, passing wise. Agni gives wealth and valour to the worshipper, to folk who offer up their gifts.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: AGNI, be kindled well with proper fuel, and let the grass be scattered wide about thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Let the impatient Portals be thrown open bring thou the Gods impatient to come hither.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Taste, Agni: serve the Gods with our oblation. Offer good sacrifices, Jatavedas!
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Let Jatavedas pay fair sacrifices, worship and gratify the Gods Immortal.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Wise God, win for us things that are all-goodly, and let the prayers, we pray today be fruitful.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thee, even thee, the Son of Strength, O Agni, those Gods have made the bearer of oblations.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To thee the God may we perform our worship: do thou, besought, grant us abundant riches.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: ALL is with thee, O Indra, all the treasures which erst our fathers won who sang thy praises. With thee are milch-kine good to milk, and horses: best winner thou of riches for the pious.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For like a King among his wives thou dwellest: with glories, as a Sage, surround and help us. Make us, thy servants, strong for wealth, and honour our songs wirth kine and steeds and decoration.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Here these our holy hymns with joy and gladness in pious emulation have approached thee. Hitherward come thy path that leads to riches: may we find shelter in thy favour, Indra.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Vasistha hath poured forth his prayers, desiring to milk thee like a cow in goodly pasture. All these my people call thee Lord of cattle: may Indra. come unto the prayer we offer.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: What though the floods spread widely, Indra made them shallow and easy for Sudas to traverse. He, worthy of our praises, caused the Simyu, foe of our hymn, to curse the rivers' fury.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Eager for spoil was Turvasa Purodas, fain to win wealth, like fishes urged by hunger. The Bhrgus and the Druhyus quickly listened: friend rescued friend mid the two distant peoples.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Together came the Pakthas, the Bhalanas, the Alinas, the Sivas, the Visanins. Yet to the Trtsus came the Arya's Comrade, through love of spoil and heroes' war, to lead them.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Fools, in their folly fain to waste her waters, they parted inexhaustible Parusni. Lord of the Earth, he with his might repressed them: still lay the herd and the affrighted herdsman.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As to their goal they sped to their destruction: they sought Parusni; e'en the swift returned not. Indra abandoned, to Sudas the manly, the swiftly flying foes, unmanly babblers.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: They went like kine unherded from the pasture, each clinging to a friend as chance directed. They who drive spotted steeds, sent down by Prsni, gave ear, the Warriors and the harnessed horses.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The King who scattered one-and-twenty people of both Vaikarna tribes through lust of glory- As the skilled priest clips grass within the chamber, so hath the Hero Indra, wrought their downfall.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou, thunder-armed, o'erwhelmedst in the waters famed ancient Kavasa and then the Druhyu. Others here claiming friendship to their friendship, devoted unto thee, in thee were joyful.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra at once with conquering might demolished all their strong places and their seven castles. The goods of Anu's son he gave to Trtsu. May we in sacrifice conquer scorned Puru.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Anavas and Druhyus, seeking booty, have slept, the sixty hundred, yea, six thousand, And six-and-sixty heroes. For the pious were all these mighty exploits done by Indra.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: These Trtsus under Indra's careful guidance came speeding like loosed waters rushing downward. The foemen, measuring exceeding closely, abandoned to Sudas all their provisions.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The hero's side who drank the dressed oblation, Indra's denier, far o'er earth he scattered. Indra brought down the fierce destroyer's fury. He gave them various roads, the path's Controller.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: E'en with the weak he wrought this matchless exploit: e'en with a goat he did to death a lion. He pared the pillar's angles with a needle. Thus to Sudas Indra gave all provisions.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To thee have all thine enemies submitted: e'en the fierce Bheda hast thou made thy subject. Cast down thy sharpened thunderbolt, O Indra, on him who harms the men who sing thy praises.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Yamuna and the Trtsus aided Indra. There he stripped Bheda bare of all his treasures. The Ajas and the Sigrus and the Yaksus brought in to him as tribute heads of horses.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Not to be scorned, but like Dawns past and recent, O Indra, are thy favours and thy riches. Devaka, Manyamana's son, thou slewest, and smotest Sambara from the lofty mountain.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: They who, from home, have gladdened thee, thy servants Parasara, Vasistha, Satayatu, Will not forget thy friendship, liberal Giver. So shall the days dawn prosperous for the princes.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Priest-like, with praise, I move around the altar, earning Paijavana's reward, O Agni, Two hundred cows from Devavan's descendant, two chariots from Sudas with mares to draw them.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Gift of Paijavana, four horses bear me in foremost place, trained steeds with pearl to deck them. Sudas's brown steeds, firmly-stepping, carry me and my son for progeny and glory.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Him whose fame spreads between wide earth and heaven, who, as dispenser, gives each chief his portion, Seven flowing Rivers glorify like Indra. He slew Yudhyamadhi in close encounter.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Attend on him O ye heroic Maruts as on Sudas's father Divodasa. Further Paijavana's desire with favour. Guard faithfully his lasting firm dominion.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: HE like a bull with sharpened horns, terrific, singly excites and agitates all the people: Thou givest him who largely pours libations his goods who pours not, for his own possession.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou, verily, Indra, gavest help to Kutsa, willingly giving car to him in battle, When, aiding Arjuneya, thou subduedst to him both Kuyava and the Dasa Susna.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Bold One, thou with all thine aids hast boldly holpen Sudas whose offerings were accepted, Puru in winning land and slaying foemen, and Trasadasyu son of Purukutsa.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: At the Gods' banquet, hero-souled! with Heroes, Lord of Bay Steeds, thou slewest many foemen. Thou sentest in swift death to sleep the Dasyu, both Cumuri and Dhuni, for Dabhiti.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: These were thy mighty powers that, Thunder-wielder, thou swiftly crushedst nine-and-ninety castles: Thou capturedst the hundredth in thine onslaught; thou slewest Namuci, thou slewest Vrtra.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Old are the blessings, Indra, which thou gavest Sudas the worshipper who brought oblations. For thee, the Strong, I yoke thy strong Bay Horses: may our prayers reach thee and win strength, Most Mighty!
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Give us not up, Lord of Bay Horses, Victor, in this thine own assembly, to the wicked. Deliver us with true and faithful succours: dear may we be to thee among the princes.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May we men, Maghavan, the friends thou lovest, near thee be joyful under thy protection. Fain to fulfil the wish of Atithigva humble. the pride of Turvasa and Yadva.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Swiftly, in truth, O Maghavan, about thee men skilled in hymning sing their songs and praises. ' Elect us also into their assembly who by their calls on thee despoiled the niggards.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thine are these lauds, O manliest of heroes, lauds which revert to us and give us riches. Favour these, Indra, when they fight with foemen, as Friend and Hero and the heroes' Helper.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Now, lauded for thine aid, Heroic Indra, sped by our prayer, wax mighty in thy body. Apportion to us strength and habitations. Ye Gods, protect us evermore with blessings.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: STRONG, Godly-natured, born for hero exploit, man's Friend, he doth whatever deed he willeth. Saving us e'en from great transgression, Indra, the Youthful, visiteth man's home with favour.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Waxing greatness Indra slayeth Vrtra: the Hero with his aid hath helped the singer. He gave Sudas wide room and space, and often hath granted wealth to him who brought oblations.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Soldier unchecked, war-rousing, battling Hero, unconquered from of old, victorious ever, Indra the very strong hath scattered armies; yea, he hath slain each foe who fought against him.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou with thy greatness hast filled full, O Indra, even both the worlds with might, O thou Most Mighty. Lord of Bays, Indra, brandishing his thunder, is gratified with Soma at the banquet.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: A Bull begat the Bull for joy of battle, and a strong Mother brought forth him the manly. He who is Chief of men, their armies' Leader, is strong Hero, bold, and fain for booty.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The people falter not, nor suffer sorrow, who win themselves this God's terrific spirit. He who with sacrifices worships Indra is lord of wealth, law-born and law's protector.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Whene'er the elder fain would help the younger the greater cometh to the lesser's present. Shall the Immortal sit aloof' inactive? O Wondrous Indra, bring us wondrous riches.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thy dear folk, Indra, who present oblations, are, in chief place, thy friends, O Thunder-wielder. May we be best content in this thy favour, sheltered by One who slays not, but preserves us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To thee the mighty hymn hath clamoured loudly, and, Maghavan, the eloquent hath besought thee. Desire of wealth hath come upon thy singer: help us then, Sakra, to our share of riches.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Place us by food which thou hast given, O Indra, us and the wealthy patrons who command us. Let thy great power bring good to him who lauds thee. Ye Gods, preserve us evermore with blessings.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: PRESSED is the juice divine with milk commingled: thereto hath Indra ever been accustomed. We wake thee, Lord of Bays, with sacrifices: mark this our laud in the wild joy of Soma.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: On to the rite they move, the grass they scatter, these Soma-drinkers eloquent in synod. Hither, for men to grasp, are brought the press-stones, far-thundering, famous, strong, that wait on heroes.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra, thou settest free the many waters that were encompassed, Hero, by the Dragon. Down rolled, as if on chariots borne, the rivers: through fear of thee all things created tremble.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Skilled in all manly deeds the God terrific hath with his weapons mastered these opponents. Indra in rapturous joy shook down their castles he slew them in his might, the Thunder-wielder.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: No evil spirits have impelled us, Indra, nor fiends, O Mightiest God, with their devices. Let our true God subdue the hostile rabble: let not the lewd approach our holy worship.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou in thy strength surpassest Earth and Heaven: the regions comprehend not all thy greatness. With thine own power and might thou slewest Vrtra: no foe hath found the end of thee in battle.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Even the earlier Deities submitted their powers to thy supreme divine dominion. Indra wins wealth and deals it out to other's: men in the strife for booty call on Indra.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The humble hath invoked thee for protection, thee, Lord of great felicity, O Indra. Thou with a hundred aids hast been our Helper: one who brings gifts like thee hath his defender.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May we, O Indra, be thy friends for ever, eagerly, Conqueror, yielding greater homage. May, through thy grace, the strength of us who battle quell in the shock the onset of the foeman.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Place us by food which thou hast given, O Indra, us and the wealthy patrons who command us. Let thy great power bring good to him who lauds thee. Ye Gods, preserve us evermore with blessings.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: DRINK Soma, Lord of Bays, and let it cheer thee: Indra, the stone, like a well guided courser, Directed by the presser's arms hath pressed it.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: So let the draught of joy, thy dear companion, by which, O Lord of Bays, thou slayest foemen, Delight thee, Indra, Lord of princely treasures.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Mark closely, Maghavan, the words I utter, this eulogy recited by Vasistha: Accept the prayers I offer at thy banquet.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Hear thou the call of the juice-drinking press-stone: hear thou the Brahman's hymn who sings and lauds thee. Take to thine inmost self these adorations.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: I know and ne'er forget the hymns and praises of thee, the Conqueror, and thy strength immortal. Thy name I ever utter. Self-Refulgent
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Among mankind many are thy libations, and many a time the pious sage invokes thee. O Maghavan, be not long distant from us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: All these libations are for thee, O Hero: to thee I offer these my prayers. that strengthen. Ever, in every place, must men invoke thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Never do men attain, O Wonder-Worker, thy greatness, Mighty One, who must be lauded, Nor, Indra, thine heroic power and bounty.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Among all Rsis, Indra, old and recent, who have engendered hymns as sacred singers, Even with us be thine auspicious friendships. Ye Gods, preserve us evermore with blessings.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: PRAYERS have been offered up through love of glory: Vasistha, honour Indra in the battle. He who with might extends through all existence hears words which I, his faithful servant, utter.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: A cry was raised which reached the Gods, O Indra, a cry to them to send us strength in combat. None among men knows his own life's duration: bear us in safety over these our troubles.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Bays, the booty-seeking car I harness: my prayers have reached him who accepts them gladly. Indra, when he had slain resistless foemen, forced with his might the two world-halves asunder.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Like barren cows, moreover, swelled the waters: the singers sought thy holy rite, O Indra. Come unto us as with his team comes Vayu: thou, through our solemn hymns bestowest booty.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: So may these gladdening draughts rejoice thee, Indra, the Mighty, very bounteous to the singer. Alone among the Gods thou pitiest mortals: O Hero, make thee glad at this libation.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thus the Vasisthas glorify with praises Indra, the Powerful whose arm wields thunder. Praised, may he guard our wealth in kine and heroes. Ye Gods, preserve us evermore with blessings.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: A HOME is made for thee to dwell in, Indra: O Much-invoked, go thitherwith the heroes. That thou, to prosper us, mayst be our Helper, vouchsafe us wealth, rejoice with draughts of Soma.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra, thy wish, twice-strong, is comprehended: pressed is the Soma, poured are pleasant juices. This hymn of praise, from loosened tongue, made perfect, draws Indra to itself with loud invoking.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come, thou Impetuous; God, from earth or heaven; come to our holy grass to drink the Soma. Hither to me let thy Bay Horses bring thee to listen to our hymns and make thee joyful.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come unto us with all thine aids, accordant, Lord of Bay Steeds, accepting our devotions, Fair-helmeted, o'ercoming with the mighty, and lending us the strength of bulls, O Indra.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As to the chariot pole a vigorous courser, this laud is brought to the great strong Upholder. This hymn solicits wealth of thee: in heaven, as 'twere above the sky, set thou our glory.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With precious things. O Indra, thus content us: may we attain to thine exalted favour. Send our chiefs plenteous food with hero children. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: WHEN with thy mighty help, O potent Indra, the armies rush together in their fury. When from the strong man's arm the lightning flieth, let not the mind go forth to side with others.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indra, where the ground is hard to traverse, smite down our foes, the mortals who assail us, Keep far from us the curse of the reviler: bring us accumulated store of treasures.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: God of the fair helm, give Sudas a hundred succours, a thousand blessings, and thy bounty. Strike down the weapon of our mortal foeman: bestow upon us splendid fame and riches.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: I wait the power of one like thee, O Indra, gifts of a Helper such as thou art, Hero. Strong, Mighty God, dwell with me now and ever: Lord of Bay Horses, do not thou desert us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Here are the Kutsas supplicating Indra for might, the Lord of Bays for God-sent conquest. Make our foes ever easy to be vanquished: may we, victorious, win the spoil, O Hero.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With precious things, O Indra, thus content us: may we attain to thine exalted favour. Send our chiefs plenteous food with hero children. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: SOMA unpressed ne'er gladdened liberal Indra, no juices pressed without a prayer have pleased him. I generate a laud that shall delight him, new and heroic, so that he may hear us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: At every laud the Soma gladdens Indra: pressed juices please him as each psalm is chanted, What time the priests with one united effort call him to aid, as sons invoke their father.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: These deeds he did; let him achieve new exploits, such as the priests declare at their libations. Indra hath taken and possessed all castles, like as one common husband doth his spouses.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Even thus have they declared him. Famed is Indra as Conqueror, sole distributer of treasures; Whose many succours come in close succession. May dear delightful benefits attend us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thus, to bring help to men, Vasistha laudeth Indra, the peoples' Hero, at libation. Bestow upon us strength and wealth in thousands. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: MEN call on Indra in the armed encounter that he may make the hymns they sing decisive. Hero, rejoicing in thy might, in combat give us a portion of the stall of cattle,
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Grant, Indra Maghavan, invoked of many, to these my friends the strength which thou possessest. Thou, Maghavan, hast rent strong places open: unclose for us, Wise God, thy hidden bounty.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: King of the living world, of men, is Indra, of all in varied form that earth containeth. Thence to the worshipper he giveth riches: may he enrich us also when we laud him.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Maghavan Indra, when we all invoke him, bountiful ever sendeth strength to aid us: Whose perfect guerdon, never failing, bringeth wealth to the men, to friends the thing they covet.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Quick, Indra, give us room and way to riches, and let us bring thy mind to grant us treasures, That we may win us cars and Steeds and cattle. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: COME to our prayers, O Indra, thou who knowest: let thy Bay Steeds be yoked and guided hither. Though mortal men on every side invoke thee, still give thine ear to us, O All-impeller.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thy greatness reacheth to our invocation, the sages' prayer which, Potent God, thou guardest. What time thy hand, O Mighty, holds the thunder, awful in strength thou hast become resistless.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: What time thou drewest both world-halves together, like heroes led by thee who call each other- For thou wast born for strength and high dominion-then e'en the active overthrew the sluggish.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Honour us in these present days, O Indra, for hostile men are making expiation. Our sin that sinless Varuna discovered, the Wondrous-Wise hath long ago forgiven.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: We will address this liberal Lord, this Indra, that he may grant us gifts of ample riches, Best favourer of the singer's prayer and praises. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: THIS Soma hath been pressed for thee, O Indra: come hither, Lord of Bays, for this thou lovest. Drink of this fair, this well-effused libation: Maghavan, give us wealth when we implore thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come to us quickly with thy Bay Steeds, Hero, come to our prayer, accepting our devotion. Enjoy thyself aright at this libation, and listen thou unto the prayers we offer.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: What satisfaction do our hymns afford thee? When, Maghavan? Now let us do thee service.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: They, verily, were also human beings whom thou wast wont to hear, those earlier sages. Hence I, O Indra Maghavan, invoke thee: thou art our Providence, even as a Father.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: We will address this liberal Lord, this Indra, that he may grant us gifts of ample riches, Best favourer of the singer's prayer and praises. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: WITH power and strength, O Mighty God, approach us: be the augmenter, Indra, of these riches; Strong Thunderer, Lord of men, for potent valour, for manly exploit and for high dominion.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thee, worth invoking, in the din of battle, heroes invoke in fray for life and sunlight. Among all people thou art foremost fighter: give up our enemies to easy slaughter.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When fair bright days shall dawn on us, O Indra, and thou shalt bring thy banner near in battle, Agni the Asura shall sit as Herald, calling Gods hither for our great good fortune.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thine are we, Indra, thine, both these who praise thee, and those who give rich gifts, O God and Hero. Grant to our princes excellent protection, may they wax old and still be strong and happy.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: We will address this liberal Lord, this Indra that he may grant us gifts of ample riches: Best favourer of the singer's prayer and praises. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: SING ye a song, to make him glad, to Indra, Lord of Tawny Steeds, The Soma-drinker, O my friends.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To him the Bounteous say the laud, and let us glorify, as men May do, the Giver of true gifts.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indra, Lord of boundless might, for us thou winnest strength and kine, Thou winnest gold for us, Good Lord.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Faithful to thee we loudly sing, heroic Indra, songs to thee: Mark, O Good Lord, this act of ours.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Give us not up to man's reproach, to foeman's hateful calumny: In thee alone is all my strength.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou art mine ample coat of mail, my Champion, Vrtra-Slayer, thou: With thee for Friend I brave the foe.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Yea, great art thou whose conquering might two independent Powers confess. The Heaven, O India, and the Earth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: So let the voice surround thee, which attends the Maruts on their way, Reaching thee with the rays of light.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Let the ascending drops attain to thee, the Wondrous God, in heaven: Let all the folk bow down to thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Bring to the Wise, the Great, who waxeth mighty, your offerings, and make ready your devotion; To many clans he goeth, man's controller.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For Indra, the sublime, the far-pervading, have singers generated prayer and praises: The sages never violate his statutes.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The choirs have stablished Indra King for ever, for victory, him whose anger is resistless: And, for the Bays' Lord, strengthened those he loveth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: LET none, no, not thy worshippers, delay thee far away from us. Even from far away come thou unto our feast, or listen if already here.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For here, like flies on honey, these who pray to thee sit by the juice that they have poured. Wealth-craving singers have on Indra set their hope, as men set foot upon a car.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Longing for wealth I call on him, the Thunderer with the strong right hand, As a son calleth on his sire.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: These Soma juices, mixed with curd, have been expressed for Indra here. Come with thy Bay Steeds, Thunder-wielder, to our home, to drink them till they make thee glad.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May he whose ear is open hear us. He is asked for wealth: will he despise our prayer? Him who bestows at once a hundred thousand gifts none shall restrain when he would give.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The hero never checked by men hath gained his strength through Indra, he Who presses out and pours his deep libations forth, O Vrtra-slayer, unto thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When thou dost drive the fighting men together be, thou Mighty One, the mighty's shield. May we divide the wealth of him whom thou hast slain: bring us, Unreachable, his goods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For Indra, Soma-drinker, armed with thunder, press the Soma juice. Make ready your dressed meats: cause him to favour us. The Giver blesses him who gives.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Grudge not, ye Soma pourers; stir you, pay the rites, for wealth, to the great Conqueror. Only the active conquers dwells in peace, and thrives: not for the niggard are the Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: No one hath overturned or stayed the car of him who freely gives. The man whom Indra and the Marut host defend comes to a stable full of kine.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra, that man when fighting shall obtain the spoil, whose strong defender thou wilt be. Be thou the gracious helper, Hero I of our cars, be thou the helper of our men.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: His portion is exceeding great like a victorious soldier's spoil. Him who is Indra, Lord of Bays, no foes subdue. He gives the Soma-pourer strength.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Make for the Holy Gods a hymn that is not mean, but well-arranged and fair of form. Even many snares and bonds subdue not him who dwells with Indra through his sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra, what mortal will attack the man who hath his wealth in thee? The strong will win the spoil on the decisive day through faith in thee, O Maghavan.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: In battles with the foe urge on our mighty ones who give the treasures dear to thee, And may we with our princes, Lord of Tawny Steeds! pass through all peril, led by thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thine, Indra, is the lowest wealth, thou cherishest the mid-most wealth, Thou ever rulest all the highest: in the fray for cattle none resisteth thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou art renowned as giving wealth to every one in all the battles that are fought. Craving protection, all these people of the earth, O Much-invoked, implore thy name.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: If I, O Indra, were the Lord of riches ample as thine own, I should support the singer, God. who givest wealth! and not abandon him to woe.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Each day would I enrich the man who sang my praise, in whatsoever place he were. No kinship is there better, Maghavan, than thine: a father even is no more.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With Plenty for his true ally the active man will gain the spoil. Your Indra, Much-invoked, I bend with song, as bends a wright his wheel of solid wood.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: A moral wins no riches by unworthy praise: wealth comes not to the niggard churl. Light is the task to give, O Maghavan, to one like me on the decisive day.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Like kine unmilked we call aloud, Hero, to thee, and sing thy praise, Looker on heavenly light, Lord of this moving world, Lord, Indra, of what moveth not.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: None other like to thee, of earth or of the heavens, hath been or ever will be born. Desiring horses, Indra Maghavan! and kine, as men of might we call on thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Bring, Indra, the Victorious Ones; bring, elder thou, the younger host. For, Maghavan, thou art rich in treasures from of old, and must be called in every fight.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Drive thou away our enemies, O Maghavan: make riches easy to be won. Be thou our good Protector in the strife for spoil: Cherisher of our friends be thou.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indra, give us wisdom as a sire gives wisdom to his sons. Guide us, O Much-invoked, in this our way may we still live and look upon the light.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Grant that no mighty foes, unknown, malevolent, unhallowed, tread us to the ground. With thine assistance, Hero, may we ass through all the waters that are rul`ng down.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: THESE who wear hair-knots on the right, the movers of holy thought, white-robed, have won me over. I warned the men, when from the grass I raised me, Not from afar can my Vasisthas help you.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With soma they brought Indra from a distance, Over Vaisanta, from the strong libation. Indra preferred Vasisthas to the Soma pressed by the son of Vayata, Pasadyumna.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: So, verily, with these he crossed the river, in company with these he slaughtered Bheda. So in the fight with the Ten Kings, Vasisthas! did Indra help Sudas through your devotions.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: I gladly, men I with prayer prayed by our fathers have fixed your axle: ye shall not be injured: Since, when ye sang aloud the Sakvari verses, Vasisthas! ye invigorated Indra.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Like thirsty men they looked to heaven, in battle with the Ten Kings, surrounded and imploring. Then Indra heard Vasistha as he praised him, and gave the Trtsus ample room and freedom.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Like sticks and staves wherewith they drive the cattle, Stripped bare, the Bharatas were found defenceless: Vasistha then became their chief and leader: then widely. were the Trtsus' clans extended.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Three fertilize the worlds with genial moisture: three noble Creatures cast a light before them. Three that give warmth to all attend the morning. All these have they discovered, these Vasisthas.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Like the Sun's growing glory is their splendour, and like the sea's is their unflathomed greatness. Their course is like the wind's. Your laud, Vasisthas, can never be attained by any other.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: They with perceptions of the heart in secret resort to that which spreads a thousand branches. The Apsaras brought hither the Vasisthas wearing the vesture spun for them by Yama.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: A form of lustre springing from the lightning wast thou, when Varuna and Mitra saw thee. Thy one and only birth was then, Vasistha, when from thy stock Agastya brought thee hither.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Born of their love for Urvasi, Vasistha thou, priest, art son of Varuna and Mitra; And as a fallen drop, in heavenly fervour, all the Gods laid thee on a lotus-blossom.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He thinker, knower both of earth and heaven, endowed with many a gift, bestowing thousands, Destined to wear the vesture spun by Yama, sprang from the Apsaras to life, Vasistha.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Born at the sacrifice, urged by adorations, both with a common flow bedewed the pitcher. Then from the midst thereof there rose up Mana, and thence they say was born the sage Vasistha.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He brings the bearer of the laud and Saman: first shall he speak bringing the stone for pressing. With grateful hearts in reverence approach him: to you, O Pratrdas, Vasistha cometh.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: MAY our divine and brilliant hymn go forth, like a swift chariot wrought and fashioned well.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The waters listen as they flow along: they know the origin of heaven and earth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Yea, the broad waters swell their flood for him: of him strong heroes think amid their foes.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Set ye for him the coursers to the pole: like Indra Thunderer is the Golden-armed.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Arouse you, like the days, to sacrifice speed gladly like a traveller on the way.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Go swift to battles, to the sacrifice: set up a flag, a hero for the folk.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Up from his strength hath risen as 'twere a light: it bears the load as earth bears living things.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni, no demon I invoke the Gods: by law completing it, I form a hymn.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Closely about you lay your heavenly song, and send your voice to where the Gods abide.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Varuna, Mighty, with a thousand eyes, beholds the paths wherein these rivers run.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He, King of kings, the glory of the floods, o'er all that liveth hath resistless sway.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May he assist us among all the tribes, and make the envier's praise devoid of light.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May the foes' threatening arrow pass us by: may he put far from us our bodies' sin.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni, oblation-cater, through our prayers aid us: to him our dearest laud is brought.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Accordant with the Gods choose for our Friend the Waters' Child: may he be good to us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With lauds I sing the Dragon born of floods: he sits beneath the streams in middle air.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ne'er may the Dragon of the Deep harm us: ne'er fail this faithful servant's sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To these our heroes may they grant renown: may pious men march boldly on to wealth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Leading great hosts, with fierce attacks of these, they burn their foes as the Sun burns the earth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: What time our wives draw near to us, may he, left-handed Tvastar, give us hero sons.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May Tvastar find our hymn acceptable, and may Aramati, seeking wealth, be ours.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May they who lavish gifts bestow those treasures: may Rodasi and Varunani listen. May he, with the Varutris, be our refuge, may bountiful Tvastar give us store of riches.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: So may rich Mountains and the liberal Waters, so may all Herbs that grow on ground, and Heaven, And Earth accordant with the Forest-Sovrans, and both the World-halves round about protect us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To this may both the wide Worlds lend approval, and Varuna in heaven, whose Friend is Indra. May all the Maruts give consent, the Victors, that we may hold great wealth in firm possession.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May Indra, Varuna, Mitra, and Agni, Waters, Herbs, Trees accept the praise we offer. May we find refuge in the Marut's bosom. Protect us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: BEFRIEND us with their aids Indra and Agni, Indra and Varuna who receive oblations! Indra and Soma give health, strength and comfort, Indra and Pusan be our help in battle.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Auspicious Friends to us be Bhaga, Sathsa, auspicious be Purandhi aid all Riches; The blessing of the true and well-conducted, and Aryaman in many forms apparent.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Kind unto us he Maker and Sustainer, and the far-reaching Pair with God-like natures. Auspicious unto us be Earth and Heaven, the Mountain, and the Gods' fair invocations.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Favour us Agni with his face of splendour, and Varuva and Mitra and the Asvins. Favour us noble actions of the pious, impetuous vita blow on us with favour.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Early invoked, may Heaven and Earth be friendly, and Air's mid-region good for us to look on. To us may Herbs and Forest-Trees be gracious, gracious the Lord Victorious of the region.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Be the God Indra with the Vasus friendly, and, with Adityas, Varuna who blesseth. Kind, with the Rudras, be the Healer Rudra, and, with the Dames, may Tvastar kindly listen.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Blest unto us be Soma, and devotions, blest be the Sacrifice, the Stones for pressing. Blest be the fixing of the sacred Pillars, blest be the tender Grass and blest the Altar.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May the far-seeing Sun rise up to bless us: be the four Quarters of the sky auspicious. Auspicious be the firmly-seated Mountains, auspicious be the Rivers and the Waters.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May Adid through holy works be gracioas, and may the Maruts, loud in song, be friendly. May Visnu give felicity, and Pusan, the Air that cherisheth our life, and Vayu.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Prosper us Savitar, the God who rescues, and let the radiant Mornings be propitious. Auspicious to all creatures be Parjanya, auspicious be the field's benign Protector.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May all the fellowship of Gods befriend us, Sarasvati, with Holy Thoughts, be gracious. Friendly be they, the Liberal Ones who seek us, yea, those who dwell in heaven, on earth, in waters.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May the great Lords of Truth protect and aid us: blest to us be our horses and our cattle. Kind be the pious skilful-handed Rbhus, kind be the Fathers at our invocations.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May Aja-Ekapad, the God, be gracious, gracious the Dragon of the Deep, and Ocean. Gracious be he the swelling Child of Waters, gracious be Prsni who hath Gods to guard her.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: So may the Rudras, Vasus, and Adityas accept the new hymn which we now are making. May all the Holy Ones of earth and heaven, and the Cow's offipring hear our invocation.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: They who of Holy Gods are very holy, Immortal, knowing Law, whom man must worship,- May these to-day give us broad paths to travel. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: LET the prayer issue from the seat of Order, for Surya with his beams hath loosed the cattle. With lofty ridges earth is far extended, and Agni's flame hath lit the spacious surface.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Asuras, O Varuna and Mitra, this hymn to you, like food, anew I offer. One of you is a strong unerring Leader, and Mitra, speaking, stirreth men to labour.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The movements of the gliding wind come hither: like cows, the springs are filled to overflowing. Born in the station e'en of lofty heaven the Bull hath loudly bellowed in this region.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May I bring hither with my song, O Indra, wise Aryaman who yokes thy dear Bay Horses, Voracious, with thy noble car, O Hero, him who defeats the wrath of the malicious.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: In their own place of sacrifice adorers worship to gain long life and win his friendship. He hath poured food on men when they have praised him; be this, the dearest reverence, paid to Rudra.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Coming together, glorious, loudly roaring - Sarasvati, Mother of Floods, the seventh- With copious milk, with fair streams, strongly flowing, full swelling with the volume of their water;
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: And may the mighty Maruts, too, rejoicing, aid our devotion and protect our offspring. Let not swift-moving Aksara neglect us: they have increased our own appropriate riches,
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Bring ye the great Aramati before you, and Pusan as the Hero of the synod, Bhaga who looks upon this hymn with favour, and, as our strength, the bountiful Purandbi.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May this our song of praise reach you, O Maruts, and Visnu guardian of the future infant. May they vouchsafe the singer strength for offspring. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: LET your best-bearing car that must be lauded, ne'er injured, bring you Vajas and Rbhuksans. Fill you, fair-helmeted! with mighty Soma, thrice-mixed, at our libations to delight you.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ye who behold the light of heaven, Rbhuksans, give our rich patrons unmolested riches. Drink, heavenly-natured. at our sacrifices, and give us bounties for the hymns we sing you.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For thou, O Bounteous One, art used to giving, at parting treasure whether small or ample. Filled full are both thine arms with great possessions: thy goodness keeps thee not from granting riches.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra, high-famed, as Vaja and Rbhuksans, thou goest working, singing to the dwelling. Lord of Bay Steeds, this day may we Vasisthas offer our prayers to thee and bring oblations.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou winnest swift advancement for thy servant, through hymns, Lord of Bay Steeds, which thou hast favoured. For thee with friendly succour have we battled, and when, O Indra, wilt thou grant us riches?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To us thy priests a home, as 'twere, thou givest: when, Indra wilt thou recognize our praises? May thy strong Steed, through our ancestral worship, bring food and wealth with heroes to our dwelling.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Though Nirrti the Goddess reigneth round him, Autumns with food in plenty come to Indra. With three close Friends to length of days he cometh, he whom men let not rest at home in quiet.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Promise us gifts, O Savitar: may riches come unto us in Parvata's full bounty. May the Celestial Guardian still attend us. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: ON high hath Savitar, this God, extended the golden lustre which he spreads around him. Now, now must Bhaga be invoked by mortals, Lord of great riches who distributes treasures.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Rise up, O Savitar whose hands are golden, and hear this man while sacrifice is offered, Spreading afar thy broad and wide effulgence, and bringing mortal men the food that feeds them.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Let Savitar the God he hymned with praises, to whom the Vasus, even, all sing glory. Sweet be our lauds to him whose due is worship: may he with all protection guard our princes.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Even he whom Aditi the Goddess praises, rejoicing in God Savitar's incitement: Even he who praise the high imperial Rulers, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman, sing in concert.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: They who come emulous to our oblation, dispensing bounty, from the earth and heaven. May they and Ahibudhnya hear our calling: guard us Varutri with the Ekadhenus.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: This may the Lord of Life, entreated, grant us,-the wealth which Savitar the God possesses. The mighty calls on Bhaga for protection, on Bhaga calls the weak to give him riches.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Bless us the Vajins when we call, while slowly they move, strong Singers, to the Gods' assembly. Crushing the wolf, the serpent, and the demons, may they completely banish all affliction.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Deep-skilled in Law eternal, deathless, Singers, O Vajins, help us in each fray for booty. Drink of this meath, he satisfied, be joyful: then go on paths which Gods are wont to travel.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: AGNI, erect, hath shown enriching favour: the flame goes forward to the Gods' assembly. Like car-borne men the stones their path have chosen: let the priest, quickened, celebrate our worship.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Soft to the tread, their sacred grass is scattered: these go like Kings amid the band around them, At the folks early call on Night and Morning,-Vayu, and Pusan with his team, to bless us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Here on their path the noble Gods proceeded: in the wide firmament the Beauteous decked them. Bend your way hither, ye who travel widely: hear this our envoy who hath gone to meet you.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For they are holy aids at sacrifices: all Gods approach the place of congregation. Bring these, desirous, to our worship, Agni, swift the Nisatyas, Bhaga, and Purandhi.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni, to these men's hymns, from earth, from heaven, bring Mitra, Varuna, Indra, and Agni, And Aryaman, and Aditi, and Visnu. Sarasvati be joyful, and the Maruts.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Even as the holy wish, the gift is offered: may he, unsated, come when men desire him. Give never-failing ever-conquering riches: with Gods for our allies may we be victors.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Now have both worlds been praised by the Vasisthas; and holy Mitra, Varuna, and Agni. May they, bright Deities, make our song supremest. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: BE gathered all the audience of the synod: let us begin their praise whose course is rapid. Whate'er God Savitar this day produces, may we be where the Wealthy One distributes.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: This, dealt from heaven ' may both the Worlds vouchsafe us, and Varuna, Indra, Aryaman, and Mitra. May Goddess Aditi assign us riches, Vayu and Bhaga make them ours for ever.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Strong be the man and full of power, O Maruts, whom ye, borne on by spotted coursers, favour. Him, too, Sarasvati and Agni further, and there is none to rob him of his riches.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: This Varuna is guide of Law, he, Mitra, and Aryaman, the Kings, our work have finished. Divine and foeless Aditi quickly listens. May these deliver us unharmed from trouble.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With offerings I propitiate the branches of this swift-moving God, the bounteous Visnu. Hence Rudra gained his Rudra-strength: O Asvins, ye sought the house that hath celestial viands.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Be not thou angry here, O glowing Pusan, for what Varutri and the Bounteous gave us. May the swift-moving Gods protect and bless us, and Vata send us rain, wha wanders round us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Now have both worlds been praised by the Vasisthas, and holy Mitra, Varuna, and Agni. May they, bright Deities, make our song supremest. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: AGNI at dawn, and Indra we invoke at dawn, and Varuna and Mitra, and the Asvins twain. Bhaga at dawn, Pusan, and Brahmanaspati, Soma at dawn, Rudra we will invoke at dawn.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: We will invoke strong, early-conquering Bhaga, the Son of Aditi, the great supporter: Thinking of whom, the poor, yea, even the mighty, even the King himself says, Give me Bhaga.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Bhaga our guide, Bhaga whose gifts are faithful, favour this song, and give us wealth, O Bhaga. Bhaga, augment our store of kine and horses, Bhaga, may we be rich in men and heroes.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: So may felicity be ours at present, and when the day approaches, and at noontide; And may we still, O Bounteous One, at sunset be happy in the Deities' loving-kindness.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May Bhaga verily be bliss-bestower, and through him, Gods! may happiness attend us. As such, O Bhaga, all with might invoke thee: as such be thou our Champion here, O Bhaga.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To this our worship may all Dawns incline them, and come to the pure place like Dadhikravan. As strong steeds draw a chariot may they bring us hitherward Bhaga who discovers treasure.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May blessed Mornings dawn on us for ever, with wealth of kine, of horses, and of heroes, Streaming with all abundance, pouring fatness. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: LET Brahmans and Angirases come forward, and let the roar of cloudy heaven surround us. Loud low the Milch-kine swimming in the waters: set be the stones that grace our holy service.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary
