verses.translation: Come near with those most recent aids of yours which merit eulogy, When I invoke you, Wealthy Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As ye protected Kanva erst, Priyamedha and Upastuta, Atri, Sinjara, Asvins Twain
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: And Amsu in decisive fight, Agastya in the fray for kine. And, in his battles, Sobhari.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For so much bliss, or even more, O Asvins, Wealthy Gods, than this, We pray white singing hymns to you.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ascend your car with golden seat, O Asvins, and with reins of gold, That reaches even to the sky.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Golden is its supporting shaft, the axle also is of gold, And both the wheels are made of gold.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thereon, ye Lords of ample wealth, come to us even from afar, Come ye to this mine eulogy.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: From far away ye come to us, Asvins, enjoying plenteous food Of Dasas, O Immortal Ones.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With splendour, riches, and renown, O Asvins, hither come to us, Nasatyas, shining brilliantly.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May dappled horses, steeds who fly with pinions, bring you hitherward To people skilled in sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The whcel delayeth not that car of yours accompanied by song, That cometh with a store of food.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Borne on that chariot wrought of gold, with coursers very fleet of foot, Come, O Nasatyas, swift as thought.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Wealthy Gods, ye taste and find the brisk and watchful wild beast good. Associate wealth with food for us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As such, O Asvins, find for me my share of new-presented gifts, As Kasu, Cedi's son, gave me a hundred head of buffaloes, and ten thousand kine.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He who hath given me for mine own ten Kings like gold to look upon. At Caidya's feet are all the people round about, all those who think upon the shield.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: No man, not any, goes upon the path on which the Cedis walk. No other prince, no folk is held more liberal of gifts than they.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: INDRA, great in his power and might, and like Parjanya rich in rain, Is magnified by Vatsa's lauds.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When the priests, strengthening the Son of Holy Law, present their gifts, Singers with Order's hymn of praiser.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Since Kanvas with their lauds have made Indra complete the sacrifice. Words are their own appropriate arms.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Before his hot displeasure all the peoples, all the men, bow down, As rivers bow them to the sea.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: This power of his shone brightly forth when Indra brought together, like A skin, the worlds of heaven and earth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The fiercely-moving Vrtra's head he severed with his thunderbolt, His mighty hundred-knotted bolt.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Here are-we sing them loudly forth-our thoughts among-the best of songs. Even lightnings like the blaze of fire.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When bidden thoughts, spontaneously advancing, glow, and with the stream Of sacrifice the Kanvas shine.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra, may we obtain that wealth in horses and in herds of cows, And prayer that may be noticed first.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: I from my Father have received deep knowledge of the Holy Law I was born like unto the Sun.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: After the lore of ancient time I make, like Kanva, beauteous songs, And Indra's self gains strength thereby.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Whatever Rsis have not praised thee, Indra, or have lauded thee, By me exalted wax thou strong.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When his wrath thundered, when he rent Vrtra to pieces, limb by limb, He sent the waters to the sea.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Against the Dasyu Susna thou, Indra, didst hurl thy during bolt: Thou, Dread one, hast a hero's fame.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Neither the heavens nor firmaments nor regions of the earth contain Indra, the Thunderer with his might.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indra him who lay at length staying thy copious waters thou, In his own footsteps, smotest down
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou hiddest deep in darkness within, O Indra, who had set his grasp On spacious heaven and earth conjoined.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra, whatever Yatis and Bhrgus have offered praise to thee, Listen, thou Mighty, to my call.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra, these spotted cows yield thee their butter and the milky draught; Aiders, thereby, of sacrifice;
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Which, teeming, have received thee as a life-germ, Indra, with their mouth, Like Surya who sustaineth all.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Lord of Might, with hymns of praise the Kanvas have increased thy power, The drops poured forth have strengthened thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Under thy guidance, Indra, mid thy praises, Lord of Thunder, shall The sacrifice be soon performed.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra, disclose much food for us, like a stronghold with store of kine: Give progeny and heroic strength.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: And, Indra, grant us all that wealth of fleet steeds which shone bright of old Among the tribes of Nahusas.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Hither thou seemest to attract heaven's fold which shines before our eyes, When, Indra, thou art kind to us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Yea, when thou puttest forth thy power, Indra, thou governest the folk. Mighty, unlimited in strength.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The tribes who bring oblations call to thee, to thee to give them help, With drops to thee who spreadest far.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: There where the mountains downward slope, there by the meeting of the streams The Sage was manifest with song.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thence, marking, from his lofty place downward he looks upon the sea, And thence with rapid stir he moves.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Then, verify, they see the light refulgent of primeval seed, Kindled on yonder side of heaven.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra, the Kanvas all exalt thy wisdom and thy manly power, And, Mightiest! thine heroic strength.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Accept this eulogy of mine, Indra, and guard me carefully: Strengthen my thought and prosper it.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For thee, O Mighty, Thunder-armed, we singers through devotion have Fashioned the hymn that we may live.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To Indra have the Kanvas sung, like waters speeding down a slope: The song is fain to go to him.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As rivers swell the ocean, so our hymns of praise make Indra strong, Eternal, of resistless wrath.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come with thy lovely Bay Steeds, come to us from regions far away O Indra, drink this Soma juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Best slayer of Vrtras, men whose sacred grass is ready trimmed Invoke thee for the gain of spoil.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The heavens and earth come after thee as the wheel follows Etasa: To thee flow Soma-drops effused.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Rejoice, O Indra, in the light, rejoice in Saryandyan, Be Glad in the sacrificer's hymn.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Grown strong in heaven, the Thunder-armed hath bellowed, Vrtra-slayer, Bull, Chief drinker of the Soma juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou art a Rsi born of old, sole Ruler over all by might: Thou, Indra, guardest well our wealth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May thy Bay Steeds with beauteous backs, a hundred, bring thee to the feast, Bring thee to these our Soma-draughts.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Kanvas with their hymns of praise have magnified this ancient thought That swells with streams of meath and oil.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Mid mightiest Gods let mortal man choose Indra at the sacrifice, Indra, whoe'er would win, for help.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thy steeds, by Priyamedhas praised, shall bring thee, God whom all invoke, Hither to drink the Somajuice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: A hundred thousand have I gained from Parsu, from Tirindira, And presents of the Yadavas.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ten thousand head of kine, and steeds three times a hundred they bestowed On Pajra for the Sama-song.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Kakuha hath reached up to heaven, bestowing buffaloes yoked in fours, And matched in fame the Yadavas.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O MARUTS, when the sage hath poured the Trstup forth as food for you, Ye shine amid the mountain-clouds.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When, Bright Ones, fain to show your might ye have determined on your course, The mountain-clouds have bent them down.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Loud roaring with the winds the Sons of Prsni have upraised themselves: They have poured out the streaming food.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Maruts spread the mist abroad and make mountains rock and reel, When with the winds they go their way
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: What time the rivers and the hills before your coming bowed them down, So to sustain your mighty force.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: We call on you for aid by night, on you for succour in the day, On you while sacrifice proceeds.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: These, verily, wondrous, red of hue, speed on their courses with a roar Over the ridges of the sky.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With might they drop the loosened rein so that the Sun may run his course, And spread themselves with beams of light.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Accept, ye Maruts, this my song, accept ye this mine hymn of praise, Accept, Rbhuksans, this my call.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The dappled Cows have poured three lakes, meath for the Thunder-wielding God, From the great cask, the watery cloud.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Maruts, quickly come to us when, longing for felicity, We call you hither from the sky.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For, Rudras and Rbhuksans, ye, Most Bountiful, are in the house, Wise when the gladdening draught is drunk.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Maruts, send us down from heaven riches distilling rapturous joy, With plenteous food, sustaining all.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When, Bright Ones, hither from the hills ye have resolved to take your way, Ye revel in the drops effused.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Man should solicit with his lauds happiness which belongs to them, So great a band invincible.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: They who like fiery sparks with showers of rain blow through the heaven and earth, Milking the spring that never fails.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With chariots and tumultuous roar, with tempests and with hymns of praise The Sons of Prsni hurry forth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For wealth, we think of that whereby ye aided Yadu, Turvasa, And KanVa who obtained the spoil.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May these our viands Bounteous Ones I that flow in streams like holy oil, With Kanva's hymns, increase your might.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Where, Bounteous Lords for whom the grass is trimmed, are ye rejoicing now? What Brahman is adoring you?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Is it not there where ye of old, supplied with sacred grass, for lauds Inspired the strong in sacrifice?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: They brought together both the worlds, the mighty waters, and the Sun, And, joint by joint, the thunderbolt.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: They sundered Vrtra limb from limb and split the gloomy mountain-clouds, Performing a heroic deed.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: They reinforced the power and strength of Trita as he fought, and helped Indra in battle with the foe.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: They deck themselves for glory, bright, celestial, lightning in their hands, And helms of gold upon their heads.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When eagerly ye from far away came to the cavern of the Bull, He bellowed in his fear like Heaven.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Borne by your golden-footed steeds, O Gods, come hither to receive The sacrifice we offer you.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When the red leader draws along their spotted deer yoked to the car. The Bright Ones come, and shed the rain.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Susoma, Saryakiavan, and Arjika full of homes, have they. These Heroes, sought with downward car.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When, Maruts, ye come to him, the singer who invokes you thus, With favours to your suppliant?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: What now? where have ye still a friend since ye left Indra all alone? Who counteth on your friendship now?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Kanvas sing forth Agni's praise together with our Maruts' who Wield thunder and wear swords of gold.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Hither for new felicity may I attract the Impetuous Ones, The Heroes with their wondrous strength
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Before them sink the very hills deerning themselves abysses: yea, Even the mountains bend them down.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Steeds flying on their tortuous path through mid-air carry them, and give The man who lauds them strength and life.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni was born the first of all, like Surya lovely with his light: With lustre these have spread abroad.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: WITH all the succours that are yours, O Asvins, hither come to us: Wonderful, borne on paths of gold, drink ye the meath with Soma juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come now, ye Asvins, on your car decked with a sun-bright canopy, Bountiful, with your golden forms, Sages with depth of intellect.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come hither from the Nahusas, come, drawn by pure hymns, from mid-air. O Asvins, drink the savoury juice shed in the Kanvas' sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come to us hither from the heavens, come from mid-air, well-loved by us: Here Kanva's son hath pressed for you the pleasant meath of Soma juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come, Asvins, to give car to us, to drink the Soma, Asvins, come. Hail, Strengtheners of the praise-song speed onward, ye Heroes, with your thoughts.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As, Heroes, in the olden time the Rsis called you to their aid, So now, O Asvins, come to us, come near to this mine eulogy.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Even from the luminous sphere of heaven come to us, ye who find the light, Carers for Vatsa, through our prayers and lauds, O ye who hear our call.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Do others more than we adore the Asvins with their hymns of praise? The Rsi Vatsa, Kanva's son, hath magnified you with his songs.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The holy singer with his hymns hath called you, Asvins, hither-ward; Best Vrtra-slayers, free from stain, as such bring us felicity.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: What time, ye Lords of ample wealth, the Lady mounted on your car, Then, O ye Asvins, ye attained all wishes that your hearts desired.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come thence, O Asvins, on your car that hath a thousand ornaments: Vatsa the sage, the sage's son, hath sung a song of sweets to you.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Cheerers of many, rich in goods, discoverers of opulence, The Asvins, Riders through the sky, have welcomed this my song of praise.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Asvins, grant us all rich gifts wherewith no man may interfere. Make us observe the stated times: give us not over to reproach.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Whether, Nasatyas, ye be nigh, or whether ye be far away, Come thence, O Asvins, on your car that hath a thousand ornaments.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Vatsa the Rsi with his songs, Nasatyas, hath exalted you: Grant him rich food distilling oil, graced with a thousand ornaments.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Bestow on him, O Asvins, food that strengthens, and that drops with oil, On him who praises you for bliss, and, Lords of bounty, prays for wealth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come to us, ye who slay the foe, Lords of rich treasure, to this hymn. O Heroes, give us high renown and these good things of earth for help.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Priyamedhas have invoked you with all succours that are yours, You, Asvins, Lords of solemn rites, with calls entreating you to come.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come to us, Asvins, ye Who bring felicity, auspicious Ones, To Vatsa who with prayer and hymn, lovers of song, hath honoured you.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Aid us, O Heroes, for those hymns for which ye helped Go Sarya erst, Gave Vasa, Dasavraja aid, and Kanva and Medhatithi:
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: And favoured Trasadasyu, ye Heroes, in spoil-deciding fray: For these, O Asvins, graciously assist us in acquiring strength.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Asvins, may pure hymns of ours, and songs and praises, honour you: Best slayers everywhere of foes, as such we fondly yearn for you.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Three places of the Asvins, erst concealed, are made apparent now. Both Sages, with the flight of Law come hither unto those who live.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To help and favour Vatsa now, O Asvins, come ye hitherward. Bestow on him a dwelling spacious and secure, and keep malignities away.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: All manliness that is in heaven, with the Five Tribes, or in mid-air, Bestow, ye Asvins, upon us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Remember Kanva first of all among the singers, Asvins, who Have thought upon your wondrous deeds.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Asvins, for you with song of praise this hot oblation is effused, This your sweet Soma juice, ye Lords of ample wealth, through which ye think upon the foe.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Whatever ye have done in floods, in the tree, Wonder-Workers, and in growing plants, Therewith, O Asvins, succour me.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: What force, Nasatyas, ye exert, whatever, Gods, ye tend and heal, This your own Vatsa gains not by his hymns alone: ye visit him who offers gifts.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Now hath the Rsi splendidly thought out the Asvins' hymn of praise. Let the Atharvan pour the warm oblation forth, and Soma very rich in sweets.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ye Asvins, now ascend your car that lightly rolls upon its way. May these my praises make you speed hitherward like a cloud of heaven.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When, O Nasatyas, we this day make you speed hither with our hymns, Or, Asvins, with our songs of praise, remember Kanya specially.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As erst Kaksivan and the Rsi Vyasva, as erst Dirghatamas invoked your presence, Or, in the sacrificial chambers, Vainya Prthi, so be ye mindful of us here, O Asvins.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come as home-guardians, saving us from foemen, guarding our living creatures and our bodies, Come to the house to give us seed and offspring,
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Whether with Indra ye be faring, Asvins, or resting in one dwelling-place with Vayu, In concord with the Rbhus or Adityas, or standing still in Visnu's striding-places.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When I, O Asvins, call on you to-day that I may gather strength, Or as all-conquering might in war, be that the Asvins' noblest grace.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Now come, ye Asvins, hitherward: here are oblations set for you; These Soma-draughts to aid Yadu and Turvasa, these offered you mid Kanva's Sons.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Whatever healing balm is yours, Nisatyas, near or far away, Therewith, great Sages, grant a home to Vatsa and to Vimada.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Together with the Goddess, with the Asvins' Speech have I awoke. Thou, Goddess, hast disclosed the hymn, and holy gift from mortal men.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Awake the Asvins, Goddess Dawn! Up Mighty Lady of sweet strains! Rise, straightway, priest of sacrifice! High glory to the gladdening draught!
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou, Dawn, approaching with thy light shinest together with the Sun, And to this man-protecting home the chariot of the Asvins comes.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When yellow stalks give forth the juice, as cows from udders pour their milk, And voices sound the song of praise, the Asvins' worshippers show first.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Forward for glory and for strength, protection that shall conquer men, And power and skill, most sapient Ones!
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When Asvins, worthy of our lauds, ye seat you in the father's house. With wisdom or the bliss ye bring.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: WHETHER ye travel far away or dwell in yonder light of heaven, Or in a mansion that is built above the sea, come thence, ye Asvins, hitherward.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Or if for Manu.ye prepared the sacrifice, remember also Kanva's son. I call Brhaspati, Indra, Visnu, all the gods, the Asvins borne by rapid steeds.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Those Asvins I invoke who work marvels, brought hither to receive, With whom our friendship is most famed, and kinship passing that of Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: On whom the solemn rites depend, whose worshippers rise without the Sun: These who foreknow the holy work of sacrifice, and by their Godhead drink the sweets of Soma juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Whether ye, Lords of ample wealth, now linger in the cast or west, With Druhyu, or with Anu, Yadu, Turvaga, I call you hither; come to me.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Lords of great riches, whether through the firmament ye fly or speed through heaven and earth, Or with your Godlike natures stand upon your cars, come thence, O Asvins, hitherward.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: THOU Agni, God mid mortal men, art guard of sacred rites, thou art To be adored at sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Mighty Agni, thou must be glorified at our festivals, Bearing our offerings to the Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Jatavedas Agni, fight and drive our foes afar from us, Them and their godless enmities.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou, Jatavedas, seekest not the worship of a hostile man, However nigh itbe to thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: We sages, mortals as we are, adore the mighty name of thee, Immortal Jatavedas' name.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Sages, we call the Sage to help, mortals, we call the God to aid: We call on Agni with our songs.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May Vatsa draw- thy mind away even from thy loftiest dwelling-place, Agni, with song that yearns for thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou art the same in many a place: mid all the people thou art Lord. In fray and fight we call on thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When we are seeking strength we call Agni to help us in the strife, The giver of rich gifts in war.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ancient, adorable at sacrifices, Priest from of old, meet for our praise, thou sittest. Fill full and satisfy thy body, Agni, and win us happiness by offering worship.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: JOY, Mightiest Indra, known and marked, sprung most from Soma-draughts, wherewith Thou smitest down the greedy fiend, for that we long.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Wherewith thou bolpest Adhrigu, the great Dasagva, and the God Who stirs the sunlight, and the sea, for that we long.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Wherewith thou dravest forth like cars Sindhu and all the mighty floods To go the way ordained by Law, for that we long.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Accept this laud for aid, made pure like oil, thou Caster of the Stone, Whereby even in a moment thou hast waxen great.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Be pleased, Song-lover, with this song it flows abundant like the sea. Indra, with all thy succours thou hast waxen great.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The God who from afar hath sent gifts to maintain our friendship's bond, Thou. spreading them like rain from heaven, hast waxen great.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The beams that mark him have grown strong, the thunder rests between his arms, When, like the Sun, he hath increased both Heaven and Earth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When, Mighty Lord of Heroes, thou didst cat a thousand buffaloes, Then grew and waxed exceeding great thine Indra-power.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra consumeth with the rays of Surya the malicious man: Like Agni conquering the woods, he hath grown strong.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: This newest thought of ours that suits the time approaches unto thee: Serving, beloved in many a place it metes and marks.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The pious germ of sacrifice directly purifies the soul. By Indra's lauds it waxes great, it metes and marks.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra who wins the friend hath spread himself to drink the Soma-draught: Like worshipper's dilating praise; it metes and marks.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He whom the sages, living men, have gladdened, offering up their hymns, Hath swelled like oil of sacrifice in Agni's mouth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Aditi also hath brought forth a hymn for Indra, Sovran Lord: The work of sacrifice for help is glorified.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The ministering priests have sung their songs for aid and eulogy: God, thy Bays turn not from the rite which Law ordains.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: If, Indra, thou drink Soma by Visnu's or Trta Aptya's side, Or with the Maruts take delight in flowing drops;
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Or, Sakra, if thou gladden thee afar or in the sea of air, Rejoice thee in this juice of ours, in flowing drops.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Or, Lord of Heroes if thou aid the worshipper who shed; the, juice, Or him whose laud delights thee, and his flowing drops.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To magnify the God, the God, Indra, yea, Indra for your help, And promptly end the sacrifice-this have they gained.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With worship, him whom men adore, with Soma, him who drinks it most, Indra with lauds have they increased this have they gained.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: His leadings are with power and might and his instructions manifold: He gives the worshipper all wealth: this have they gained.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For slaying Vrtra have the Gods set Indra in the foremost place. Indra the choral bands have sung, for vigorous strength.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: We to the Mighty with our might, with lauds to him who hears our call, With holy hymns have sung aloud, for vigorous strength.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Not earth, nor heaven, nor firmaments contain the Thunder-wielding God: They shake before his violent rush and vigorous strength.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: What time the Gods, O Indra, get thee foremost in the furious fight, Then thy two beautiful Bay Steeds carried thee on.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When Vrtra, stayer of the floods, thou seest, Thunderor with might, Then thy two beautiful Bay Steeds carried thee on.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When Visnu, through thine energy, strode wide those three great steps of his, Then thy two beautiful Bay Steeds carried thee on.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When thy two beautiful Bay Steeds grew great and greater day by day, Even then all creatures that had life bowed down to thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When, Indra, all the Marut folk humbly submitted them to thee, Even then all creatures that had life bowed down to thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When yonder Sun, that brilliant light, thou settest in the heaven above, Even then all creatures that had life bowed down to thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To thee, O Indra, with this thought the sage lifts up this eulogy, Akin and leading as on foot to sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When in thine own dear dwelling all gathered have lifted up the voice Milk-streams at worship's central spot, for sacrifice,
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As Priest, O Indra, give us wealth in brave men and good steeds and kine That we may first remember thee for sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: INDRA, when Soma juices flow, makes his mind pure and meet for lauds. He gains the power that brings success, for great is he.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: In heaven's first region, in the seat of Gods, is he who brings success, Most glorious, prompt to save, who wins the water-floods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Him, to win strength, have I invoked, even Indra mighty for the fray. Be thou most near to us for bliss, a Friend to aid.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra, Song -lover, here for thee the worshipper's libation flows. Rejoicing in this sacred grass thou shinest forth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Even now, O Indra, give us that which, pressing juice, we crave of thee. Bring us wealth manifold which finds the light of heaven.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: What time the zealous worshipper hath boldly sung his songs to thee, Like branches of a tree up-grows what they desire.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Generate songs even as of old, give car unto the singer's call. Thou for the pious hast grown great at each carouse.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Sweet strains that glorify him play like waters speeding down a slope, Yea, him who in this song is called the Lord of Heaven;
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Yea, who alone is called the Lord, the single Ruler of the folk, By worshippers seeking aid: may he joy in the draught.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Praise him, the Glorious, skilled in song, Lord of the two victorious Bays: They seek the worshipper's abode who bows in prayer.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Put forth thy strength: with dappled Steeds come, thou of mighty intellect, With swift Steeds to the sacrifice, for 'tis thy joy.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Grant wealth to those who praise thee, Lord of Heroes, Mightiest Indra: give Our princes everlasting fame and opulence.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: I call thee when the Sun is risen, I call thee at the noon of day: With thy car-horses, Indra, come well pleased to us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Speed forward hither, come to us, rejoice thee in the milky draught: Spin out the thread of ancient time, as well is known.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: If, Sakra, Vrtra-slayer, thou be far away or near to us. Or in the sea, thou art the guard of Soma juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Let songs we sing and Soma-drops expressed by us make Indra strong: The tribes who bring oblations find delight in him.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Him sages longing for his aid, with offerings brought in eager haste, Him. even as branches, all mankind have made to grow.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: At the Trkadrukas the Gods span sacrifice that stirred the mind: May our songs strengthen him who still hath strengthened us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When, true to duty, at due times the worshipper offers lauds to thee, They call him Purifier, Pure, and Wonderful.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: That mind of Rudra, fresh and strong, moves conscious in the ancient ways, With reference whereto the wise have ordered this.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: If thou elect to be my Friend drink of this sacrificial juice, By help whereof we may subdue all enemies.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indra, Lover of the song, when shall thy praiser be most blest? When wilt thou grant us wealth in herds of kine and steeds?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: And thy two highly-lauded Bays, strong stallions, draw thy car who art Untouched by age, most gladdening car for which we pray.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With ancient offerings we implore the Young and Strong whom many praise. He from of old hath sat upon dear sacred grass.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Wax mighty, thou whom many laud for aids which Rsis have extolled. Pour down for us abundant food and guard us well.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indra, Caster of the Stone, thou helpest him who praises thee: From sacrifice I send to thee a mind yoked hymn.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Here, yoking for the Soma-draught these Horses, sharers of thy feast, Thy Bay Steeds, Indra, fraught with weal to, consent to come.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Attendants on thy glory, let the Rudras roar assent to thee, And all the Marut companies come to the feast.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: These his victorious followers bold in the heavens the place they love, Leagued in the heart of sacrifice, as well we know.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: That we may long behold the light, what time the ordered rite proceeds, He duly measures, as he views, the sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indra, strong is this thy car, and strong are these Bay Steeds of thine: O Satakratu, thou art strong, strong is our call.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Strong is the press-stone, strong thy joy, strong is the flowing Soma juice: Strong is the rite thou furtherest, strong is our call.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As strong I call on thee the Strong, O Thunderer with thy thousand aids: For thou hast won the hymn of praise. Strong is our call.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: IF I, O Indra, were, like thee, the single Sovran of all wealth, My worshipper should be rich in kine.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: I should be fain, O Lord of Power, to strengthen and enrich the sage, Were I the Lord of herds of kine.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To worshippers who press the juice thy goodness, Indra, is a cow Yielding in plenty kine and steeds.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: None is there, Indra, God or man, to hinder thy munificence, The wealth which, lauded, thou wilt give.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The sacrifice made Indra strong when he unrolled the earth, and made Himself a diadem in heaven.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thine aid we claim, O Indra, thine who after thou hast waxen great Hast won all treasures for thine own.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: In Soma's ecstasy Indra spread the firmament and realms of light, When he cleft Vala limb from limb.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Showing the hidden he drave forth the cows for the Angirases, And Vala he cast headlong down.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: By Indra were the luminous realms of heaven established and secured, Firm and immovable from their place.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra, thy laud moves quickly like a joyous wave of water-floods: Bright shine the drops that gladden thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For thou, O Indra, art the God whom hymns and praises magnify: Thou blessest those who worship thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Let the two long-maned Bay Steeds bring Indra to drink the Soma juice, The Bountiful to our sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With waters' foam thou torest off, Indra, the head of Namuci, Subduing all contending hosts.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Dasyus, when they fain would climb by magic arts and mount to heaven, Thou, Indra, castest down to earth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As Soma-drinker conquering all, thou scatteredst to every side Their settlement who poured no gifts.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: SING forth to him whom many men invoke, to him whom many laud. Invite the powerful Indra with your songs of praise.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Whose lofty might-for doubly strong is he-supports the heavens and earth, And hills and plains and floods and light with manly power.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Such, Praised by many! thou art King alone thou smitest Vrtras dead, To gain, O Indra, spoils of war and high renown.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: We sing this strong and wild delight of thine which conquers in the fray, Which, Caster of the Stone! gives room and shines like gold.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Wherewith thou also foundest lights for Ayu and for Manu's sake: Now joying in this sacred grass thou beamest forth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: This day too singers of the hymn praise, as of old, this might of thine: Win thou the waters day by day, thralls of the strong.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: That lofty Indra-power of thine, thy strength and thine intelligence, Thy thunderbolt for which we long, the wish makes keen.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indra, Heaven and Earth augment thy manly power and thy renown; The waters and thy mountains stir and urge thee on.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Visnu the lofty ruling Power, Varuna, Mitra sing thy praise: In thee the Marut3' company have great delight.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indra, thou wast born the Lord of men, most liberal of thy gifts: Excellent deeds for evermore are all thine own.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ever, alone, O highly-praised, thou sendest Vrtras to their rest: None else than Indra executes the mighty deed.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Though here and there, in varied hymns, Indra, men call on thee for aid, Still with our heroes fight and win the light of heaven.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Already have all forms of him entered our spacious dwelling-place: For victory stir thou Indra, up, the Lord of Might.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: PRAISE Indra whom our songs must laud, sole Sovran of mankind, the Chief Most liberal who controlleth men.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: In whom the hymns of praise delight, and all the glory-giving songs. Like the floods' longing for the sea.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Him I invite with eulogy, best King, effective in the fight, Strong for the gain of mighty spoil.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Whose perfect ecstasies are wide, profound, victorious, and give joy in the field where heroes win.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Him, when the spoils of war are staked, men call to be their advocate: They who have Indra win the day.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Men honour him with stirring songs and magnify with solemn rites: Indra is he who giveth case.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: 1ndra is priest and Rsi, he is much invoked by many men, And mighty by his mighty powers.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Meet to be lauded and invoked, true Hero with his deeds of might, Victorious even when alone.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The men, the people magnify that Indra with their Slina. songs, With hymns and sacred eulogies
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Him who advances them to wealth, sends light to lead them in the war, And quells their foemen in the fray.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May he, the saviour much-invoked, may Indra bear us in a ship Safely beyond all enemies.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As such, O Indra, honour us with gifts of booty, further us, And lead us to felicity.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: COME, we have pressed the juice for thee; O Indra, drink this Soma here Sit thou on this my sacred grass.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indra, let thy long-maned Bays, yoked by prayer, bring thee hitherward Give car and listen to our prayers.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: We Soma-bearing Brahmans call thee Soma-drinker with thy friend, We, Indra, bringing Soma juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come unto us who bring the juice, come unto this our eulogy, Fair-visored! drink thou of the juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: I pour it down within thee, so through all thy members let it spread: Take with. thy tongue the pleasant drink.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Sweet to thy body let it be, delicious be the savoury juice: Sweet be the Soma to thine heart.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Like women, let this Soma-draught, invested with its robe, approach, O active Indra, close to thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra, transported with the juice, vast in his bulk, strong in his neck And stout arms, smites the Vrtras down.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indra, go thou forward, thou who rulest over all by might: Thou Vrtra-slayer slay the fiends,
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Long be thy grasping-hook wherewith thou givest ample wealth to him Who sheds the juice and worships thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Here, Indra, is thy Soma-draught, made pure upon the sacred grass: Run hither, come and drink thereof.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Famed for thy radiance, worshipped well this juice is shed for thy delight Thou art invoked, Âkhaṇḍala!
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To Kundapayya, grandson's son, grandson of Ṣringavṛish! to thee, To him have I addressed my thought.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Strong pillar thou, Lord of the home armour of Soma-offerers: The drop of Soma breaketh all the strongholds down, and Indra is the Rsis' Friend.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Holy Pṛidâkusânu, winner of the spoil, one eminent o'er many men, Lead on the wild horse Indra with his vigorous grasp forward to drink the Soma juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Now let the mortal offer prayer to win the unexampled grace Of these Adityas and their aid to cherish life.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For not an enemy molests the paths which these Adityas tread: Infallible guards, they strengthen us in happiness.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Now soon may Bhaga, Savitar, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman Give us the shelter widely spread which we implore.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With Gods come thou whose fostering care none checks, O Goddesss Aditi: Come, dear to many, with the Lords who guard us well.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For well these Sons of Aditi know to keep enmities aloof, Unrivalled, giving ample room, they save from woe.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Aditi guard our herd by day, Aditi, free from guile, by night, Aditi, ever strengthening, save us from grief!
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: And in the day our hymn is this: May Aditi come nigh to help, With loving-kindness bring us weal and chase our foes.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: And may the Asvins, the divine Pair of Physicians, send us health: May they remove iniquity and chase our foes.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May Agni bless us with his fires, and Surya warm us pleasantly: May the pure Wind breathe sweet on us, and chase our foes.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Drive ye disease and strife away, drive ye away malignity: Adityas, keep us ever far from sore distress.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Remove from us the arrow, keep famine, Adityas! far away: Keep enmities afar from us, Lords of all wealth!
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Now, O Adityas, grant to us the shelter that lets man go free, Yea, even the sinner from his sin, ye Bounteous Gods 1
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Whatever mortal with the powe r of demons fain would injure us, May he, impetuous, suffer harm by his own deeds.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May sin o'ertake our human foe, the man who speaketh evil thing, Him who would cause our misery, whose heart is false.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Gods, ye are with the simple ones, ye know each mortal in your hearts; Ye, Vasus, well discriminate the false and true.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Fain would we have the sheltering aid of mountains and of water-floods: Keep far from us iniquity, O Heaven and Earth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: So with auspicious sheltering aid do ye, O Vasus, carry us Beyond all trouble and distress, borne in your ship.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Adityas, ye Most Mighty Ones, grant to our children and their seed Extended term of life that they may live long days.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Sacrifice, O Adityas, is your inward monitor: be kind, For in the bond of kindred we are bound to you.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Maruts' high protecting aid, the Asvins, and the God who saves, Mitra and Varuna for weal we supplicate.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Grant us a home with triple guard, Aryaman, Mitra, Varuna! Unthreatened, Maruts! meet for praise, and filled with men.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: And as we human beings, O Adityas, are akin to death, Graciously lengthen ye our lives that we may live.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: SING praise to him, the Lord of Light. The Gods have made the God to be their messenger, And sent oblation to Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni, the Bounteous Giver, bright with varied flames, laud thou, O singer Sobhari- Him who controls this sacred food with Soma blent, who hath first claim to sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thee have we chosen skill fullest in sacrifice, Immortal Priest among the Gods, Wise finisher of this holy rite:
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Son of Strength, the blessed, brightly shining One, Agni whose light is excellent. May be by sacrifice win us in heaven the grace of Mitra, Varuna, and the Floods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The mortal who hath ministered to Agni with oblation, fuel, ritual lore, And reverence, skilled in sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Verily swift to run are his fleet-footed steeds, and most resplendent fame is his. No trouble caused by Gods or wrought by mortal man from any side o'ertaketh him.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May we by thine own fires be well supplied with fire, O Son of Strength, O Lord of Might: Thou as our Friend hast worthy men.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni, who praises like a guest of friendly mind, is as a car that brings us gear. Also in thee is found perfect security thou art the Sovran Lord of wealth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: That man, moreover, merits praise who brings, auspicious Agni, sacrificial gifts May he win riches by his thoughts.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He for whose sacrifice thou standest up erect is prosperous and rules o'er men. He wins with coursers and with singers killed in song: with heroes he obtains the prize.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He in whose dwelling Agni is chief ornament, and, all-desired, loves his laud well, And zealously tends his offerings-
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: His, or the lauding sage's word, his, Son of Strength! who Is most prompt with sacred gifts, Set thou beneath the Gods, Vasu, above mankind, the speech of the intelligent.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He who with sacrificial gifts or homage bringeth very skilful Agni nigh, Or him who flashes fast with song,
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The mortal who with blazing fuel, as his laws command, adores the Perfect God, Blest with his thoughts in splendour shall exceed all men, as though he overpassed the floods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Give us the splendour, Agni, which may overcome each greedy fiend in our abode, The wrath of evil-hearted folk.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: That, wherewith Mitra, Varuna, and Aryaman, the Asvins, Bhaga give us light, That may we, by thy power finding best furtherance, worship, O Indra, helped by thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Agni, most devout are they, the sages who have set thee Sage exceeding wise, O God, for men to look upon:
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Who have arranged thine altar Blessed God, at morn brought thine oblation, pressed the juice. They by their deeds of strength have won diem, mighty wealth, who have set all their hope in thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May Agni worshipped bring us bliss, may the gift, Blessed One, and sacrifice bring bliss; Yea, may our praises bring us bliss.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Show forth the mind that brings success in war with fiends, wherewith thou conquerest in fight. Bring down the many firm hopes of our enemies, and let us vanquish with thine aid.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: I praise with song the Friend of man, whom Gods sent down to be herald and messenger, Best worshipper, bearer of our gifts.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou unto sharp-toothed Agni, Young and Radiant God, proclaimest with thy song the feast- Agni, who for our sweet strains moulds heroic strength when sacred oil is offered him,
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: While, served with sacrificial oil, now upward and now downward Agni moves his sword, As doth the Asura his robe.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The God, the Friend of man, who bears our gifts to heaven, the God with his sweet-smelling mouth, Distributes, skilled in sacrifice, his precious things, Invoking Priest, Immortal God.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Son of Strength, Agni, if thou wert the mortal, bright as Mitra, I worshipped with our gifts! And I were the Immortal God
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: I would not give thee up, Vasu, to calumny, or misery, O Bounteous One. My worshipper should feel no hunger or distress, nor, Agni, should he live in sin.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Like a son cherished in his father's house, Let our oblation rise unto the Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With thine immediate aid may I, excellent Agni, ever gain my wish A mortal with a God to help.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Agni, by thy wisdom, by thy bounties, by thy leading may I gather wealth. Excellent Agni, thou art called my Providence: delight thou to be liberal.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni, he conquers by thine aid that brings him store of noble heroes and great strength, Whose bond of friendship is thy choice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thy spark is black and crackling, kindled in due time, O Bounteous, it is taken up. Thou art the dear Friend of the mighty Mornings: thou shinest in glimmerings of the night.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: We Sobharis have come to him, for succour, who is good to help with thousand powers, The Sovran, Trasadasyu's Friend.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Agni, thou on whom all other fires depend, as branches on the parent stem, I make the treasures of the folk, like songs, mine own, while I exalt thy sovran might.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The mortal whom, Adityas, ye, Guilelew, lead to the farther bank Of all the princes, Bounteous Ones
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Whoe'er he be, Man-ruling Kings! the Regent of the race of men- May we, O Mitra, Varuna, and Aryaman, like him be furtherers of your law.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: A gift of fifty female slaves hath Trasadasyu given me, Purukutsa's son, Most liberal, kind, lord of the brave.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: And Syava too for me led forth a strong steed at Suvastu's ford: A herd of three times seventy kine, good lord of gifts, he gave to me.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: LET none, Swift Travellers! check you: come hither, like-spirited, stay not far away, Ye benders even of what is firm.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Maruts, Rbhuksans, Rudras come ye with your cars strong-fellied and exceeding bright. Come, ye for whom we long, with food, to sacrifice, come ye with love to Sobbari.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For well we know the vigorous might of Rudra's Sons, the Maruts, who are passing strong, Swift Visnu's band, who send the rain.,
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Islands are bursting forth and misery is stayed: the heaven and earth are joined in one. Decked with bright rings, ye spread the broad expanses out, when ye, Self. luminous, stirred yourselves.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Even things immovable shake and reel, the mountains and the forest trees at your approach, And the earth trembles as ye come.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To lend free course, O Maruts, to your furious rush, heaven high and higher still gives way, Where they, the Heroes mighty with their arms, display their gleaming ornaments on their forms.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: After their Godlike nature they, the bull. like Heroes, dazzling and impetuous, wear Great splendour as they show erect.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The pivot of the Sobharis' chariot within the golden box is balmed with milk. May they the Well-born, Mighty, kindred of the Cow, aid us to food and to delight.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Bring, ye who sprinkle balmy drops. oblations to your vigorous Marut company, To those whose leader is the Bull.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come hither, O ye Mares, on your strong horsed car, solid in look, with solid naves. Lightly like winged falcons, O ye Heroes, come, come to enjoy our offerings.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Their decoration is the same: their ornaments of gold are bright upon their arms; Their lances glitter splendidly.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: They toil not to defend their bodies from attack, strong Heroes with their mighty arms. Strong are your bows and strong the weapons in your cars, and glory sits on every face.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Whose name extendeth like a sea, alone, resplendent, so that all have joy in it, And life-power like ancestral might.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary
