verses.translation: Pay honour to these Maruts and sing praise to them, for of the wheel-spokes of the car Of these loud roarers none is last: this is their power, this moves them to give mighty gifts.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Blest by your favouring help was he, O Maruts, at the earlier flushings of the morn, And even now shall he be blest.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The strong man to whose sacrifice, O Heroes, ye approach that ye may taste thereof, With glories and with war that winneth spoil shall gain great bliss, ye Shakers of the world.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Even as Rudra's Sons, the brood of the Creator Dyaus, the Asura, desire, O Youthful Ones, so shall it be:
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: And these the bounteous, worthy of the Maruts who move onward pouring down the rain- Even for their sake, O Youthful Ones, with kindest heart take us to you to be your own.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Sobhari, with newest song sing out unto the youthful purifying Bulls, Even as a plougher to his steers.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Who, like a celebrated boxer, overcome the challengers in every fight: They who, like shining bulls, are most illustrious-honour those Maruts with thy song.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Allied by common ancestry, ye Maruts, even the Cows, alike in energy, Lick, all by turns, each other's head.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Even mortal man, ye Dancers breast adorned with gold, attains to brotherhood with you. Mark ye and notice us, O Maruts; evermore your friendship is secured to us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Maruts, rich in noble gifts, bring us a portion of the Maruts' medicine, Ye Coursers who are Friends to us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Haters of those who serve you not, bliss-bringers, bring us bliss with those auspicious aids Wherewith ye are victorious and guard Sindhu well, and succour Krvi in his need.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Maruts, who rest on fair trimmed grass, what balm soever Sindhu or Asikni hath, Or mountains or the seas contain.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ye carry on your bodies, ye who see it all: so bless us graciously therewith. Cast, Maruts, to the ground our sick man's malady: replace the dislocated limb.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: WE call on thee, O Matchless One! We seeking help, possessing nothing firm ourselves, Call on thee wonderful in fight
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: On thee for aid in sacrifice. This youth of ours, the bold, the mighty, hath gonse forth. We therefore, we thy friends, Indra, have chosen thee, free-giver, as our Guardian God.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come hither, for the drops are here, O Lord of corn-lands. Lord of horses, Lord of kine: Drink thou the Soma, Soma's Lord!
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For we the kinless singers have drawn hither thee, O Indra, who hast numerous kin. With all the forms thou hast, comic thou of bull-like strength, come near to drink the Soma juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Sitting like birds beside thy meath, mingled with milk, that gladdeneth and exalteth thee, Indra, to thee we sing aloud.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: We speak to thee with this our reverential prayer. Why art thou pondering yet awhile? Here are our wishes; thou art liberal, Lord of Bays: we and our hymns are present here.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For not in recent times alone, O Indra, Thunder-armed, have we obtained thine aid. Of old we knew thy plenteous wealth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Hero, we knew thy friendship and thy rich rewards: these, Thunderer, now we crave of thee. O Vasu, for all wealth that cometh of the kine, sharpen our powers, fair-visored God.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Him who of old hath brought to us this and that blessing, him I magnify for you, Even Indra, O my friends, for help
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Borne by Bay Steeds, the Lord of heroes, ruling men, for it is he who takes; delight. May Maghavan bestow on us his worshippers hundreds of cattle and of steeds.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Hero, may we, with thee for Friend, withstand the man who pants against us in his wrath, In fight with people rich in kine.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May we be victors in the singer's battle song, and meet the wicked, Much invoked! With heroes smite the foeman and show forth our strength. O Indra, further thou our thoughts.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indra, from all ancient time rivalless ever and companionless art thou: Thou seekest comradeship in war.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou findest not the wealthy man to be thy friend: those scorn thee who are flown with wine. What time thou thunderest and gatherest, then thou, even as a Father, art invoked.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indra, let us not, like fools who waste their lives at home, with friendship such as thine Sit idly by the poured-out juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Giver of kine, may we not miss thy gracious gifts: let us not rob thee of thine own. Strip even the strong places of the foe, and bring: thy gifts can never be made vain.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra or blest Sarasvati alone bestows such wealth, treasure so great, or thou, O Citra, on the worshipper.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Citra is King, and only kinglings are the rest who dwell beside Sarasvati. He, like Parjanya with his rain, hath spread himself with thousand, yea, with myriad gifts.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: HITHERWARD have I called to-day, for succour, that most wondrous car Which ye ascended, Asvins, ye whose paths are red, swift to give Car, for Surya's sake.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Car ever young, much longed-for, easily invoked, soon guided, first in deeds of might, Which waits and serves, O Sobhari, with benevolence, without a rival or a foe.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: These Asvins with our homage, these Two Omnipresent Deities Hitherward will we bring for kind help, these who seek the dwelling of the worshipper.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: One of your chariot wheels is moving swiftly round, one speeds for you its onward course. Like a milch-cow, O Lords of splendour, and with haste let your benevolence come to us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: That chariot of yours which hath a triple seat and reins of gold, The famous car that traverseth the heaven and earth, thereon Nasatyas, Asvins, come.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ye with your plough, when favouring Manu with your help, ploughed the first harvest in the sky. As such will we exalt you, Lords of splendour, now, O Asvins, with our prayer and praise.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come to us, Lords of ample wealth, by paths of everlasting Law, Whereby to high dominion ye with mighty strength raised Trksi, Trasadasyu's son.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: This Soma pressed with stones is yours, ye Heroes, Lords of plenteous wealth. Approach to drink the Soma, come, drink in the worshipper's abode.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Asvins, mount the chariot, mount the golden seat, ye who are Lords of plenteous wealth, And bring to us abundant food.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The aids wherewith ye helped Paktha and Adhrigt;, and Babhru severed from his friends,- With those, O Asvins, come hither with speed and soon, and heal whatever is diseased.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When we continually invoke the Asvins, the resistless, at this time of day, We lovers of the song, with songs.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Through these, ye Mighty Ones, come hither to my call which brings all blessings, wears all forms,- Through which, All-present Heroes, lavishest of food ye strengthened Krvi, come through these.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: I speak to both of these as such, these Asvins whom I reverence at this time of day: With homage we entreat them both.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ye who are Lords of splendour, ye whose paths are red, at eve, at mom, at sacrifice, Give us not utterly as prey to mortal foe, ye Rudras, Lords of ample wealth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For bliss I call. the blissful car, at morn the inseparable Asvins with their car I call, like Sobhari our sire.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Rapid as thought, and strong, and speeding to the joy, bringing your swiftly-coming help, Be to us a protection even from far away Lords of great wealth, with many aids.'
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come, Wonder-Workers, to our home, our home, O Asvins, rich in cattle, steeds, and gold, Chief drinkers of the Soma's juice
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Choice-worthy strength, heroic, firm and excellent, uninjured by the Raksas foe, At this your coming nigh, ye Lords of ample wealth and all good things, may we obtain.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: WORSHIP thou Jatavedas, pray to him who willingly accepts, Whose smoke wanders at will, and none may grasp his flame.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou, all men's friend, Visvamanas, exaltest Agni with thy song, The Giver, and his flames with which no cars contend.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Whose resolute assault, to win vigour and food, deserves our praise,- Through whose discovering power the priest obtaineth wealth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Up springs the imperishable flame, the flame of the Refulgent One Most bright, with glowing jaws and glory in his train.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Skilled in fair sacrifice, extolled, arise in Godlike loveliness, Shining with lofty splendour, with effulgent light.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Called straight to our oblations, come, O Agni, through our eulogies, As thou hast been our envoy bearing up our gifts.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: I call your Agni, from of old Invoking Priest of living men: Him with this song I laud and magnify for you.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Whom, wondrous wise, they animate with solemn rites and his fair form, Kind as a friend to men who keep the holy Law.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Him, true to Law, who perfecteth the sacrifice,. Law-loving ones! Ye with your song have gratified in the place of prayer.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May all our sacrifices go to him the truest Angiras, Who is among mankind the most illustrious Priest.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Imperishable Agni, thine are all these high enkindled lights, Like horses and like stallions showing forth their strength.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: So give us, Lord of Power and Might, riches combined with hero strength, And guard us with our sons and grand. sons in our frays.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Soon as the eager Lord of men is friendly unto Manti's race, Agni averteth from us all the demon host.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Hero Agni, Lord of men, on hearing this new laud of mine, Burn down the Raksasas, enchanters, with thy flame.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: No mortal foe can e'er prevail by arts of magic over him Who serveth Agni well with sacrificial gifts.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Vyasva the sage, who sought the Bull, hath won thee, finder of good things: As such may we enkindle thee for ample wealth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Usana Kavya stablished thee, O Agni, as Invoking Priest: Thee, Jatavedas, Sacrificing Priest for man.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: All Deities of one accord appointed thee their messenger: Thou, God, through hearing, hadst first claim to sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Him may the mortal hero make his own immortal messenger. Far-spreading, Purifier, him whose path is black.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With lifted ladles let us call him splendid with his brilliant flame, Men's ancient Agni, wasting not, adorable.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The man who pays the worship due to him with sacrificial gifts Obtains both plenteous nourishment and hero fame.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To Jatavedas Agni, chief in sacrifices, first of all With homage goes the ladle rich with sacred gifts.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Even as Vyatya did, may we with these most high and liberal hymns Pay worship unto Agni of the splendid flame.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Now sing, as Sthurayupa sang, with lands to him who spreadeth far, To Agni of the home, O Rsi, Vyasva's son.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As welcome guest of human kind, as offspring of the forest kings, The sages worship ancient Agni for his aid.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For men's oblations brought to him who is the mighty Lord of all, Sit, Agni, mid our homage, on the sacred grass.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Grant us abundant. treasures, grant the opulence which many crave, With store of heroes, progeny, and high renown.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni, Most Youthful of the Gods, send evermore the gift of wealth Unto Varosusaman and to all his folk.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: A mighty Conqueror art thou, O Agni, so disclose to us Food in our herds of kine and gain of ample wealth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou, Agni, art a glorious God: bring hither Mitra, Varuna, Imperial Sovrans, holy-minded, true to Law.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: COMPANIONS, let us learn a prayer to Indra, whom the thunder arms, To glorify your bold and most heroic Friend.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For thou by slaying Vrtra art the Vrtra-slayer, famed for might. Thou, Hero, in rich gifts surpassest wealthy chiefs.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As such, when glorified, bring us riches of very wondrous fame, Set in the highest rank, Wealth-giver, Lord of Bays!
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Yea, Indra, thou disclosest that preeminent dear wealth of men: Boldly, O Bold One, glorified, bring it to us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The workers of destruction stay neither thy right hand nor thy left: Nor hosts that press about thee, Lord of Bays, in fight.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Thunder-armed, I come with songs to thee as to a stall with kine: Fulfil the wish and thought of him who sings thy praise.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Chief Vrtra-slayer, through the hymn of Visvamanas think of all, All that concerneth us, Excellent, Mighty Guide.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May we, O Vrtra-slayer, O Hero, find this thy newest boon, Longed-for, and excellent, thou who art much invoked!
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indra, Dancer, Much-invoked! as thy great power is unsurpassed, So be thy bounty to the worshipper unchecked.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Most Mighty, most heroic One, for mighty bounty fill thee full. Though strong, strengthen thyself to win wealth, Maghavan!
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Thunderer, never have our prayers gone forth to any God but thee: So help us, Maghavan, with thine assistance now.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For, Dancer, verily I find none else for bounty, saving thee, For splendid wealth and power, thou Lover of the Song.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For Indra pour ye out the drops meath blent with Soma let him drink With bounty and with majesty will he further us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: I spake to the Bay Coursers' Lord, to him who gives ability: Now hear the son of Asva as he praises thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Never was any Hero born before thee mightier than thou: None certainly like thee in goodness and in wealth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O ministering priest, pour out of the sweet juice what gladdens most: So is the Hero praised who ever prospers us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra, whom Tawny Coursers bear, praise such as thine, preeminent, None by his power or by his goodness hath attained.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: We, seeking glory, have invoked this Master of all power and might Who must be glorified by constant sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come, sing we praise to Indra, friends, the Hero who deserves the laud, Him who with none to aid o'ercomes all tribes of men.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To him who wins the kine, who keeps no cattle back, Celestial God, Speak wondrous speech more sweet than butter and than meath.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Whose hero powers are measureless, whose bounty ne'er may be surpassed, Whose liberality, like light, is over all.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As Vyasva did, praise Indra, praise the Strong unfluctuating Guide, Who gives the foe's possessions to the worshipper.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Now, son of Vyasva, praise thou him who to the tenth time still is new, The very Wise, whom living men must glorify
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou knowest, Indra, Thunder-armed, how to avoid destructive powers, As one secure from pitfalls each returning day.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indra, bring that aid wherewith of old, Most Wondrous! thou didst slay His foes for active Kutsa: send it down to us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: So now we seek thee fresh in might, Most Wonderful in act! for gain: For thou art he who conquers all our foes for us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Who will set free from ruinous woe, or Arya on the Seven Streams: O valiant Hero, bend the Dasa's weapon down.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As to Varosusaman thou broughtest great riches, for their gain, To Vyasva's sons, Blest Lady, rich in ample wealth!
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Let Narya's sacrificial meed reach Vyasva's Soma-bearing sons: In hundreds and in thousands be the great reward.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: If one should ask thee, Where is he who sacrificed? Whither lookest thou? Like Vala he hath passed away and dwelleth now on Gomati.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: I WORSHIP you who guard this All, Gods, holiest among the Gods, You, faithful to the Law, whose power is sanctified.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: So, too, like charioteers are they, Mitra and sapient Varuna, Sons high-born from of old, whose holy laws stand fast.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: These Twain, possessors of all wealth, most glorious, for supremest sway Aditi, Mighty Mother, true to Law, brought forth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Great Varuna and Mitra, Gods, Asuras and imperial Lords, True to Eternal Law proclaim the high decree.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The offspring of a lofty Power, Daksa's Two Sons exceeding strong, Who, Lords of flowing rain, dwell in the place of food.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ye who have gathered up your gifts, celestial and terrestrial food, Let your rain come to us fraught with the mist of heaven.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Twain, who from the lofty sky seem to look down on herds below, Holy, imperial Lords, are set to be revered.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: They, true to Law, exceeding strong, have sat them down for Savran rule: Princes whose laws stand fast, they have obtained their sway.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Pathfinders even better than the eye, with unobstructed sight, Even when they close their lids, observant, they perceive.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: So may the Goddess Aditi, may the Nasatyas guard us well, The Maruts guard us well endowed with mighty strength.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Do ye, O Bounteous Gods, protect our dwelling lace by day and night: With you for our defenders may we go unharmed.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May we, unharmed, serve bountiful Visnu, the God who slayeth none: Self-moving Sindhu hear and be the first to mark.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: This sure protection we elect, desirable and reaching far, Which Mitra, Varuna, and Aryaman afford.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: And may the Sindhu of the floods, the Maruts, and the ASvin Pair, Boon Indra, and boon Visnu have one mind with us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Because these warring Heroes stay the enmity of every foe, As the fierce water-flood repels the furious ones.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Here this one God, the Lord of men, looks forth exceeding far and wide: And we, for your advantage, keep his holy laws.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: We keep the old accustomed laws, the statutes of supremacy, The Iong-known laws of Mitra and of Varuna.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He who hath measured with his ray the boundaries of heaven and earth, And with his majesty hath filled the two worlds full,
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Surya hath spread his light aloft up to the region of the sky, Like Agni all aflame when gifts are offered him.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With him who sits afar the word is lord of food that comes from kine, Controller of the gift of unempoisoned food.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: So unto Surya, Heaven, and Earth at morning and at eve I speak. Bringing enjoyments ever rise thou up for us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: From Uksanyayana a bay, from Harayana a white steed, And from Susaman we obtained a hamessed car.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: These two shall bring me further gain of troops of tawny-coloured steeds, The carriers shall they be of active men of war.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: And the two sages have I gained who hold the reins and bear the whip, And the two great strong coursers, with my newest song.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: I CALL your chariot to receive united praise mid princely men, Strong Gods who pour down wealth, of never vanquished might!
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ye to Varosusaman come, Nasatyas, for this glorious rite. With your protecting aid. Strong Gods, who pour down wealth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: So with oblations we invoke you, rich in ample wealth, to-day, When night hath passed, O ye who send us plenteous food.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Asvins, Heroes, let your car, famed, best to travel, come to us, And, for his glory, mark your zealous servant's lauds.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Asvins, who send us precious gifts, even when offended, think of him: For ye, O Rudras, lead us safe beyond our foes.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For, Wonder-Workers, with fleet steeds ye fly completely round this All, Stirring our thoughts, ye Lords of splendour, honey-hued.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With all-sustaining opulence, Asvins, come hitherward to us, Ye rich and noble Heroes, ne'er to be o'erthrown.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To welcome this mine offering, O ye Indra-like Nasatyas, come As Gods of best accord this day with other Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For we, like Vyasva, lifting up our voice like oxen, call on you: With all your loving kindness, Sages, come to us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Rsi, laud the Asvins well. Will they not listen to thy call? Will they not burn the Panis who are nearer them?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Heroes, listen to the son of Vyasva, and regard me here, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman, of one accord.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Gods whom we yearn for, of your gifts, of what ye bring to us, bestow By princes' hands on me, ye Mighty, day by day.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Him whom your sacrifices clothe, even as a woman with her robe, The Asvins help to glory honouring him well.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Whoso regards your care of men as succour widest in its reach, About his dwelling go, ye Asvins, loving us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come to us ye who pour down wealth, come to the home which men must guard: Like shafts, ye are made meet for sacrifice by song.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Most fetching of all calls, the laud, as envoy, Heroes, called to you Be it your own, O Asvin Pair.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Be ye in yonder sea of heaven, or joying in the home of food, Listen to me, Immortal Ones.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: This river with his lucid flow attracts you, more than all the streams,- Even Sindhu with his path of gold.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Asvins, with that glorious fame come hither, through our brilliant song, Come ye whose ways are marked with light.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Harness the steeds who draw the car, O Vasu, bring the well-fed pair. O Vayu, drink thou of our meath: come unto our drink-offerings.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Wonderful Vayu, Lord of Right, thou who art Tvastar's son-in-law, Thy saving succour we elect.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To Tvastar's son-in-law we pray for wealth whereof he hath control: For glory we seek vayu, men with juice effused.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: From heaven, auspicious Vayu, come drive hither with thy noble steeds: Come on thy mighty car with wide-extending seat.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: We call thee to the homes of men, thee wealthiest in noble food, And liberal as a press-stone with a horse's back.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: So, glad and joyful in thine heart, do thou, God, Vayu, first of all Vouchsafe us water, strength, and thought.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: CHEIF Priest is Agni at the laud, as stones and grass at sacrifice: With song I seek the Maruts, Brahmanaspati, Gods for help much to be desired.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: I sing to cattle and to Earth, to trees, to Dawns, to Night, to plants. O all ye Vasus, ye possessors of all wealth, be ye the furtherers of our thoughts.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Forth go, with Agni, to the Gods our sacrifice of ancient use, To the Adityas, Varuna whose Law stands fast, and the all-lightening Marut troop.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Lords of all wealth, may they be strengtheners of man, destroyers of his enemies. Lords of all wealth, do ye, with guards which none may harm, preserve our dwelling free from foes.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come to us with one mind to-day, come to us all with one accord, Maruts with holy song, and, Goddess Aditi, Mighty One, to our house and home.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Send us delightful things, ye Maruts, on your steeds: come ye, O Mitra, to our gifts. Let Indra, Varuna, and the Adityas sit, swift Heroes, on our sacred grass.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: We who have trimmed the grass for you, and set the banquet in array, And pressed the Soma, call you, Varuina, like men, with sacrificial fires aflame.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Maruts, Visinu, Asvins, Pusan, haste away with minds turned hitherward to Me. Let the Strong Indra, famed as Vrtra's slayer, come first with the winners of the spoil.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ye Guileless Gods, bestow on us a refuge strong on every side, A sure protection, Vasus, unassailable from near at hand or from afar.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Kinship have I with you, and close alliance O ye Gods, destroyers of our foes. Call us to our prosperity of former days, and soon to new felicity.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For now have I sent forth to you, that I may win a fair reward, Lords of all wealth, with homage, this my song of praise. like a milch-cow that faileth not.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Excellent Savitar hath mounted up on high for you, ye sure and careful Guides. Bipeds and quadrupeds, with several hopes and aims, and birds have settled to their tasks.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Singing their praise with God-like thought let us invoke each God for grace, Each God to bring you help, each God to strengthen you.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For of one spirit are the Gods with mortal man, co-sharers all of gracious gifts. May they increase our strength hereafter and to-day, providing case and ample room.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: I laud you, O ye Guileless Gods, here where we meet to render praise. None, Varuna and Mitra, harms the mortal, man who honours and obeys your laws.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He makes his house endure, he gathers plenteous food who pays obedience to your will. Born in his sons anew he spreads as Law commands, and prospers every way unharmed.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: E'en without war he gathers wealth, and goes his way on pleasant paths, Whom Mitra, Varuna and Aryaman protect, sharing the gift of one accord.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: E'en on the plain for him ye make a sloping path, an easy way where road is none: And far away from him the ineffectual shaft must vanish, shot at him in vain.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: If ye appoint the rite to-day, kind Rulers, when the Sun ascends, Lords of all wealth, at sunset or at waking time, or be it at the noon of day,
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Or, Asuras, when ye have sheltered the worshipper who goes to sacrifice, at eve may we, O Vasus, ye possessors of all wealth, come then into the midst of You.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: If ye to-day at sunrise, or at noon, or in the gloom of eve, Lords of all riches, give fair treasure to the man, the wise man who hath sacrificed,
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Then we, imperial Rulers, claim of you this boon, your wide protection, as a son. May we, Adityas, offering holy gifts, obtain that which shall bring us greater bliss.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: THE Thirty Gods and Three besides, whose seat hath been the sacred grass, From time of old have found and gained.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman, Agnis, with Consorts, sending boons, To whom our Vasat! is addressed:
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: These are our guardians in the west, and northward here, and in the south, And on the cast, with all the tribe.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Even as the Gods desire so verily shall it be. None diminisheth this power of theirs, No demon, and no mortal
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Seven carry seven spears; seven are the splendours they possess, And seven the glories they assume.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: ONE is a youth brown, active, manifold he decks the golden one with ornament.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Another, luminous, occupies the place of sacrifice, Sage, among the Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: One brandishes in his hand an iron knife, firm, in his seat amid the Deities.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Another holds the thunderbolt, wherewith he slays the Vrtras, resting in his hand.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Another bears a pointed weapon: bright is he, and strong, with healing medicines.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Another, thief-like, watches well the ways, and knows the places where the treasures lie.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Another with his mighty stride hath made his three steps thither where the Gods rejoice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Two with one Dame ride on with winged steeds, and journey forth like travellers on their way.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Two, highest, in the heavens have set their seat, worshipped with holy oil, imperial Kings.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Some, singing lauds, conceived the Sama-hymn, great hymn whereby they caused the Sun to shine.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: NOT one of you, ye Gods, is small, none of you is a feeble child: All of you, verily, are great.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thus be ye lauded, ye destroyers of the foe, ye Three-and-Thirty Deities, The Gods of man, the Holy Ones.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As such defend and succour us, with benedictions speak to us: Lead us not from our fathers' and from Manu's path into the distance far away.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ye Deities who stay with us, and all ye Gods of all mankind, Give us your wide protection, give shelter for cattle and for steed.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: THAT Brahman pleases Indra well, who worships, sacrifices, pours Libation, and prepares the meal.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Sakra protects from woe the man who gives him sacrificial cake. And offers Soma blent with milk.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: His chariot shall be glorious, sped by Gods, and mighty shall he be, Subduing all hostilities.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Each day that passes, in his house flows his libation, rich in milk, Exhaustless, bringing progeny.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Gods, with constant draught of milk, husband and wife with one accord Press out and wash the Soma juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: They gain sufficient food: they come united to the sacred grass, And never do they fail in strength.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Never do they deny or seek to hide the favour of the Gods: They win high glory for themselves.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With sons and daughters by their side they reach their full extent of life, Both decked with ornaments of gold.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Serving the Immortal One with gifts of sacrificial meal and wealth, They satisfy the claims of love and pay due honour to the Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: We claim protection from the Hills, we claim protection of the Floods, Of him who stands by Visnu's side.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May Pusan come, and Bhaga, Lord of wealth, All-bounteous, for our weal Broad be the path that leads to bliss:
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Aramati, and, free from foes, Visva with spirit of a God, And the Adityas' peerless might.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Seeing that Mitra, Aryaman, and Varuna are guarding us, The paths of Law are fair to tread.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: I glorify with song, for wealth, Agni the God, the first of you. We honour as a well-loved Friend the God who prospereth our fields.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As in all frays the hero, so swift moves his car whom Gods attend. The man who, sacrificing, strives to win the heart of Deities will conquer those who worship not.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ne'er are ye injured, worshipper, presser of juice, or pious man. The man who, sacrificing, strives to win the heart of Deities will conquer those who worship not.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: None in his action equals him, none holds him far or keeps him off. The man who, sacrificing, strives to win the heart of Deities will conquer those who worship not.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Such strength of heroes shall be his, such mastery of fleet-foot steeds. The man who, sacrificing, strives to win the heart of Deities will conquer those who worship not.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: KANVAS, tell forth with song the deeds of Indra, the Impetuous, Wrought in the Soma's wild delight.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Strong God, he slew Anarsani, Srbinda, Pipru, and the fiend, Ahisuva, and loosed the floods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou broughtest down the dwelling-place, the height of lofty Arbuda. That exploit, Indra, must be famed.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Bold, to your famous Soma I call the fair-visored God for aid, Down like a torrent from the hill.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Rejoicing in the Soma-draughts, Hero, burst open, like a fort, The stall of horses and of kine.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: If my libation gladdens, if thou takest pleasure in my laud, Come with thy Godhead from afar.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indra, Lover of the Song, the singers of thy praise are we: O Soma-drinker, quicken us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: And, taking thy delight with us bring us still undiminished food: Great is thy wealth, O Maghavan.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Make thou us rich in herds of kine, in steeds, in gold: let us exert Our strength in sacrificial gifts.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Let us call him to aid whose hands stretch far, to whom high laud is due. Who worketh well to succour us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He, Satakratu, even in fight acts as a Vrtra-slayer still: He gives his worshippers much wealth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May he, this Aakra, strengthen us, Boon God who satisfies our needs, Indra, with all his saving helps.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To him, the mighty stream of wealth, the Soma-presser's rescuing Friend, To Indra sing your song of praise;
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Who bringeth what is great and firm, who winneth glory in his wars, Lord of vast wealth through power and might.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: There liveth none to cheek or stay his energies and gracious deeds: None who can say, He giveth not.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: No debt is due by Brahmans now, by active men who press the juice: Well hath each Soma-draught been paid.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Sing ye to him who must be praised, say lauds to him who must be praised, Bring prayer to him who must be praised.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May be, unchecked, strong, meet for praise, bring hundreds, thousands forth to light, Indra who aids the worshipper.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Go with thy God-like nature forth, go where the folk are calling thee: Drink, Indra, of the drops we pour.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Drink milky draughts which are thine own, this too which was with Tugrya once, This is it, Indra, that is thine.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Pass him who pours libations out in angry mood or after sin: Here drink the juice we offer thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Over the three great distances, past the Five Peoples go thy way, O Indra, noticing our voice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Send forth thy ray like Surya: let my songs attract thee hitherward, Like waters gathering to the vale.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Now to the Hero fair of cheek, Adhvaryu, pour the Soma forth: Bring of the juice that he may drink
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Who cleft the water-cloud in twain, loosed rivers for their downward flow, And set the ripe milk in the kine.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He, meet for praise, slew Vrtra, slew Ahisuva, Urnavabha's son, And pierced through Arbuda with frost.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To him your matchless Mighty One, unconquerable Conqueror, Sing forth the prayer which Gods have given:
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra, who in the wild delight of Soma juice considers here All holy Laws among the Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Hither let these thy Bays who share thy banquet, Steeds with golden manes, Convey thee to the feast prepared.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Hither, O thou whom many laud, the Bays whom Priyamedha praised, Shall bring thee to the Soma-draught.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: WE compass thee like waters, we whose grass is trimmed and Soma pressed. Here where the filter pours its stream, thy worshippers round thee, O Vrtra-slayer, sit.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Men, Vasu! by the Soma, with lauds call thee to the foremost place: When comest thou athirst unto the juice as home, O Indra, like a bellowing bull?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Boldly, Bold Hero, bring us spoil in thousands for the Kanvas' sake. O active Maghavan, with eager prayer we crave the yellow-hued with store ol kine.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Medhyatithi, to Indra sing, drink of the juice to make thee glad. Close-knit to his Bay Steeds, bolt-armed, beside the juice is he: his chariot is of gold.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He Who is praised as strong of hand both right and left, most wise and hold: Indra who, rich in hundreds, gathers thousands up, honoured as breaker-down of forts.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The bold of heart whom none provokes, who stands in bearded confidence; Much-lauded, very glorious, overthrowing foes, strong Helper, like a bull with might.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Who knows what vital power he wins, drinking beside the flowing juice? This is the fair-checked God who, joying in the draught, breaks down the castles in his strength.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As a wild elephant rushes on this way and that way, mad with heat,' None may compel thee, yet come hither to the draught: thou movest mighty in thy power.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When he, the Mighty, ne'er o'erthrown, steadfast, made ready for the fight, When Indra Maghavan lists to his praiser's call, he will not stand aloof, but come.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Yea, verily, thou art a Bull, with a bull's rush. whom none may stay: Thou Mighty One, art celebrated as a Bull, famed as a Bull both near and far.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thy reins are very bulls in strength, bulls' strength is in thy golden whip. Thy car, O Maghavan, thy Bays are strong as bulls: thou, Satakratu, art a Bull.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Let the strong presser press for thee. Bring hither, thou straight-rushing Bull. The mighty makes the mighty run in flowing streams for thee whom thy Bay Horses bear.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come, thou most potent Indra, come to drink the savoury Soma juice. Maghavan, very wise, will quickly come to hear the songs, the prayer, the hymns of praise.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When thou hast mounted on thy car let thy yoked Bay Steeds carry thee, Past other men's libations, Lord of Hundred Powers, thee, Vrtra-slayer, thee our Friend.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O thou Most Lofty One, accept our laud as nearest to thine heart. May our libations be most sweet to make thee glad, O Soma-drinker, Heavenly Lord.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Neither in thy decree nor mine, but in another's he delights,- The man who brought us unto this.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra himself hath said, The mind of woman brooks not discipline, Her intellect hath little weight.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: His pair of horses, rushing on in their wild transport, draw his car: High-lifted is the stallion's yoke.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Cast down thine eyes and look not up. More closely set thy feet. Let none See what thy garment veils, for thou, a Brahman, hast become a dame.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come hither, Indra, with thy Bays, come thou to Kanva's eulogy. Ye by command of yonder Dyaus, God bright by day! have gone to heaven.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May the stone draw thee as it speaks, the Soma-stone with ringing voice. Ye by command of yonder Dyaus, God bright by day! have gone to heaven.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The stones' rim shakes the Soma here like a wolf worrying a sheep. Ye by command of yonder Dyaus, God bright by day! have gone to heaven.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Kanvas call thee hitherward for succour and to win the spoil. Ye by command of yonder Dyaus, God bright by day! have gone to heaven.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: I set for thee, as for the Strong, the first draught of the juices shed.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come with abundant blessings, come with perfect care to succour us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come, Lord of lofty thought, who hast infinite wealth and countless aids.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Adorable mid Gods, the Priest good to mankind shall bring thee near.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As wings the falcon, so thy Bays rushing in joy shall carry thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come from the enemy to us, to svaha and the Soma-draught.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come hither with thine car inclined to hear, take pleasure in our lauds.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Lord of well-nourished Horses, come with well-fed Steeds alike in hue.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come hither from the mountains, come from regions of the sea of air.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Disclose to us O Hero, wealth in thousands both of kine and steeds.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Bring riches hitherward to us in hundreds, thousands, myriads. Ye by command of yonder Dyaus, God bright by day! have gone to heaven.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The thousand steeds, the mightiest troop, which we and Indra have received From Vasurocis as a gift,
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The brown that match the wind in speed, and bright bay coursers fleet of foot, Like Suns, resplendent are they all.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Mid the Pargvata's rich gifts, swift steeds whose wheels run rapidly, I seemed to stand amid a wood.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: WITH Agni and with Indra, Visnu, Varuna, with the Adityas, Rudras, Vasus, closely leagued; Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, O Asvins, drink the Soma juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With all the Holy Thoughts, all being Mighty Ones! in close alliance wil the Mountains, Heaven, and Earth; Accordant. of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, O Asvins, drink the Soma juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With all the Deities, three times eleven, here, in close alliance with the Maruts, Bhrgus, Floods; Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, O Asvins, drink the Soma juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Accept the sacrifice, attend to this my call: come nigh, O ye Twain Gods, to all libations here. Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, O Asvins, bring us strengthening food.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Accept our praise-song as a youth accepts a maid. Come nigh, O ye Twain Gods, to all libations here. Accordant, of one mind with Sarya and with Dawn O Asvins, bring us strengthening food.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Accept the songs we sing, accept the solemn rite. Conie nigh, O ye Twain Gods, to all libations here. Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, O Asvins, bring us strengthening food.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ye fly as starlings fly unto the forest trees; like buffaloes ye seek the Soma we have shed. Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, come thrice, O Asvins, to our home.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ye fly like swans, like those who travel on their way; like buffaloes ye seek the Soma we have shed. Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, come thrice, O Asvins, to our home.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ye fly to our oblation like a pair of hawks; like buffaloes ye seek the Soma we have shed. Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, come thrice, O Asvins, to our home.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come hitherward and drink and satisfy yourselves, bestow upon us progeny and affluence. Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, O Asvins, grant us vigorous strength.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Conquer your foes, protect us, praise your worshippers; bestow upon us progeny and affluence. Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, O Asvins, grant us vigorous strength.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Slay enemies, animate men whom ye befriend; bestow upon us progeny and affluence. Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, O Asvins, grant us vigorous strength.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With Mitra, Varuna, Dharma, and the Maruts in your company approach unto your praiser's call. Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, and with the Adityas, Asvins! come.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With Visnu and the Angirases attending you, and with the Maruts come unto your praiser's call. Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, and with the Adityas, Asvins! come.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With Rbhus and With Vajas. O ye Mighty Ones, leagued with the Maruts come ye to your praiser's call. Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, and with the Adityas, Asvins! come.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Give spirit to our prayer and animate our thoughts; slay ye the Raksasas and drive away disease. Accordant, of One mind with Surya and with Dawn, -the presser's Soma, Asvins drink.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Strengthen the Ruling Power, strengthen the men of war; slay ye the Raksasas and drive away disease. Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, the presser's Soma, Asvins drink.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Give strength unto the milch-kine, give the people strength, slay ye the Raksasas and drive away disease. Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, the presser's Soma, Asvins drink.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As ye heard Atri's earliest eulogy, so hear Syavasva, Soma-presser, ye who reel in joy. Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, drink juice, O Asvins, three days old.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Further like running streams Syavasva's eulogies who presses out the Soma, ye who reel in joy. Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, drink juice, O Asvins, three days old.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Seize, as ye grasp the reins, Syavasva's solemn rites who presses out the Soma, ye who reel in joy. Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, drink juice, O Asvins, three days old.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Drive down your chariot hitherward drink ye the Soma's savoury juice. Approach, ye Asvins, come to us: I call you, eager for your aid. Grant treasures to the worshipper.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When sacrifice which tells our reverence hath begun. Heroes! to drink the gushing juice, Approach, ye Asvins, come to us: I call you, eager for your aid. Grant treasures to the worshipper.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Sate you with consecrated drink, with juice effused, ye Deities. Approach, ye Asvins, come to us: I call you, eager for your aid. Grant treasures to the worshipper.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: THOU helpest him whose grass is trimmed, who sheds the juice, O Satakratu, drink Soma to make thee glad. The share which they have fixed for thee, thou, Indra, Victor o'er all hosts and space, begirt with Maruts, Lord of Heroes, winner of the floods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Maghavan, help thy worshipper: let him help thee. O Satakratu, drink Soma to make thee glad. The share which they have fixed for thee, etc.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou aidest Gods with food, and that with might aidg thee, O Satakratu, drink Soma to make thee glad.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Creator of the heaven, creator of the earth, O Satakratu, drink Soma to make thee glad.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Father of cattle, father of all steeds art thou. O Satakratu, drink Soma to make thee glad.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Stone-hurler, glorify the Atris' hymn of praise. O Satakratu, drink Soma to make thee glad.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Hear thou Syavagva while he pours to thee, as erst thou heardest Atri when he wrought his holy rites. Indra, thou only gavest Trasadasyu aid in the fierce fight with heroes, strengthening his prayers.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: THIS prayer, and those who shed the juice, in wars with Vrtra thou holpest, Indra, Lord of Strength, with all thy succours. O Vrtra-slayer, from libation poured at noon, drink of the Soma juice, thou blameless Thunderer.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou mighty Conqueror of hostile armaments, O Indra, Lord of Strength, with all thy saving help.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Sole Ruler, thou art Sovran of this world of life, O Indra, Lord of Strength, with all thy saving help.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou only sunderest these two consistent worlds, O Indra, Lord of Strength, with all thy saving help.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou art the Lord supreme o'er rest and energy, O Indra, Lord of Strength, with all thy saving help.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou helpest one to power, and one thou hast not helped, O Indra, Lord of Strength, with all thy saving aid.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Hear thou Syavasva while he sings to thee, as erst thou heardest Atri when he wrought his holy rites. Indra, thou only gavest Trasadasyu aid in the fierce fight with heroes, strengthening his powers.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: YE Twain are Priests of sacrifice, winners in war and holy works: Indra and Agni, mark this well.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ye bounteous riders on the car, ye Vrtra-slayers unsubdued: Indra and Agni, mark this well.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The men with pressing-stones have pressed this meath of yours which gives delight: Indra, and Agni, mark this well.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Accept our sacrifice for weal, sharers of praise! the Soma shed: Indra and Agni, Heroes, come.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Be pleased with these libations which attract you to our sacred gifts Indra and Agni, Heroes, come.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Accept this eulogy of mine whose model is the Gayatri: Indra and Agni, Heroes, Come.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come with the early-faring Gods, ye who are Lords of genuine wealth: Indra-Agni, to the Soma-draught
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Hear ye the call of Atris, hear Syavasva as he sheds the juice: Indra-Agni to the Soma-draught
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thus have I called you to our aid as sages called on you of old: Indra-Agni to the Soma draught!
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra's and Agni's grace I claim, Sarasvati's associates To whom this psalm of praise is sung.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: THE glorious Agni have I praised, and worshipped with. the sacred food. May Agni deck the Gods for us. Between both gathering-places he goes on his embassy, the Sage. May all the others die away.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni, burn down the word within their bodies through our newest speech, All hatreds of the godless, all the wicked man's malignities. Away let the destroyers go. May all the others die away.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni, I offer hymns to thee, like holy oil within thy mouth. Acknowledge them. among the Gods, for thou art the most excellent, the worshipper's blissful messenger. Let all the others die away.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni bestows all vital power even as each man supplicates. He brings the Vasus strengthening gifts, and grants delight, in rest and stir, for every calling on the Gods. Let all the others die away.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni hath made himself renowned by wonderful victorious act. He is the Priest of all the tribes, chosen with sacrificial meads. He urges Deities to receive. Let all the others die away.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni knows all that springs from Gods, he knows the mystery of men. Giver of wealth is Agni, he uncloses both the doors to us when worshipped with our newest gift. Let all the others die away.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni inhabiteth with Gods and men who offer sacrifice. He cherisheth with great delight much wisdom, as all things that be, God among Gods adorable. May all the others die away.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary
