verses.translation: Agni who liveth in all streams, Lord of the Sevenfold Race of men, Him dweller in three homes we seek, best slayer of the Dasytis for Mandhatar, first in sacrifice. Let all the others die away.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni the Wise inhabiteth three gathering-places, triply formed. Decked as our envoy let the Sage bring hither and conciliate the Thrice Eleven Deities. Let all the others die away.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Our Agni, thou art first among the Gods, and first mid living men. Thou only rulest over wealth. Round about thee, as natural dams, circumfluous the waters run. Let all the others die away.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: INDRA and Agni, surely ye as Conquerors will give us wealth, Whereby in fight we may o'ercome that which is strong and firmly fixed, as Agni burns the woods with wind. Let all the others die away.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: We set no snares to tangle you; Indra we worship and adore, Hero of heroes mightiest. Once may he come unto us with his Steed, come unto us to win us strength, and to complete the sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For, famous Indra-Agni, ye are dwellers in the midst of frays. Sages in wisdom, ye are knit to him who seeketh you as friends. Heroes, bestow on him his wish.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Nabhaka-like, with sacred song Indra's and Agni's praise I sing, Theirs to whom all this world belongs, this heaven and this mighty earth which bear rich treasure in their lap.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To Indra and to Agni send your prayers, as was Nabhaka's wont,- Who open with sideway opening the sea with its foundations seven-Indra all powerful in his might.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Tear thou asunder, as of old, like tangles of a creeping plant, Demolish thou the Dasa's might. May we with Indra's help divide the treasure he hath gathered up.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: What time with this same song these men call Indra-Agni sundry ways, May we with our own heroes quell those who provoke us to the fight, and conquer those who strive with us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Two refulgent with their beams rise and come downward from the sky. By Indra's and by Agni's behest, flowing away, the rivers, run which they released from their restraint.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indra, many are thine aids, many thy ways of guiding us, Lord of the Bay Steeds, Hinva's Son. To a Good Hero come our prayers, which soon shall have accomplishment.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Inspire him with your holy hymns, the Hero bright and glorious, Him who with might demolisheth even the brood of Susna, and winneth for us the heavenly streams.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Inspire him worshipped with fair rites, the glorious Hero truly brave. He brake in pieces Susna's brood who still expected not the stroke, and won for us the heavenly streams. Let all the others die away.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thus have we sung anew to Indra-Agni, as sang our sires, Angirases, and Mandhatar. Guard us with triple shelter and preserve us: may we be masters of a store of riches.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To make this Varuna come forth sing thou a song unto the band of Maruts wiser than thyself,- This Varuna who guardeth well the thoughts of men like herds of kine. Let all the others die away.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Him altogether praise I with the song and hymns our fathers sang, and with Nabhaka's eulogies,- Him dwelling at the rivers' source, surrounded by his Sisters Seven.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The nights he hath encompassed, and stablished the morns with magic art visible over all is he. His dear Ones, following his Law, have prospered the Three Dawns for him.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He, visible o'er all the earth, stablished the quarters of the sky: He measured out the eastern place, that is the fold of Varuna: like a strong herdsman is the God.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He who supports the worlds of life, he who well knows the hidden names mysterious of the morning beams, He cherishes much wisdom, Sage, as heaven brings forth each varied form.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: In whom all wisdom centres, as the nave is set within the wheel. Haste ye to honour Trita, as kine haste to gather in the fold, even as they muster steeds to yoke.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He wraps these regions as a robe; he contemplates the tribes of Gods and all the works of mortal men. Before the home of Varuna all the Gods follow his decree.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He is an Ocean far-removed, yet through the heaven to him ascends the worship which these realms possess. With his bright foot he overthrew their magic, and went up to heaven.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ruler, whose bright far-seeing rays, pervading all three earths, have filled the three superior realms of heaven. Firm is the seat of Varuna: over the Seven he rules as King.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Who, after his decree, o'erspread the Dark Ones with a robe of light; Who measured out the ancient seat, who pillared both the worlds apart as the Unborn supported heaven. Let all the others die away.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: LORD of all wealth, the Asura propped the heavens, and measured out the broad earth's wide expanses. He, King supreme, approached all living creatures. All these are Varuna's holy operations.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: So humbly worship Varuna the Mighty revere the wise Guard of World Immortal. May he vouchsafe us triply-barred protection. O Earth and Heaven, within your lap preserve us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Sharpen this song of him who strives his utmost, sharpen, God Varuna, his strength and insight; May we ascend the ship that bears us safely, whereby we may pass over all misfortune.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Asvins, with songs the singer stones have made you hasten hitherward, Nasatyas, to the Soma-draught. Let all the others die away.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As the sage Atri with his hymns, O Asvins, called you eagerly, Nasatyas, to the Soma-draught. Let all the others die away.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: So have I called you to our aid, even as the wise have called of old, Nasatyas, to the Soma-draught. Let all the others die away.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: THESE songs of mine go forth as lauds of Agni, the disposing Sage, Whose worshipper is ne'er o'erthrawn.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Wise Agni Jatavedas, I beget a song of praise for thee. Who willingly receivest it.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thy sharpened flames, O Agni, like the gleams of light that glitter through, Devour the forests with their teeth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Gold-coloured, bannered with the smoke, urged by the wind, aloft to heaven Rise, lightly borne, the flames of fire.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: These lightly kindled fiery flames are all around made visible, Even as the gleamings of the Dawns.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As Jatavedas speeds along, the dust is black beneath his feet, When Agni spreads upon the earth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Making the plants his nourishment, Agni devours and wearies not, Seeking the tender shrubs again.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Bending him down with all his tongues, he flickers with his fiery glow Splendid is Agni in the woods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni, thine home is in the floods: into the plants thou forcest way, And as their Child art born anew.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Worshipped with offerings shines thy flame, O Agni, from the sacred oil, With kisses on the ladle's mouth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Let us serve Agni with our hymns, Disposer, fed on ox and cow, Who bears the Soma on his back.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Yea, thee, O Agni, do we seek with homage and with fuel, Priest Whose wisdom is most excellent.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O worshipped with oblations, pure Agni, we call on thee as erst, Did Bhrgu, Manus, Angiras.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For thou, O Agni, by the fire, Sage by the Sage, Good by the Good, Friend by the Friend, art lighted up.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: So wealth in thousands, food with store of heroes give thou to the sage, O Agni, to the worshipper.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Agni, Brother, made by strength, Lord of red steeds and brilliant sway, Take pleasure in this laud of mine.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: My praises, Agni, go to thee, as the cows seek the stall to meet, The lowing calf that longs for milk.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni, best Angiras, to thee all people who have pleasant homes, Apart, have turned as to their wish.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The sages skilled in holy song and thin. kers with their thoughts have urged Agni to share the sacred feast.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: So, Agni, unto thee the Priest, Invoker, strong in forays, pray 'nose who spin out the sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: In many a place, the same in look art thou, a Prince o'er all the tribes In battles we invoke thine aid.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Pray thou to Agni, pray to him who blazes served with sacred oil: Let him give ear to this our call.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: We call on thee as such, as one who hears, as Jatavedas, one, Agni! who beats away our foes.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: I pray to Agni, King of men, the Wonderful, the President Of holy Laws: may he give ear.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Him like a bridegroom, him who stirs all people, like a noble horse, Like a fleet steed, we instigate.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Slaying things deadly, burning up foes, Riksasas, on every side, Shine, Agni, with thy sharpened flame.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou whom the people kindle even as Manus did, best Angiras! O Agni, mark thou this my speech.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Agni, made by strength! be thou born in the heavens or born in floods, As such we call on thee with songs.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Yea, all the people, all the folk who have good dwellings, each apart, Send food for thee to eat thereof.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Agni, so may we, devout, gazed at by men, throughout our days, Pass lightly over all distress.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: We venerate with cheerful hearts the cheerful Agni, dear to all, Burning, with purifying flame.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: So thou, O Agni rich in light, beaming like Surya with thy rays Boldly demolishest the gloom,
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: We pray to thee for this thy gift, Victor the gift that faileth not, O Agni, choicest wealth from thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: PAY service unto Agni with your fuel, rouse your Guest with oil: In him present your offerings.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni, do thou accept my laud, be magnified by this my song: Welcome my sweetly-spoken words.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni, envoy, I place in front; the oblation-bearer I address: Here let him seat the Deities.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni, the lofty flames of' thee enkindled have gone up on high, Thy bright flames, thou Refulgent One.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Beloved! let my ladles full of sacred oil come near to thee: Agni, accept our offerings.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: I worship Agni-may he hear!-the cheerful, the Invoker, Priest, Of varied splendour, rich in light.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ancient Invoker, meet for praise, beloved Agni, wise and strong, The visitant of solemn rites.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni, best Angiras, accept straightway these offerings, and guide The seasonable sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Excellent God, with brilliant flames, enkindled bring thou hitherward, Knowing the way, the Heavenly Host.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Him, Sage and Herald, void of guile, ensign of sacrifices, him Smoke-bannered, rich in light, we seek.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Agni, be our Guardian thou, God, against those who injure us: Destroy our foes, thou Son of Strength.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Making his body beautiful, Agni the Sage hath waxen by The singer and his ancient hymn.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: I invocate the Child of Strength, Agni with purifying flame, At this well-ordered sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: So Agni, rich in many friends, with fiery splendour, seat thyself With Gods upon our sacred grass.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The mortal man who serves the God Agni within his own abode, For him he causes wealth to shine.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni is head and height of heaven, the Master of the earth is he: He quickeneth the watere seed.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Upward, O Agni, rise thy flames, pure and resplendent, blazing high, Thy lustres, fair effulgences.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For, Agni, thou as Lord of Light rulest o'er choicest gifts: may I, Thy singer, find defense in thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Agni, they who understand stir thee to action with their thoughts: So let our songs enhance thy might.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: We ever claim the friendship of Agni, the singing messenger, Of God-like nature, void of guile.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni who bears most holy sway, the holy Singer, holy Sage, Shines holy when we worship him.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Yea, let my meditations, let my songs exalt thee evermore. Think, Agni, of our friendly bond,
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: If I were thou and thou wert I, O Agni, every prayer of thine Should have its due fulfilment here.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For Excellent and Lord of wealth. art thou O Agni, rich in light: May we enjoy thy favouring grace.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni, to thee whose laws stand fast our resonant songs of praise speed forth, As rivers hasten to the sea.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni, the Youthful Lord of men, who stirreth much and eateth all, The Sage, I glorify with hymns.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To Agni let us haste with lauds, the Guide of sacrificial rites, Armed with sharp teeth, the Mighty One.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: And let this man, good Agni, be with thee the singer of thy praise: Be gracious, Holy One, to him.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For thou art sharer of our feast, wise, ever watchful as a Sage: Agni, thou shinest in the sky.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Agni, Sage, before our foes, before misfortunes fall on us, Excellent Lord, prolong our lives.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: HITHERWARD! they who light flame and straightway trim the sacred grass. Whose Friend is Indra ever young.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: High is their fuel, great their laud, wide is their splinter from the stake, Whose Friend is Indra ever young.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Unequalled in fight the hero leads his army with the warrior chiefs. Whose Friend is Indra ever young.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The new-born Vrtra-slayer asked his Mother, as he seized his shaft, Who are the fierce? Who are renowned?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Savasi answered, He who seeks thine enmity will battle like A stately elephant on a hill.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: And hear, O Maghavan; to him who craves of thee thou grantest all Whate'er thou makest firm is firm.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: What time the Warrior Indra goes to battle, borne by noble steeds, Best of all charioteers is he.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Repel, O Thunder-armed, in all directions all attacks on us: And be our own most glorious God.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May Indra set our car in front, in foremost Place to win the spoil, He whom the wicked injure not.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thine enmity may we escape, and, Gakra, for thy bounty, rich In kine, may we come near to thee
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Softly approaching, Thunder-armed wealthy by hundreds, rich in steeds, Unrivalled, ready with our gifts.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For thine exalted excellence gives to thy worshippers each day Hundreds and thousands of thy boons.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra, we know thee breaker-down even of strong forts, winner of spoil, A:one who conquers wealth for us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Though thou art highest, Sage and Bold let the drops cheer thee when we come To thee as to a trafficker.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Bring unto us the treasure of the opulent man who, loth to give, Hath slighted thee for gain of wealth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra, these friends of ours, supplied with Soma, wait and look to thee, As men with fodder to the herd.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: And thee who art not deaf, whose cars are quick to listen, for our aid, We call to us from far away.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When thou hast listened, make our call one which thou never wilt forget, And be our very nearest Friend.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When even now, when we have been in trouble, we have thought of thee, O Indra, give us gifts of kine.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Lord of Strength, we rest on thee, as old men rest upon a staff: We long to have. thee dwell with us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To Indra sing a song of praise, Hero of mighty valour, him Whom no one challenges to war.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Hero, the Soma being shed, I pour the juice for thee to drink: Sate thee and finish thy carouse.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Let not the fools, or those who mock beguile thee when they seek thine aid Love not the enemies of prayer.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Here let them with rich milky draught cheer thee to great munificence: Drink as the wild-bull drinks the lake.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Proclaim in our assemblies what deeds, new and ancient, far away, The Vrtra-slayer hath achieved.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: In battle of a thousand arms Indra drank Kadru's Soma juice: There he displayed his manly might.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: True undeniable strength he found in Yadu and in Turvasa, And conquered through the sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Him have I magnified, our Lord in, common, Guardian of your folk, Discloser of great wealth in kine;
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Rbhuksan, not to be restrained, who strengthened Tugra's son in lauds, Indra beside the flowing juice;
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Who for Trisoka clave the hill that formed a wide receptacle, So that the cows might issue forth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Whate'er thy plan or purpose be, whate'er, in transport, thou wouldst do, Do it not, Indra, but be kind.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: But little hath been heard of done upon the earth by one like thee i Let thine heart, Indra, turn to us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thine then shall be this high renown, thine shall these lofty praises be, When, Indra, thou art kind to us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Not for one trespass, not for two, O Hero, slay us, nor for three, Nor yet for many trespasses.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: I fear one powerful like thee, the crusher down of enemies, Mighty, repelling all attacks.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O wealthy God, ne'er may I live to see my friend or son in need*: Hitherward let thy heart be turned.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: What friend, O people, unprovoked, hath ever said unto a friend, He turns and leaves us in distress?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Hero, insatiate enjoy this Soma juice so near to thee, Even as a hunter rushing down.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Hither I draw those Bays of thine yoked by our hymn, with splendid car, That thou mayst give unto the priests.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Drive all our enemies away, smite down the foes who press around, And bring the wealth for which we long:
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indra, that which is concealed in strong firm place precipitous: Bring us the wealth for which we long
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Great riches which the world of men shall recognize as sent by thou: Bring us the wealth for which we long.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: WE, Indra, Lord of ample wealth, our Guide, depend on one like thee, Thou driver of the Tawny Steeds.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For, Hurler of the Bolt, we know thee true, the giver of our food, We know the giver of our wealth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O thou whose majesty the bards celebrate with their songs, thou Lord, Of hundred powers and hundred aids.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Fair guidance hath the mortal man whom Aryaman, the Marut host, And Mitra, void of guile, protect.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Kine, steeds, and hero strength he gains, and prospers, by the Adityas sped, Ever in wealth which all desire.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: We pray to Indra for his gift, to him the Fearless and the Strong, We pray to him the Lord of wealth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For verily combined in him are all the fearless powers of aid. Him, rich in wealth, let swift Steeds bring to us, his Bays, to Soma juice for his carouse:
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Yea, that most excellent carouse, Indra, which slays most enemies, With Heroes wins the light of heaven, and is invincible in war:
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Which merits fame, all-bountiful! and, unsubdued, hath victory in deeds of might. So come to our libations, Strongest! Excellent! May we obtain a stall of kine.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Responding to our wish for cows, for steeds, and chariots, as of old, Be gracious, Greatest of the Great
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For, Hero, nowhere can I find the bounds of thy munificence. Still do thou favour us, O Bolt-armed Maghavan: with strength hast thou rewarded hymns.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: High, glorifier of his friend, he knows all generations, he whom many praise. All races of mankind with ladies lifted up invoke that Mighty Indra's aid.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Be he our Champion and Protector in great deeds, rich in all wealth, the Vrtra-slayer, Maghavan.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: In the wild raptures of the juice sing to your Hero with high laud, to him the Wise, To Indra, glorious in his name, the Mighty One, even as the hymn alloweth it.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou givest wealth to me myself, thou givest treasure, Excellent! and the strong steed, O Much-invoked, in deeds of might, yea, even now.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Him, Sovran Ruler of all precious things, who even hath power o'er this fair form of his, As now it taketh shape, and afterward,
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: We praise, so that the Mighty One may speed to you, Pourer of bounties, Traveller, prepared to go. Thou favourest the Maruts known to all, by song and sacrifice. With song and praise I sing to thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: We in the sacrifice perform their will whose voice is lifted high, The worship of those Thundering Ones who o'er the ridges of these mountains fly in troops.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indra, Mightiest, bring us that which crushes men of evil minds, Wealth suited to our needs, O Stirrer of the thought, best wealth, O thou who stirrest thought.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Winner, noble winner, strong, wondrous, most splendid, excellent, Sole Lord of victory, bring all-overpowering wealth, joy-giving, chief in deeds of might.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Now let the godless man approach who hath received reward so great As Vasa, Asvya, when this light of morning dawned, received from Prthusravas, from Kanita's son.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Steeds sixty thousand and ten thousand kine, and twenty hundred camels I obtained; Ten hundred brown in hue, and other ten red in three spots: in all, ten thousand kine.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ten browns that make my wealth increase, fleet steeds whose tails are long and fair, Turn with swift whirl my chariot wheel;
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The gifts which Prthusravas gave, Kanita's son munificent. He gave a chariot wrought of gold: the prince was passing bountiful, and won himself most lofty fame.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come thou to this great rite of ours, Vayu! to give us vigorous light. We have served thee that thou mightest give much to us, yea, mightest quickly give great wealth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Who with thrice seven times seventy horses comes to us, invested with the rays of morn, Through these our Soma-draughts and those who press, to give, drinker of pure bright Soma Juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Who hath inclined this glorious one, bounteous himself, to give me gifts. Borne on firm chariot with the prosperous Nahup, wise, to a man yet more devout.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Sole Lord in beauty meet for praise, O Vayu, dropping fatness down, Hurried along by steeds, by camels, and by hounds, spreads forth thy train: even this it is.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: So, as a prize dear to the strong, the sixty thousand have I gained, Bulls that resemble vigorous steeds.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To me come oxen like a herd, yea, unto me the oxen come.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: And in the grazing herd he made a hundred camels bleat for me, And twenty hundred mid the white.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: A hundred has the sage received, Dasa Balbutha's and Taruksa's gifts. These are thy people, Vayu, who rejoice with Indra for their guard, rejoice with Gods for guards.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: And now to Vasa Asvya here this stately woman is led forth, Adorned with ornaments of gold.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: GREAT help ye give the worshipper, Varuna, Mitra, Mighty Ones! No sorrow ever reaches him whom ye, Adityas, keep from harm. Yours are incomparable aids, and good the succour they afford.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Gods, Adityas, well ye know the way to keep all woes afar. As the birds spread their sheltering wings, spread your protection over us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As the birds spread their sheltering wings let your protection cover us. We mean all shelter and defense, ye who have all things for your own.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To whomsoever they, Most Wise, have given a home and means of life, O'er the whole riches of this man they, the Adityas, have control.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As drivers of the car avoid ill roads, let sorrows pass us by. May we be under Indra's guard, in the Adityas' favouring grace.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For verily men sink and faint through loss of wealth which ye have given. Much hath he gained from you, O Gods, whom ye, Adityas, have approached.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: On him shall no fierce anger fall, no sore distress shall visit him, To whom, Adityas, ye have lent your shelter that extendeth far.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Resting in you, O Gods, we are like men who fight in coats of mail. Ye guard us from each great offence, ye guard us from each lighter fault.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May Aditi defend us, may Aditi guard and shelter us, Mother of wealthy Mitra and of Aryaman and Varuna.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The shelter, Gods, that is secure, auspicious, free from malady, A sure protection, triply strong, even that do ye extend to us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Look down on us, Adityas, as a guide exploring from the bank. Lead us to pleasant ways as men lead horses to an easy ford.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ill be it for the demons' friend to find us or come near to us. But for the milch-cow be it well, and for the man who strives for fame.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Each evil deed made manifest, and that which is concealed, O Gods, The whole thereof remove from us to Trita Aptya far away.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Daughter of Heaven, the dream that bodes evil to us or to our kine, Remove, O Lady of the Light, to Trita Aptya far away.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Even if, O Child of Heaven, it make a garland or a chain of gold, The whole bad dream, whate'er it be, to Trita Aptya we consign.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To him whose food and work is this, who comes to take his share therein, To Trita, and to Dvita, Dawn! bear thou the evil dream away.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As we collect the utmost debt, even the eighth and sixteenth part, So unto Aptya we transfer together all the evil dream.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Now have we conquered and obtained, and from our trespasses are free. Shine thou away the evil dream, O Dawn, whereof we are afraid. Yours are incomparable aids, and good the succour they afford.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: WISELY have I enjoyed the savoury viand, religious-thoughted, best to find out treasure, The food to which all Deities and mortals, calling it meath, gather themselves together.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou shalt be Aditi as thou hast entered within, appeaser of celestial anger. Indu, enjoying Indra's friendship, bring us - as a swift steed the car - forward to riches.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: We have drunk Soma and become immortal; we have attained the light, the Gods discovered. Now what may foeman's malice do to harm us? What, O Immortal, mortal man's deception?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Absorbed into the heart, be sweet, O Indu, as a kind father to his son, O Soma, As a wise Friend to friend: do thou, wide-ruler, O Soma, lengthen out our days for living.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: These glorious drops that give me freedom have I drunk. Closely they knit my joints as straps secure a car. Let them protect my foot from slipping on the way: yea, let the drops I drink preserve me from disease.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Make me shine bright like fire produced by friction: give us a clearer sight and make us better. For in carouse I think of thee, O Soma, Shall I, as a rich man, attain to comfort?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May we enjoy with an enlivened spirit the juice thou givest, like ancestral riches. O Soma, King, prolong thou our existence as Surya makes the shining days grow longer.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: King Soma, favour us and make us prosper: we are thy devotees; of this be mindful. Spirit and power are fresh in us, O Indu give us not up unto our foeman's pleasure.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For thou hast settled in each joint, O Soma, aim of men's eyes and guardian of our bodies. When we offend against thine holy statutes, as a kind Friend, God, best of all, be gracious.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May I be with the Friend whose heart is tender, who, Lord of Bays! when quaffed will never harm me- This Soma now deposited within me. For this, I pray for longer life to Indra.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Our maladies have lost their strength and vanished: they feared, and passed away into the darkness. Soma hath risen in us, exceeding mighty, and we are come where men prolong existence. 12, Fathers, that Indu which our hearts have drunken, Immortal in himself, hath entered mortals. So let us serve this Soma with oblation, and rest securely in his grace and favour.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Associate with the Fathers thou, O Soma, hast spread thyself abroad through earth and heaven. So with oblation let us serve thee, Indu, and so let us become the lords of riches,
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Give us your blessing, O ye Gods' preservers. Never may sleep or idle talk control us. But evermore may we, as friends of Soma, speak to the synod with brave sons around us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: On all sides,. Soma, thou art our life-giver: aim of all eyes, light-finder, come within us. Indu, of one accord with thy protections both from behind and from before preserve us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: AGNI, come hither with thy fires; we choose thee as Invoking Priest. Let the extended ladle full of oil balm thee, best Priest, to sit on sacred grass.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For unto thee, O Angiras, O Son of Strength, move ladles in the sacrifice. To Agni, Child of Force, whose locks drop oil, we seek, foremost in sacrificial rites.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni, thou art Disposer, Sage, Herald, bright God! and worshipful, Best offerer, cheerful, to be praised in holy rites, pure Lord! by singers with their hymns.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Most Youthful and Eternal, bring the longing Gods to me, the guileless, for the feast. Come, Vasu, to the banquet that is well-prepared: rejoice thee, gracious, with our songs.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Famed art thou, Agni, far and wide, Preserver, righteous, and a Sage. The holy singers, O refulgent kindled God! arrangers, call on thee to come -
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Shine, Most Resplendent! blaze, send bliss unto the folk, and to thy worshipper Great art thou. So may my princes, with good fires, subduing foes, rest in the keeping of the Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Agni, as thou burnest down to earth even high-grown underwood, So, bright as Mitra is, burn him who injures us, him who plots ill against thy friend.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Give us not as a prey to mortal enemy, nor to the wicked friend of fiends. With conquering guards, auspicious, unassailable, protect us, O Most Youthful God.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Protect us, Agni, through the first, protect us through the second hymn, Protect us through three hymns, O Lord of Power and Might, through four hymns, Vasu, guard thou us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Preserve us from each fiend who brings the Gods no gift, preserve thou us in deeds of strength: For we possess in thee the nearest Friend of all, for service of the Gods and weal.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Holy Agni, give us wealth renowned with men and strengthening life. Bestow on us, O Helper, that which many crave, more glorious still by righteousness;
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Wherewith we may o'ercome our rivals in the war, o'erpowering the foe's designs. So wax thou by our food, O Excellent in strength. Quicken our thoughts that find out wealth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni is even as a bull who whets and brandishes his horns. Well-sharpened are his jaws which may not be withstood: the Child of Strength hath powerful teeth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Not to be stayed, O Bull, O Agni, are thy teeth when thou art spreading far and wide. Make our oblations duly offered up, O Priest, and give us store of precious things.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou liest in the wood: from both thy Mothers mortals kindle thee. Unweariedly thou bearest up the offerer's gifts, then shinest bright among the Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: And so the seven priests, O Agni, worship thee, Free-giver, Everlasting One. Thou cleavest through the rock with heat and fervent glow. Agni, rise up above the men.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For you let us whose grass is trimmed call Agni, Agni, restless God. Let us whose food is offered call to all the tribes Agni the Invoking Priest of men.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni, with noble psalm that tells his wish he dwells, thinking on thee who guardest him. Speedily bring us strength of many varied sorts to be most near to succour us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni, Praise-singer! Lord of men, God burner-up of Raksasas, Mighty art thou, the ever-present Household-Lord, Home-friend and Guardian from the sky.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Let no fiend come among us, O thou rich in light, no spell of those who deal in spells. To distant pastures drive faint hunger: far away, O Agni, chase the demons' friends.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: BOTH boons,-may Indra, hitherward turned, listen to this prayer of ours, And mightiest Maghavan with thought inclined to us come near to drink the Soma juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For him, strong, independent Ruler, Heaven and Earth have fashioned forth for power and might. Thou seatest thee as first among thy peers in place, for thy soul longs for Soma juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Fill thyself full, O Lord of wealth, O Indra, with the juice we shed. We know thee, Lord of Bay Steeds victor in the fight, vanquishing e'en the invincible.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Changeless in truth, O Maghavan Indra, let it be as thou in wisdom willest it. May we, O fair of check, win booty with thine aid, O Thunderer, swiftly seeking it.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra, with all thy saving helps give us assistance, Lord of power. For after thee we follow even as glorious bliss, thee, Hero, finder-out of wealth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Increaser of our steeds and multiplying kine, a golden well, O God, art thou, For no one may impair the gifts laid up in thee. Bring me whatever thing I ask.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For thou,-come to the worshipper!-wilt find great wealth to make us rich. Fill thyself full, O Maghavan, for gain of kine, full, Indra, for the gain of steeds.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou as thy gift bestowest many hundred herds, yea, many thousands dost thou give. With singers' hymns have we brought the Fort-render near, singing to Indra for his grace.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Whether the simple or the sage, Indra, have offered praise to thee, He Satakratu! by his love hath gladdened thee, ambitious! ever pressing on!
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: If he the Strong of arm, the breaker-down of forts, the great Destroyer, hear my call, We, seeking riches cry to Indra, Lord of wealth, to Satakratu with our lauds.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: We count not then as sinners, nor as niggardly or foolish men, When with the Soma juice which we have shed we make Indra, the Mighty One, our Friend.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Him have we yoked in fight, the powerful Conqueror, debt-claimer, not to be deceived. Best charioteer, the Victor marks each fault, he knows the strong to whom he will come near.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra, give us security from that whereof we are afraid. Help us, O Maghavan, let thy succour give us this: drive away foes and enemies.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For thou, O liberal Lord of bounty, strengthenest his ample home who worships thee. So Indra, Maghavan, thou Lover of the Song, we with pressed Soma call on thee,
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra is Vrtra-slayer, guard, our best defender from the foe. May he preserve our last and middlemost, and keep watch from behind us and before.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Defend us from behind, below, above, in front, on all sides, Indra, shield us well. Keep far away from us the terror sent from heaven: keep impious weapons far away.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Protect us, Indra, each to-day, each morrow, and each following day. Our singers, through all days, shalt thou, Lord of the brave, keep safely both by day and night.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: A crushing Warrior, passing rich is Maghavan, endowed with all heroic might. Thine arms, O Satakratu, are exceeding strong, arms which have grasped the thunderbolt.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: OFFER ye up as praise to him that wherein Indra takes delight. The Soma-bringers magnify Indra's great energy with hymns. Good are the gifts that Indra gives.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Sole among chiefs, companionless, impetuous, and peerless, he Hath waxen great o'er many folk, yea., over all things born, in might.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Lord of swift bounty, he will win e'en with a steed of worthless sort. This, Indra, must be told of thee who wilt perform heroic deeds.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come to us hither: let us pay devotions that enhance thy might, For which, Most Potent! thou wouldst fain bless the man here who strives for fame.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For thou, O Indra, makest yet more bold the spirit of the bold Who with strong Soma serveth thee, still ready with his reverent prayers.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Worthy of song, he looketh down as a man looketh into wells. Pleased with the Soma-bringer's skill he maketh him his mate and friend.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: In strength and wisdom all the Gods, Indra, have yielded unto thee. Be thou the Guard of all, O thou whom many praise.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Praised, Indra, is this might of thine, best for the service of the Gods, That thou with power dost slay Vrtra, O Lord of Strength.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He makes the races of mankind like synods of the Beauteous One. Indra knows this his manifest deed, and is renowned.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thy might, O Indra, at its birth, thee also, and thy mental power, In thy care, Maghavan rich in kine! they have increased exceedingly.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Vrtra-slayer, thou and I will both combine for winning spoil. Even malignity will consent, O Bolt-armed Hero, unto us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Let us extol this Indra as truthful and never as untrue. Dire is his death who pours no gifts great light hath he who offers them. Good are the gifts that Indra gives.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: WITH powers of Mighty Ones hath he, Ancient, Beloved, been equipped, Through whom the Father Manu made prayers efficacious with the Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Him, Maker of the sky, let stones wet with the Soma ne'er forsake, Nor hymns and prayer that must be said.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra who knew full well disclosed the kine to the Angirases. This his great deed must be extolled.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra, promoter of the song, the sage's Strengthener as of old, Shall come to bless and succour us at presentation of this laud.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Now after their desire's intent the pious singers with the cry Of Hail! have sung loud hymns to thee, Indra, to gain a stall of kine.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With Indra rest all deeds of might, deeds done and yet to be performed, Whom singers know devoid of guile.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When the Five Tribes with all their men to Indra have sent out their voice, And when the priest hath strewn much grass, this is the Friend's own dwelling place.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: This praise is verily thine own: thou hast performed these manly deeds, And sped the wheel upon its way.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: At the o'er flowing of this Steer, boldly he strode for life, and took Soma as cattle take their corn.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Receiving this and craving help, we, who with you are Daksa's sons, Would fain exalt the Maruts' Lord.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Yea, Hero, with the singers we sing.to the duly-coming Band. Allied with thee may we prevail.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With us are raining Rudras, clouds accordant in call to battle, at the death of Vrtra, The strong assigned to him who sings and praises. May Gods with Indra at their head protect us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: MAY our hymns give thee great delight. Display thy bounty, Thunderer. Drive off the enemies of prayer.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Crush with thy foot the niggard churls who bring no gifts. Mighty art thou There is not one to equal thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou art the Lord of Soma pressed, Soma impressed is also thine. Thou art the Sovran of the folk.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come, go thou forth, dwelling in heaven and listening to the prayers of men: Thou fillest both the heavens and earth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Even that hill with rocky heights, with hundreds, thousands, held within. Thou for thy worshippers brakest through.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: We call on thee both night and day to taste the flowing Soma juice: Do thou fulfil our heart's desire.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Where is that ever-youthful Steer, strong. necked and never yet bent down? What Brahman ministers to him?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To whose libation doth the Steer, betake him with delight therein? Who takes delight in Indra now?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Whom, Vrtra-slayer, have thy gift and hero powers accompanied? Who is thy dearest in the laud?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For thee among mankind, among the Purus is this Soma shed. Hasten thou hither: drink thereof.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: This, growing by Soma and by Saryanavan, dear to thee, In Arjikiya, cheers thee best.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Hasten thou hitherward, and drink this for munificence to-day, Delightful for thine eager draught.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: THOUGH, Indra, thou art called by men from east and west, from north and south, Come hither quickly with fleet steeds
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: If in the effluence of heaven, rich in its light, thou takest joy, Or in the sea in Soma juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With songs I call thee, Great and Wide, even as a cow to profit us, Indra, to drink the Soma-draught.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Hither, O Indra, let thy Bays bear up and, bring upon thy car Thy glory, God! and majesty.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou, Indra, wouldst be sung and praised as great, strong, lordly in thy deeds Come hither, drink our Soma juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: We who have shed the Soma and prepared the feast are calling thee. To sit on this our sacred grass.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As, Indra, thou art evermore the common Lord of all alike, As such we invocate thee now.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The men with stones have milked for thee this nectar of the Soma juice: Indra, be pleased with it, and drink.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Neglect all pious men with skill in sacred song: come hitherward, With speed, and give us high renown.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Gods, may the mighty rest unharmed, the King who gives me spotted kine, Kine decked with golden ornaments.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Beside a thousand spotted kine I have received a gift of gold, Pure, brilliant, and exceeding great.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Durgaha's grandsons, giving me a thousand kine, munificent, Have won renown among the Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: LOUD singing at the sacred rite where Soma flows we priests invoke With haste, that he may help, as the bard's Cherisher, Indra who findeth wealth for you.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Whom with fair helm, in rapture of the juice, the firm resistless slayers hinder not: Giver of glorious wealth to him who sing a his praise, honouring him who toils and pours:
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Sakra, who like a curry-comb for horses or a golden goad, Indra, the Vrtra-slayer, urges eagerly the opening of the stall of kine:
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Who for the worshipper scatters forth ample wealth, even though buried, piled in heaps: May Indra, Lord of Bay Steeds, fair-helmed Thunderer, act at his pleasure, as he lists.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Hero whom many praise, what thou hast longed for, oven of old, from men. All that we offer unto thee, O Indra, now, sacrifice, laud, effectual speech.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To Soma, Much-invoked, Bolt-armed! for thy carouse, Celestial, Soma-drinker come. Thou to the man who- prays and pours the juice hast been best giver of delightful wealth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Here, verily, yesterday we let the Thunder-wielder drink his fill. So in like manner offer him the juice today. Now range you by the Glorious One.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Even the wolf, the savage beast that rends the sheep, follows the path of his decrees. So graciously accepting, Indra, this our praise, with wondrous thought come forth to us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: What manly deed of vigour now remains that Indra hath not done? Who hath not heard his glorious title and his fame, the Vrtra-slayer from his birth?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: 'How great his power resistless! how invincible the Vrtra-slayer's matchless might! Indra excels all usurers who see the day, excels all traffickers in strength.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indra, Vrtra-slayer, we, thy very constant worshippers, Bring prayers ne'er heard before to thee, O Much-invoked, O Thunder-armed, to be thy mead.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O thou of mighty acts, the aids that are in thee call forward many an eager hope. Past the drink-offerings, Vasu, even of the good, hear my call, Strongest God, and come.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Verily, Indra, we are thine, we worshippers depend on thee. For there is none but only thou to show us race, O Maghavan, thou much invoked.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: From this our misery and famine set us free, from this dire curse deliver us. Succour us with thine help and with thy wondrous thought. Most Mighty, finder of the way.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Now let your Soma juice be poured; be not afraid, O Kali's sons. This darkening sorrow goes away; yea, of itself it vanishes.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Now pray we to these Ksatriyas, to the Adityas for their aid, These who are gracious to assist.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May Mitra bear us oer distress, and Varuna and Aryaman, Yea, the Adityas, as they know.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For wonderful and meet for praise is these Adityas' saving help To him who offers and prepares.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The mighty aid of you, the Great, Varuna, Mitra, Aryarnan, We claim to be our sure defence.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Guard us, Adityas, still alive, before the deadly weapon strike: Are ye not they who hear our call?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: What sheltering defense ye have for him who toils in pouring gifts, Graciously bless ye us therewith.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Adityas, Gods, from sorrow there is freedom; for the sinless, wealth, O ye in whom no fault is seen.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Let not this fetter bind us fast: may he release us for success; For strong is Indra and renowned.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Gods who fain would lend your aid, destroy not us as ye destroy Your enemies who go astray.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: And thee too, O Great Aditi, thee also, Goddess, I address, Thee very gracious to assist.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Save us in depth and shallow from the foe, thbu Mother of Strong Sons Let no one of our seed be harmed.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Far-spread! wide-ruling! grant that we, unharmed by envy, may expand Grant that our progeny may live.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Those who, the Princes of the folk, in native glory, ne'er deceived, Maintain their statutes, void of guilt-
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As such, from mouth of ravening wolves, O ye Adityas, rescue us, Like a bound thief, O Aditi.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Adityas, let this arrow, yea, let this malignity depart From us or e'er it strike us dead.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Fori Bountiful Adityas, we have evermore enjoyed your help, Both now and in die days of old.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To every one, O ye Most Wise, who turneth even from sin to you, Ye Gods vouchsafe that he may live.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May this new mercy profit us, which, ye Adityas, frees like one, Bound from his bonds, O Aditi.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O ye Adityas, this your might is not to be despised by us: So be ye graciously inclined.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Let not Vivasvan's weapon nor the shaft, Adityas, wrought with skill, Destroy us ere old age be nigh.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: On every side dispel all sin, Adityas, all hostility, Indigence, and combined attack.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: EVEN as a car to give us aid, we draw thee hither for our bliss, Strong in thy deeds, checking assault, Lord, Mightiest Indra, of the brave!
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Great in thy power and wisdom, Strong, with thought that comprehendeth all Thou hast filled full with majesty.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou very Mighty One, whose hands by virtue of thy greatness grasp, The golden bolt that breaks its way.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Your Lord of might that ne'er hath bent, that ruleth over all mankind, I call, that he, as he is wont, may aid the chariots and the men.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Whom, ever furthering, in frays that win the light, in both the hosts Men call to succour and to help.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra, the Strong, the measureless, worthy of praise, Most Bountiful, Sole Ruler even over wealth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Him, for his ample bounty, him, this Indra do I urge to drink, Who, as his praise was sung of old, the Dancer, is the Lord of men.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou Mighty One, whose friendship none of mortals ever hath obtained None will attain unto thy might.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Aided by thee, with thee allied, in frays for water and for sun, Bolt-armed! may we win ample spoil.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: So seek we thee with sacrifice and songs, chief Lover of the Song, As, in our battles Indra, thou to Purumayya gavest help.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Thunderer, thou whose friendship and whose onward guidance both are sweet, Thy sacrifice must be prepared.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To us, ourselves, give ample room, give for our dwelling ample room Give ample room to us to live.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: We count the banquet of the Gods a spacious pathway for the men, And for the cattle, and the car.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Six men, yea, two and two, made glad with Soma juice, come near to me With offerings pleasant to the taste.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Two brown-hued steeds, Indrota's gift, two bays from Rksa's son were mine, From Asvamedha's son two red.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: From Atithigva good car-steeds; from Arksa rein-obeying steeds, From Asvamedha beauteous ones.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary
