verses.translation: Indrota, Atithigva's son, gave me six horses matched with mares And Patakratu gave besides.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Marked above all, amid the brown, is the red mare Vrsanvati, Obedient to the rein and whip.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O bound to me by deeds of might, not even the man who loves to blame. Hath found a single fault in you.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: I SEND you forth the song of praise for Indu, hero-gladdener. With hymn and plenty he invites you to complete the sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou wishest for thy kine a bull, for those who long for his approach, For those who turn away from him, lord of thy cows whom none may kill.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The dappled kine who stream with milk prepare his draught of Soma juice: Clans in the birth-place of the Gods, in the three luminous realms of heaven.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Praise, even as he is known, with song Indra the guardian of the kine, The Son of Truth, Lord of the brave.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Hither his Bay Steeds have been sent, red Steeds are on the sacred grass,, Where we in concert sing our songs.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For Indra Thunder-armed the kine have yielded mingled milk and meath, What time he found them in the vault.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When I and Indra mount on high up to the Bright One's place and home, We, having drunk of meath, will reach his seat whose Friends are three times seven.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Sing, sing ye forth your songs of praise, ye Briyamedhas, sing your songs: Yea, let young children sing their lauds as a strong castle praise ye him.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Now loudly let the viol sound, the lute send out its voice with might, Shrill be the music of the string. To Indra is the hymn up-raised.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When hither speed the dappled cows, unflinching, easy to be milked, Seize quickly, as it bursts away, the Soma juice for Indra's drink.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra hath drunk, Agni hath drunk. all Deities have drunk their fill. Here Varuna shall have his home, to whom the floods have sung aloud as mother kine unto their calves.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou, Varuna, to whom belong Seven Rivers, art a glorious God. The waters flow into thy throat as 'twere a pipe with ample mouth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He who hath made the fleet steeds spring, well-harnessed, to the worshipper, He, the swift Guide, is that fair form that loosed the horses near at hand.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra, the very Mighty, holds his enemies in utter scorn. He, far away, and yet a child, cleft the cloud smitten by his voice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He, yet a boy exceeding small, mounted his newly-fashioned car. He for his Mother and his Sire cooked the wild mighty buffalo.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Lord of the home, fair-helmeted, ascend thy chariot wrought of gold. We will attend the Heavenly One, the thousand-footed, red of hue, matchless, who blesses where he goes.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With reverence they come hitherward to him as to. a Sovran lord, That they may bring him near for this man's good success, to prosper and bestow his gifts.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Priyamedhas have observed the offering of the men of old, Of ancient custom, while they strewed the sacred grass, and spread their sacrificial food.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: HE who, as Sovran Lord of men, moves with his chariots unrestrained, The Vrtra-slayer vanquisher, of fighting hosts, preeminent, is praised with song.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Honour that Indra, Puruhanman! for his aid, in whose sustaining hand of old, The splendid bolt of thunder was deposited, as the great Sun was set in heaven.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: No one by deed attains to him who works and strengthens evermore: No, not by sacrifice, to Indra. praised o all, resistless, daring, bold in might.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The potent Conqueror, invincible in war, him at whose birth the Mighty Ones, The Kine who spread afar, sent their loud voices out, heavens, earths seat their loud voices out,
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indra, if a hundred heavens and if a hundred earths were thine- No, not a thousand Suns could match thee at thy birth, not both the worlds, O Thunderer.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou, Hero, hast performed thy hero deeds with might, yea, all with strength, O Strongest One. Maghavan, help us to a stable full of kine, O Thunderer, with wondrous aids.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Let not a godless mortal gain this food, O thou whose life is long! But one who yokes the bright-hued steeds, the Etasas, even Indra yoker of the Bays.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Urge ye the Conqueror to give, your Indra greatly to be praised, To be invoked in shallow waters and in depths, to be invoked in deeds of might.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Vasu, O thou Hero, raise us up to ample opulence. Raise us to gain of mighty wealth, O Maghavan, O Indra, to sublime renown.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra, thou justifiest us, and tramplest down thy slanderers. Guard thyself, valiant Hero, in thy vital parts: strike down the Dasa with thy blows.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The man who brings no sacrifice, inhuman, godless, infidel, Him let his friend the mountain cast to rapid death, the mountain cast the Dasyu down.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Mightiest Indra, loving us, gather thou up, as grains of corn, Within thine hand, of these their kine, to give away, yea, gather twice as loving us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O my companions, wish for power. How may we perfect Sara's praise, The liberal princely patron, never to be harmed?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: By many a sage whose grass is trimmed thou art continually praised, That thou, O Sara, hast bestowed here one and here another calf.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The noble, Suradeva's son, hath brought a calf, led by the car to three of us. As a chief brings a goat to milk.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O AGNI, with thy mighty wealth guard us from all malignity, Yea, from all hate of mortal man.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For over thee, O Friend from birth, the wrath of man hath no control: Nay, Guardian of the earth art thou.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As such, with all the Gods, O Son of Strength, auspicious in thy flame. Give us wealth bringing all things good.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Malignities stay not from wealth the mortal man whom, Agni, thou Protectest while he offers gifts.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Sage Agni, be whom thou dost urge, in worship of the Gods, to wealth, With thine assistance winneth kine.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Riches with many heroes thou hast for the man who offers gifts: Lead thou us on to higher bliss.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Save us, O Jatavedas, nor abandon us to him who sins, Unto the evil-hearted man.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Agni, let no godless man avert thy bounty as a God: Over all treasures thou art Lord.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: So, Son of Strength, thou aidest us to what is great and excellent. Those, Vasu! Friend! who sing thy praise.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Let our songs come anear to him beauteous and bright with piercing flame Our offerings, with our homage, to the Lord of wealth, to him whom many praise, for help:
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To Agni Jatavedas, to the Son of Strength, that he may give us precious gifts, Immortal, from of old Priest among mortal men, the most delightful in the house.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni, made yours by sacrifice, Agni, while holy rites advance; Agni, the first in songs, first with the warrior steed; Agni to win the land for us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May Agni who is Lord of wealth vouchsafe us food for friendship sake. Agni we ever seek for seed and progeny, the Vasu who protects our lives.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Solicit with your chants, for help, Agni the God with piercing flame, For riches famous Agni, Purumilha and ye men! Agni to light our dwelling well.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni we laud that he may keep our foes afar, Agni to give us health and strength. Let him as Guardian be invoked in all the tribes, the lighter-up of glowing brands.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: PREPARE oblation: let him come; and let the minister serve again Who knows the ordering thereof,
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Rejoicing in his friendship, let the priest be seated over man, Beside the shoot of active power.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Him, glowing bright beyond all thought, they seek among the race of man; With him for tongue they seize the food.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He hath inflamed the twofold plain: lifegiving, he hath climbed the wood, And with his tongue hath struck the rock.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Wandering here the radiant Calf finds none to fetter him, and seeks The Mother to declare his praise.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: And now that great and mighty team, the team of horses that are his, And traces of his car, are seen.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The seven milk a single cow; the two set other five to work, On the stream's loud-resounding bank.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Entreated by Vivasvan's ten, Indra cast down the water-jar With threefold hammer from the sky.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Three times the newly-kindled flame proceeds around the sacrifice: The priests anoint it with the meath.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With reverence they drain the fount that circles with its wheel above, Exhaustless, with the mouth below.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The pressing-stones are set at work: the meath is poured into the tank, At the out-shedding of the fount.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ye cows, protect the fount: the two Mighty Ones bless the sacrifice. The handles twain are wrought of gold.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Pour on the juice the ornament which reaches both the heaven and earth Supply the liquid to the Bull.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: These know their own abiding-place: like calves beside the mother cows They meet together with their kin.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Devouring in their greedy jaws, they make sustaining food in heaven, To Indra, Agni light and prayer.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Pious One milked out rich food, sustenance dealt in portions seven, Together with the Sun's seven rays.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: I took some Soma when the Sun rose up, O Mitra, Varuna. That is the sick man's medicine.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: From where oblations must be laid, which is the Well-beloved's home, He with his tongue hath compassed heaven.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: ROUSE ye for him who keeps the Law, yoke your steeds, Asvins, to your car Let your protecting help be near.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come, Asvins, with your car more swift than is the twinkling of an eye Let your protecting help be near.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Asvins, ye overlaid with cold the fiery pit for Atri's sake: Let your protecting help be near.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Where are ye? whither are ye gone? whither, like falcons, have ye flown? Let your protecting help be near.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: If ye at any time this day are listening to this my call, Let your protecting help be near.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Asvins, fust to hear our prayer, for closest kinship I approach: Let your protecting help be near.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For Atri ye, O Asvins, made a dwelling place to shield him well, Let your protecting help be near.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ye warded off the fervent heat for Atri when he sweetly spake: Let your protecting help be near.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Erst Saptavadbri by his prayer obtained the trenchant edge of fire: Let your protecting help be near.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come hither, O ye Lords of wealth, and listen to this call of mine: Let your protecting help be near.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: What is this praise told forth of you as Elders in the ancient way? Let your protecting help be near.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: One common brotherhood is yours, Asvins your kindred is the same: Let your protecting help be near.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: This is your chariot, Asvins, which speeds through the regions, earth and heaven Let your protecting aid be near.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Approach ye hitherward to us with thousands both of steeds and kine: Let your protecting help be near.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Pass us not by, remember us with thousands both of kine aud steeds: Let your protecting help be near.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The purple-tinted Dawn hath risen, and true to Law hath made the light Let your protecting help be near.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He looked upon the Asvins, as an axe armed man upon a tree: Let your protecting help be near.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: By the black band encompassed round, break it down, bold one, like a fort. Let your protecting help be near.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: EXERTING all our strength with thoughts of power we glorify in speech Agni your dear familiar Friend, the darling Guest in every home.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Whom, served with sacrificial oil like Mitra, men presenting gifts Eulogize with their songs of praise
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Much-lauded Jatavedas, him who bears oblations up to heaven Prepared in service of the Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To noblest Agni, Friend of man, best Vrtra-slayer, are we come, Him in whose presence Rksa's son, mighty Srutarvan, waxes great;
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To deathless Jatavedas, meet for praise, adored, with sacred oil, Visible through the gloom of night
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Even Agni whom these priestly men worship with sacrificial gifts, With lifted ladles offering them.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Agni, this our newest hymn hath been addressed from us to thee, O cheerful Guest, well-born, most wise, worker of wonders, ne'er deceived.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni, may it be dear to thee, most grateful, and exceeding sweet: Grow mightier, eulogized therewith.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Splendid with splendours may it be, and in the battle with the foe Add loftier glory to thy fame.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Steed, cow, a lord of heroes, bright like Indra, who shall fill the car. Whose high renown ye celebrate, and people praise each glorious deed.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou whom Gopavana made glad with song, O Agni Angiras, Hear this my call, thou Holy One.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou whom the priestly folk implore to aid the gathering of the spoil, Such be thou in the fight with foes.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: I, called to him who reels with joy, Srutarvan, Rksa's son, shall stroke The heads of four presented steeds, like the long wool of fleecy rams.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Four coursers with a splendid car, Savistha's horses, fleet of foot, Shall bring me to the sacred feast, as flying steeds brought Tugra's son.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The very truth do I declare to thee, Parusni, mighty flood. Waters! no man is there who gives more horses than Savistha gives.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: YOKE, Agni, as a charioteer, thy steeds who best invite the Gods: As ancient Herald seat thyself.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: And, God, as skilfullest of all, call for us hitherward the Gods: Give all our wishes sure effect.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For thou, Most Youthful, Son of Strength, thou to whom sacrifice is paid, Art holy, faithful to the Law.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: This Agni, Lord of wealth and spoil hundredfold, thousand fold, is head And chief of riches and a Sage.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As craftsmen bend the felly, so bend at our general call: come nigh, Angiras, to the sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Now, O Virupa, rouse for him, Strong God who shines at early morn, Fair praise with voice that ceases not.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With missile of this Agni, his who looks afar, will we lay low The thief in combat for the kine.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Let not the Companies of Gods fail us, like Dawns that float away, Like cows who leave the niggardly.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Let not the sinful tyranny of any fiercely hating foe Smite us, as billows smite a ship.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Agni, God, the people sing reverent praise to thee for strength: With terrors trouble thou the foe.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Wilt thou not, Agni, lend us aid in winning cattle, winning wealth? Maker of room, make room for us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: In this great battle cast us not aside as one who bears a load: Snatch up the wealth and win it all.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Agni, let this plague pursue and fright another and not us: Make our impetuous strength more strong.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The reverent or unwearied man whose holy labour he accepts, Him Agni favours with success.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Abandoning the foeman's host pass hither to this company: Assist the men with whom I stand.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As we have known thy gracious help, as of a Father, long ago, So now we pray to thee for bliss.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: NOT to forsake me, I invoke this Indra girt by Maruts, Lord Of magic power who rules with might.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: This Indra with his Marut Friends clave into pieces Vrtra's bead With hundred-knotted thunderbolt.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra, with Marut Friends grown strong, hath rent asunder Vrtra, and Released the waters of the sea.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: This is that Indra who, begirt by Maruts, won the light of heaven That he might drink the Soma juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Mighty, impetuous, begirt by Maruts, him who loudly roars, Indra we invocate with songs.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra begirt by Maruts we invoke after the ancient plan, That he may drink the Soma juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O liberal Indra, Marut-girt, much-lauded Satakratu, drink The Soma at this sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To thee, O Indra, Marut-girt, these Soma juices, Thunderer! Are offered from the heart with lauds.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Drink, Indra, with thy Marut Friends, pressed Soma at the morning rites, Whetting thy thunderbolt with strength.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Arising in thy might, thy jaws thou shookest, Indra, having quaffed The Soma which the mortar pressed.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra, both worlds complained to thee when uttering thy fearful roar, What time thou smotest Dasyus dead.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: From Indra have I measured out a song eight-footed with nine parts, Delicate, faithful. to the Law.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: SCARCELY was Satakratu, born when of his Mother he inquired, Who are the mighty? Who are famed?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Then Savassi declared to him Aurnavabha, Ahisuva: Son, these be they thou must o'erthrow
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Vrtra-slayer smote them all as spokes are hammered into naves: The Dasyu-killer waxed in might.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Then Indra at a single draught drank the contents of thirty pails, Pails that were filled with Soma juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra in groundless realms of space pierced the Gandharva through, that he Might make Brahmans' strength increase.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Down from the mountains Indra shot hither his well-directed shaft: He gained the ready brew of rice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: One only is that shaft of thine, with thousand feathers, hundred barbs, Which, Indra, thou hast made thy friend.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Strong as the Gbhus at thy birth, therewith to those who praise thee, men, And women, bring thou food to eat.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: By thee these exploits were achieved, the mightiest deeds, abundantly: Firm in thy heart thou settest them.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: All these things Visnu brought, the Lord of ample stride whom thou hadst sent- A hundred buffaloes, a brew of rice and milk: and Indra, slew the ravening boar
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Most deadly is thy bow, successful, fashioned well: good is thine arrow, decked with gold. Warlike and well equipped thine arms are, which increase sweetness for him who drinks the sweet.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: BRING us a thousand, Indra, as our guerdon for the Soma juice: Hundreds of kine, O Hero, bring.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Bring cattle, bring us ornament, bring us embellishment and steeds, Give us, besides, two rings of gold.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: And, Bold One, bring in ample store rich jewels to adorn this ear, For thou, Good Lord, art far renowned.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: None other is there for the priest, Hero! but thou, to give him gifts, To win much spoil and prosper him.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra can never be brought low, Sakra can never be subdued: He heareth and beholdeth all.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He spieth out the wrath of man, he who can never be deceived: Ere blame can come he marketh it.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He hath his stomach full of might, the Vrtra-slayer, Conqueror, The Soma-drinker, ordering all.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: In thee all treasures are combined, Soma all blessed things in thee, Uninjured, easy to bestow.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To thee speeds forth my hope that craves the gift of corn, and kine and gold, Yea, craving horses, speeds to thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra, through hope in thee alone even this sickle do I grasp. Fill my hand, Maghavan, with all that it can hold of barley cut or gathered up.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: THIS here is Soma, ne'er restrained, active, all-conquering bursting forth, Rsi and Sage by sapience,
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: All that is bare he covers o'er, all that is sick he medicines; The blind man sees, the cripple walks.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou, Soma, givest wide defense against the hate of alien men, Hatreds that waste and weaken us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou by thine insight and thy skill, Impetuous One, from heaven and earth Drivest the sinner's enmity.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When to their task they come with zeal, may they obtain the Giver's grace, And satisfy his wish who thirsts.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: So may he find what erst was lost, so may be speed the pious man, And lengthen his remaining life.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Gracious, displaying tender love, unconquered, gentle in thy thoughts, Be sweet, O Soma, to our heart.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Soma, terrify us not; strike us not with alarm, O King: Wound not our heart with dazzling flame.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When in my dwelling-place I see the wicked enemies of Gods, King, chase their hatred far away, thou Bounteous One, dispel our foes.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Sarakratu! truely I have made none else my Comforter. Indra; be gracious unto us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou who hast ever aided us kindly of old to win the spoil, As such, O Indra, favour us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: What now? As prompter of the poor thou helpest him who sheds the juice. Wilt thou not, Indra, strengthen us?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indra, help our chariot on, yea, Thunderer, though it lag behind: Give this my car the foremost place.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ho there! why sittest thou at case? Make thou my chariot to be first And bring the fame of victory near.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Assist our car that seeks the prize. What can be easier for thee? So make thou us victorious.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra, be firm: a fort art thou. To thine appointed place proceeds The auspicious hymn in season due.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Let not our portion be disgrace. Broad is the course, the prize is set, The barriers are opened wide.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: This thing we wish. that thou mayst take thy fourth, thy sacrificial name. So art thou held to be our Lord.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ekadyu hath exalted you, Immortals: both Goddesses and Gods hath he delighted. Bestow upon him bounty meet for praises. May he, enriched with prayer, come soon and early.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: INDRA, God of the mighty arm, gather for us with thy right hand Manifold and nutritious spoil.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: We know thee mighty in thy deeds, of mighty bounty, mighty wealth, Mighty in measure, prompt to aid.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Hero, when thou art fain to give, neither may Gods nor mortal men Restrain thee like a fearful Bull.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come, let us glorify Indra, Lord supreme of wealth, Self-ruling King: In bounty may he harm us not.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Let prelude sound and following chant so let him hear the Saman sung, And with his bounty answer us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indra, with thy right hand bring, and with thy left remember us. Let us not lose our share of wealth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come nigh, O Bold One, boldly bring hither the riches of the churl Who giveth least of all the folk.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra, the booty which thou hast with holy singers to receive, Even that booty win with us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra, thy swiftly-coming spoil, the booty which rejoices all, Sounds quick in concert with our hopes.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: HASTE forward to us from afar, or, Vrtra-slayer, from anear, To meet the offering to the meath.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Strong are the Soma-draughts; come nigh: the juices fill thee with delight: Drink boldly even as thou art wont'.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Joy, Indra, in the strengthening food et it content thy wish and thought, And be delightful to thine heart.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come to us thou who hast no foe: we call thee down to hymns of praise, In heaven's sublimest realm of light.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: This Soma here expressed with stones and dressed with milk for thy carouse, Indra, is offered up to thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Graciously, Indra, hear my call. Come and obtain the draught, and sate Thyself with juices blent with milk.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Soma, Indra, which is shed in chalices and vats for thee, Drink thou, for thou art Lord thereof.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Soma seen within the mats, as in the flood the Moon is seen, Drink thou, for thou art Lord thereof.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: That which the Hawk brought in his claw, inviolate, through the air to thee, Drink thou, for thou art Lord thereof.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: WE choose unto ourselves that high protection of the Mighty Gods That it may help and succour us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May they be ever our allies, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman, Far-seeing Gods who prosper us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ye furtherers of holy Law, transport us safe o'er many woes, As over water-floods in ships.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Dear wealth be Aryaman to us, Varuna dear wealth meet for praise: Dear wealth we choose unto ourselves.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For Sovrans of dear wealth are ye, Adityas, not of sinner's wealth, Ye sapient Gods who slay the foe.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: We in our homes, ye Baunteous Ones, and while we journey on the road, Invoke you, Gods, to prosper us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Regard us, Indra, Visnu, here, ye Asvins and the Marut host, Us who are kith and kin to you.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ye Bounteous Ones, from time of old we here set forth our brotherhood, Our kinship in. the Mother's womb.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Then come with Indra for your chief, as early day, ye Bounteous Gods Yea, 1 address you now for this.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: AGNI, your dearest Guest, I laud, him who is loving as a friend, Who brings us riches like a car.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Whom as a far-foreseeing Sage the Gods have, from the olden time, Established among mortal men.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Do thou, Most Youthful God, protect the men who offer, hear their songs, And of thyself preserve their seed.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: What is the praise wherewith, O God, Aigiras, Agni, Son of Strength, We, after thine own wish and thought,
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May serve thee, O thou Child of Power, and with what sacrifice's plan? What prayer shall I now speak to thee?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Our God, make all of us to dwell in happy habitations, and Reward our songs with spoil and wealth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Lord of the house, what plenty fills the songs which thou inspirest now, Thou whose hymn helps to win the kine?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Him Wise and Strong they glorify, the foremost Champion in the fray, And mighty in his dwelling-place.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni, he dwells in rest and peace who smites and no one smites again: With hero sons he prospers well
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To this mine invocation, O ye Asvins, ye Nasatyas, come, To drink the savoury Soma juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: This laud of mine, ye Asvins Twain, and this mine invitation hear, To drink the savoury Soma juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Here Krsna is invoking you, O Asvins, Lords of ample wealth. To drink the savoury Soma juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: List, Heroes, to the singer's call, the call of Krsna lauding you, To drink the savoury Soma juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Chiefs, to the sage who sings your praise grant an inviolable home, To drink the savoury Soma juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come to the worshipper's abode, Asvins, who here is lauding you, To drink the savoury Soma juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Yoke to the firmly jointed car the ass which draws you, Lords of wealth. To drink the savoury Soma juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come hither, Asvins, on your car of triple form with triple seat, To drink the savoury Soma juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Asvins, O Nasatyas, now accept with favouring grace my songs, To drink the savoury Soma juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: YE Twain are wondrous strong, well-skilled in arts that heal, both bringers of delight, ye both won Daksa's praise. Visvaka calls on you as such to save his life. Break ye not off our friendship, come and set me free.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: How shall he praise you now who is distraught in mind? Ye Twain give wisdom for the gainof what is good. Visvaka calls on you as such to save his life. Break ye not off our friendship, come and set me free.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Already have ye Twain, possessors of great wealth, prospered Visnapu thus for gain of what is good. Visvaka calls on you as such to save his life. Break ye not off our friendship, come and set me free.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: And that Impetuous Hero, winner of the spoil, though he is far away, we call to succour us, Whose gracious favour, like a father's, is most sweet. Break ye not off our friendship, come and set me free.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: About the holy Law toils Savitar the God the horn of holy Law hath he spread far and wide. The holy Law hath quelled even mighty men of war. Break ye not off our ftiendship, come and act me free.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: SPLENDID, O Asvins, is your praise. Come fountain-like, to pour the stream. Of the sweet juice effused-dear is it, Chiefs, in heaven-drink like two wild bulls at a pool.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Drink the libation rich in sweets, O Asvins Twain: sit. Heroes, on the sacred grass. Do ye with joyful heart in the abode of man preserve his life by means of wealth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Priyamedhas bid you come with all the succours that are yours. Come to his house whose holy grass is trimmed, to dear sacrifice at the morning rites.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Drink ye the Soma rich in meath, ye Asvins Twain: sit gladly on the sacred grass. So, waxen mighty, to our eulogy from heaven come ye as wild-bulls to the pool.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come to us, O ye Asvins, now with steeds of many a varied hue, Ye Lords of splendour, wondrous, borne on paths of gold, drink Soma, ye who strengthen Law.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For we the priestly singers, fain to hymn your praise, invoke you for the gain of strength. So, wondrous, fair, and famed for great deeds come to us, through our hymn, Asvins, when ye hear.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As cows low to their calves in stalls, so with our songs we glorify This Indra, even your Wondrous God who checks attack, who joys in the delicious juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Celestial, bounteous Giver, girt about with might, rich, mountain-like, in precious things, Him swift we seek. for foodful booty rich in kine, brought hundredfold and thousandfold.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra, the strong and lofty hills are powerless to bar thy way. None stay that act of thine when thou wouldst fain give wealth to one like me who sings thy praise.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: A Warrior thou by strength, wisdom, and wondrous deed, in might excellest all that is. Hither may this our hymn attract thee to our help, the hymn which Gotamas have made.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For in thy might thou stretchest out beyond the boundaries of heaven. The earthly region, Indra, comprehends thee not. After thy Godhead hast thou waxed.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When, Maghavan, thou honourest the worshipper, no one is there to stay thy wealth. Most liberal Giver thou, do thou inspire our song of praise, that we may win the spoil.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To Indra sing the lofty hymn, Maruts that slays the Vrtras best. Whereby the Holy Ones created for the God the light divine that ever wakes.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra who quells the curse blew curses far away, and then in splendour came to us. Indra, refulgent with thy Marut host! the Gods strove eagerly to win thy love.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Sing to your lofty Indra, sing, Maruts, a holy hymn of praise. Let Satakratu, Vrtra-slayer, kill the foe with hundred-knotted thunderbolt.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Aim and fetch boldly forth, O thou whose heart is bold: great glory will be thine thereby. In rapid torrent let the mother waters spread. Slay Vrtra, win the light of heaven.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When thou, unequalled Maghavan, wast born to smite the Vrtras dead, Thou spreadest out the spacious earth and didst support and prop the heavens.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: There was the sacrifice produced for thee, the laud, and song of joy, Thou in thy might surpassest all, all that now is and yet shall be.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Raw kine thou filledst with ripe milk. Thou madest Surya rise to heaven., Heat him as milk is heated with pure Sama hymns, great joy to him who loves the song.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: MAY Indra, who in every fight must be invoked, be near to us. May the most mighty Vrtra-slayer, meet for praise, come to libations and to hymns.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou art the best of all in sending bounteous gifts, true art thou, lordly in thine act. We claim alliance with the very Glorious One, yea, with the Mighty Son of Strength.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Prayers unsurpassed are offered up to thee the Lover of the Song. Indra, Lord of Bay Steeds, accept these fitting hymns, hymns which we have thought out for thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For thou, O Maghavan, art truthful, ne'er subdued and bringest many a Vrtra low. As such, O Mightiest Lord, Wielder of Thunder, send wealth hither to the worshipper.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indra, thou art far-renowned, impetuous, O Lord of Strength. Alone thou slayest with the guardian of mankind resistless never-conquered foes.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As such we seek thee now, O Asura, thee most wise, craving thy bounty as our share. Thy sheltering defense is like a mighty cloak. So may thy glories reach to us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: DOWN to the stream a maiden came, and found the Soma by the way. Bearing it to her home she said, For Indra will I press thee out, for Sakra will I press thee out.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou roaming yonder, little man, beholding every house in turn, Drink thou this Soma pressed with teeth, accompanied with grain and curds, with cake of meal and song of praise.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Fain would we learn to know thee well, nor yet can we attain to thee. Still slowly and in gradual drops, O Indu, unto Indra flow.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Will he not help and work for us? Will he not make us wealthier? Shall we not, hostile to our lord, unite ourselves to Indra now?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indra, cause to sprout again three places, these which I declare,- My father's head, his cultured field, and this the part below my waist.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Make all of these grow crops of hair, you cultivated field of ours, My body, and my father's head.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Cleansing Apala, Indra! thrice, thou gavest sunlike skin to her, Drawn, Satakratu! through the hole of car, of wagon, and of yoke.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: INVITE ye Indra with a song to drink your draught of Soma juice, All-conquering Satakratu, most munificent of all who live.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Lauded by many, much-invoked, leader of song, renowned of old: His name is Indra, tell it forth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra the Dancer be to us the giver of abundant strength: May he, the mighty, bring it near.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra whose jaws are strong hath drunk of worshipping Sudaksa's draught, The Soma juice with barley mixt.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Call Indra loudly with your songs of praise to drink the Soma juice. For this is what augments his strength.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When he hath drank its gladdening drops, the God with vigour of a God Hath far surpassed all things that are.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou speedest down to succour us this ever-conquering God of yours, Him who is drawn to all our songs
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Warrior not to he restrained, the Soma-drinker ne'er o'erthrown, The Chieftain of resistless might.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indra, send us riches, thou Omniscient, worthy of our praise: Help us in the decisive fray.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Even thence, O 1ndra, come to us with food that gives a hundred powers, With food that gives a thousand powers.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: We sought the wisdom of the wise. Sakra, Kine-giver, Thunder-armed! May we with steeds o'ercome in fight.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: We make thee, Satakratu, find enjoyment in the songs we sing. Like cattle in the pasture lands.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For, Satakratu, Thunder-armed, all that we craved, as men are wont, All that we hoped, have we attained.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Those, Son of Strength, are come to thee who cherish wishes in their hearts O Indra, none excelleth thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: So, Hero, guard us with thy care, with thy most liberal providence, Speedy, and terrible to foes.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Satakratu Indra, now rejoice with that carouse of thine Which is most splendid of them all
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Even, Indra, that carouse which slays the Vrtras best, most widely famed, Best giver of thy power and might.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For that which is thy gift we know, true Soma-drinker, Thunder-armed, Mighty One, amid all the folk.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For Indra, Lover of Carouse, loud be our songs about the juice: Let poets sing the song of praise.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: We summon Indra to the draught, in whom all glories rest, in whom The seven communities rejoice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: At the Trikadrukas the Gods span sacrifice that stirs the mind: Let our songs aid and prosper it.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Let the drops pass within thee as the rivers flow into the sea: O Indra, naught excelleth thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou, wakeful Hero, by thy might hast taken food of Soma juice, Which, Indra, is within thee now.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indra, Vrtra-slayer, let Soma be ready for thy maw, The drops be ready for thy forms.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Now Srutakaksa sings his song that cattle and the steed may come, That Indra's very self may come.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Here, Indra, thou art ready by our Soma juices shed for thee, Sakra, at hand that thou mayst give.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Even from far away our songs reach thee, O Caster of the Stone: May we come very close to thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For so thou art the hero's Friend, a Hero, too, art thou, and strong: So may thine heart be won to us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: So hath the offering, wealthiest Lord, been paid by all the worshippers: So dwell thou, Indra, even with me.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Be not thou like a sloth fed priest, O Lord of spoil and wealth: rejoice In the pressed Soma blent with milk.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indra, let not ill designs surround us in the sunbeams' light: This may we gain with thee for Friend.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With thee to help us, Indra, let us answer all our enemies: For thou art ours and we are thine.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra, the poets and thy friends, faithful to thee, shall loudly sing Thy praises as they follow thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: SURYA, thou mountest up to meet the Hero famous for his wealth, Who hurls the bolt and works for man
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Him who with might of both his arms brake nine-and-ninety castles down, Slew Vrtra and smote Ahi dead.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: This Indra is our gracious Friend. He sends us in a full broad stream Riches in horses, kine, and corn.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Whatever, Vrtra-slayer! thou, Surya, hast risen upon to-day, That, Indra, all is in thy power.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When, Mighty One, Lord of the brave, thou thinkest thus, I shall not die, That thought of thine is true indeed.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou, Indra, goest unto all Soma libations shed for thee, Both far away and near at hand.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: We make this Indra very strong to strike the mighty Vrtra dead: A vigorous Hero shall he be.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra was made for giving, set, most mighty, o'er the joyous draught. Bright, meet for Soma, famed in song.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: By song as 'twere, the powerful bolt which none may parry was prepared Lofty, invincible he grew.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra, Song-lover, lauded, make even in the wilds fair ways for us, Whenever, Maghavan, thou wilt.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou whose commandment and behest of sovran sway none disregards, Neither audacious man nor God.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: And both these Goddesses, Earth, Heaven, Lord of the beauteous helm! revere Thy might which no one may resist.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou in the black cows and the red and in the cows with spotted skin This white milk hast deposited.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When in their terror all the Gods shrank from the Dragon's furious might, Fear of the monster fell on them.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Then he was my Defender, then, Invincible, whose foe is not, The Vrtra-slayer showed his might.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Him your best Vrtra-slayer, him the famous Champion of mankind I urge to great munificence,
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To come, Much-lauded! Many-named with this same thought that longs for milk, Whene'er the Soma juice is shed.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Much-honoured by libations, may the Vrtra-slayer wake for us: May Sakra listen to our prayers.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Hero, with that aid dost thou delight us, with what succour bring Riches to those who worship thee?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With whose libation joys the Strong, the Hero with his team who quells The foe, to drink the Soma juice?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Rejoicing in thy spirit bring thousand fold opulence to us: Enrich thy votary with gifts.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: These juices with their wedded wives flow to enjoyment lovingly: To waters speeds the restless one.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Presented strengthening gifts have sent Indra away at sacrifice, With might, onto the cleansing bath.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: These two who share his feast, Bay Steeds with golden manes, shall bring him to The banquet that is laid for him.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For thee, O Lord of Light, are shed these Soma-drops, and grass is strewn Bring Indra to his worshippers.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May Indra give thee skill, and lights of heaven, wealth to his votary And priests who praise him: laud ye him.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Satakratu, wondrous strength and all our lauds I bring to thee: Be gracious to thy worshippers.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Bring to us all things excellent, O Satakratu, food and strength: For, Indra, thou art kind to us. 2§ O Satakratu, bring to us all blessings, all felicity: Fbr, Indra, thou art kind to us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Bearing the Soma juice we call, best Vrtra-slayer, unto thee: For, Indra, thou art kind to us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come, Lord of rapturous, joys, to our libation with thy Bay Steeds, come To our libation with thy Steeds.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Known as best Vrtra-slayer erst, as Indra Satakratu, come With Bay Steeds to the juice we shed.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Vrtra-slayer, thou art he who drinks these drops of Soma: come With Bay Steeds to the juice we shed.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May Indra give, to aid us, wealth handy that rules the Skilful Ones: Yea, may the Strong give potent wealth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: THE Cow, the famous Mother of the wealthy Maruts, pours her milk: Both horses of the cars are yoked,-
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: She in whose bosom all the Gods, and Sun and Moon for men to see, Maintain their everlasting Laws.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: This all the pious sing to us, and sacred poets evermore: The Maruts to the Soma-draught
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Here is the Soma ready pressed of this the Maruts drink, of this Self-luminous the Asvins drink.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Of this, moreover, purified, set in three places, procreant, Drink Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: And Indra, like the Herald Priest, desirous of the milky juice, At early morn will quaff thereof.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When have the Princes gleamed and shone through waters as through troops of foes'? When hasten they whose might is pure?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: What favour do I claim this day of you great Deities, you who are Wondrously splendid in yourselves?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: 1 call, to drink the Soma, those Maruts who spread all realms of earth And luminous regions of the sky.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: You, even such, pure in your might, you, O ye Maruts, I invoke From heaven to drink this Soma juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Maruts, those who have sustained and propped the heavens and earth apart, I call to drink this Soma juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: That vigorous band of Maruts that abideth in the mountains, I Invoke to drink this Soma juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: SONG-LOVER! like a charioteer come songs to thee when Soma flows. O Indra, they have called to thee as mother-kine unto their calves.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Bright juices hitherward have sped thee, Indra, Lover of the Song. Drink, Indra, of this flowing sap: in every house 'tis set for thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Drink Soma to inspirit thee, juice, Indra, which the Falcon brought: For thou art King and Sovran Lord of all the families of men.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indra, hear Tirasci's call, the call of him who serveth thee. Satisfy him with wealth of kine and valiant offspring: Great art thou.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For he, O Indra, hath produced for thee the newest gladdening song, A hymn that springs from careful thought, ancient, and full of sacred truth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: That Indra will we laud whom songs and hymns of praise have magnified. Striving to win, we celebrate his many deeds of hero might.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come now and let us glorify pure Indra with pure Sama hymns. Let the pure milky draught delight him strengthened by pure songs of praise.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indra, come thou pure to us, with pure assistance, pure thyself. Pure, send thou riches down to us, and, meet for Soma, pure, be glad.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indra, pure, vouchsafe us wealth, and, pure, enrich the worshipper. Pure, thou dost strike the Vrtras dead, and strivest, pure, to win the spoil.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: FOR him the Mornings made their courses longer, and Nights with pleasant voices spake to Indra. For him the Floods stood still, the Seven Mothers, Streams easy for the heroes to pass over.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Darter penetrated, though in trouble, thrice-seven close-pressed ridges of the mountains. Neither might God nor mortal man accomplish what the Strong Hero wrought in full-grown vigour.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The mightiest force is Indra's bolt of iron when firmly grasped in both the arms of Indra. His head and mouth have powers that pass all others, and all his people hasten near to listen.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: 1 count thee as the Holiest of the Holy, the caster-down of what hath ne'er been shaken. I count thee as the Banner of the heroes, I count thee as the Chief of all men living.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: What time, O Indra, in thine arms thou tookest thy wildly rushing bolt to Slay the Dragon, The mountains roared, the cattle loudly bellowed, the Brahmans with their hymns drew nigh to Indra.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Let us praise him who made these worlds and creatures, all things that after him sprang into being. May we win Mitra with our songs, and Indra, and. wait upon our Lord with adoration.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Flying in terror from the snort of Vrtra, all Deities who were thy friends forsook thee. So, Indra, be thy friendship with the Maruts: in all these battles thou shalt be the victor.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thrice-sixty Maruts, waxing strong, were with thee, like piles of beaming light, worthy of worship. We come to thee: grant us a happy portion. Let us adore thy might with this oblation.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: A sharpened weapon is the host of Maruts. Who, Indra, dares withstand thy bolt of thunder? Weaponless are the Asuras, the godless: scatter them with thy wheel, Impetuous Hero.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To him the Strong and Mighty, most auspicious, send up the beauteous hymn for sake of cattle. Lay oa his body many songs for Indra invoked with song, for will not he regard. them?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To him, the Mighty, who accepts laudation, send forth thy thought as by a boat o'er rivers, Stir with thy hymn the body of the Famous and Dearest One, for will not he regard it?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Serve him with gifts of thine which Indra welcomes: praise with fair praise, invite him with thine homage. Draw near, O singer, and refrain from outcry. Make thy voice heard, for will not he regard it?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Black Drop sank in Amsumati's bosom, advancing with ten thousand round about it. Indra with might longed for it as it panted: the hero-hearted laid aside his weapons.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: 1 saw the Drop in the far distance moving, on the slope bank of Amsumati's river, Like a black cloud that sank into the water. Heroes, I send you forth. Go, fight in battle.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary
