verses.translation: And then the Drop in Amsumati's bosom, splendid with light, assumed its proper body; And Indra, with Brhaspati to aid him, conquered the godless tribes that came against him.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Then, at thy birth, thou wast the foeman, Indra, of those the seven who ne'er had met a rival. The hidden Pair, the Heaven and Earth, thou foundest, and to the mighty worlds thou gavest pleasure.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: So, Thunder-armed! thou with thy bolt of thunder didst boldly smite that power which none might equal; With weapons broughtest low the might of Susna, and, Indra, foundest by thy strength the cattle.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Then wast thou, Chieftain of all living mortals, the very mighty slayer of the Vrtras. Then didst thou set the obstructed rivers flowing, and win the floods that were enthralled by Dasas.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Most wise is he, rejoicing in libations, splendid as day, resistless in his anger. He only doth great deeds, the only Hero, sole Vrtra-slayer he, with none beside him.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra is Vrtra's slayer, man's sustainer: he must be called; with fair praise let us call him. Maghavan is our Helper, our Protector, giver of spoil and wealth to make us famous.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: This Indra, Vrtra-slayer, this Rbhuksan, even at his birth, was meet for invocation. Doer of many deeds for man's advantage, like Soma quaffed, for friends we must invoke him.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O INDRA, Lord of Light, what joys thou broughtest from the Asuras, Prosper therewith, O Maghavan, him who lauds that deed, and those whose grass is trimmed for thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The unwasting share of steeds and kine which, Indra, thou hast fast secured, Grant to the worshipper who presses Soma and gives guerdon, not unto the churl.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The riteless, godless man who sleeps, O Indra, his unbroken steep,- May he by following his own devices die. Hide from him wealth that nourishes.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Whether, O Sakra, thou be far, or, Vrtra-slayer, near at hand, Thence by heaven-reaching songs he who hath pressed the juice invites thee with thy long-maned Steeds.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Whether thou art in heaven's bright sphere, or in the basin of the sea; Whether, chief Vrtra-slayer, in some place on earth, or in the firmament, approach.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou Soma-drinker, Lord of Strength, beside our flowing Soma juice Delight us with thy bounty rich in pleasantness, O Indra, with abundant wealth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indra, turn us not away: be the companion of our feast. For thou art our protection, yea, thou art our kin: O Indra, turn us not away.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Sit down with us, O Indra, sit beside the juice to drink the meath. Show forth great favour to the Singer, Maghavan; Indra, with us, beside the juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Caster of the Stone, nor Gods nor mortals have attained to thee. Thou in thy might surpassest all that hath been made: the Gods have not attained to thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Of one accord they made and formed for kingship Indra, the Hero who in all encounters overcometh, Most eminent for power, destroyer in the conflict, fierce and exceeding strong, stalwart and full of vigour.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Bards joined in song to Indra so that he might drink the Soma juice, The Lord of Light, that he whose laws stand fast might aid with power and with the help he gives.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The holy sages form a ring, looking and singing to the Ram. Inciters, full of vigour, not to he deceived, are with the chanters, nigh to bear.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Loudly I call that Indra, Maghavan the Mighty, who evermore possesses power, ever resistless. Holy, most liberal, may he lead us on to riches, and, Thunder-armed, make all our pathways pleasant for us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou knowest well, O Sakra, thou Most Potent, with thy strength, Indra, to destroy these castles. Before thee, Thunder-armed! all beings tremble: the heavens and earth before thee shake with terror,
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May thy truth, Indra, Wondrous Hero be my guard: bear me o'er much woe, Thunderer! as over floods. When, Indra, wilt thou honour us with opulence, all-nourishing and much-to-be. desired, O King?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To Indra sing a Sama hymn, a lofty song to Lofty Sage, To him who guards the Law, inspired, and fain for praise.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou, Indra, art the Conqueror: thou gavest splendour to the Sun. Maker of all things, thou art Mighty and All-God.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Radiant with light thou wentest to the sky, the luminous realm of heaven. ne Deities, Indra strove to win thee for their Friend.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come unto us, O Indra, dear, still conquering, unconcealable, Vast as a mountain spread on all sides, Lord of Heaven.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O truthful Soma-drinker, thou art mightier than both the worlds. Thou strengthenest him who pours libation, Lord of Heaven.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For thou art he, O Indra, who stormeth all castles of the foe, Slayer of Dasyus, man's Supporter, Lord of Heaven.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Now have we, Indra, Friend of Song, sent our great wishes forth to thee, Coming like floods that follow floods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As rivers swell the ocean, so, Hero, our prayers increase thy might, Though of thyself, O Thunderer, waxing day by day.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With holy song may bind to the broad wide-yoked car the Bay Steeds of the rapid God, Bearers of Indra, yoked by word.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indra, bring great strength to us, bring valour, Satakratu, thou most active, bring A hero conquering in war.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For, gracious Satakratu, thou hast ever been a Mother and a Sire to us, So now for bliss we pray to thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To thee, Strong, Much-invoked, who showest forth thy strength, O Satakratu, do I speak: So grant thou us heroic strength.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O THUNDERER, zealous worshippers gave thee drink this time yesterday. So, Indra, listen here to those who bring the laud: come near unto our dwelling place.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Lord of Bay Steeds, fair-helmed, rejoice thee: this we crave. Here the disposers wait on thee. Thy loftiest glories claim our lauds beside the juice, O Indra, Lover of the Song.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Turning, as 'twere, to meet the Sun, enjoy from Indra all good things. When he who will be born is born with power we look to treasures as our heritage.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Praise him who sends us wealth, whose bounties injure none: good are the gifts which Indra. grants. He is not worth with one who satisfies his wish: he turns his mind to giving boons.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou in thy battles, Indra, art subduer of all hostile bands. Father art thou, all-conquering, cancelling the curse, thou victor of the vanquisher.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Earth and Heaven clung close to thy victorious might as to their calf two mother-cows. When thou attackest Vrtra all the hostile bands shrink and faint, Indra, at thy wrath.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Bring to your aid the Eternal One, who shoots and none may shoot at him, Inciter, swift, victorious, best of Charioteers. Tugrya's unvanquished Strengthener;
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Arranger of things unarranged, e'en Satakratu, source of might, Indra, the Friend of all, for succour we invoke, Guardian of treasure, sending wealth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: I MOVE before thee here present in person, and all the Deities follow behind me. When, Indra, thou securest me my portion, with me thou shalt perform heroic actions.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The food of meath in foremost place I give thee, thy Soma shall be pressed, thy share appointed. Thou on my right shalt be my friend and comrade: then shall we two smite dead full many a foeman.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Striving for strength bring forth a laud to Indra, a truthful hymn if he in truth existeth. One and another say, There is no Indra. Who hath beheld him? Whom then shall we honour?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Here am I, look upon me here, O singer. All that existeth 1 surpass in greatness. The Holy Law's commandments make me mighty. Rending with strength I rend the worlds asunder.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When the Law's lovers mounted and approached me as 1 sate lone upon the dear sky's summit. Then spake my spirit to the heart within me, My friends have cried unto me with their children.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: All these thy deeds must be declared at Soma-feasts, wrought, Indra, Bounteous Lord, for him who sheds the juice, When thou didst open wealth heaped up by many, brought from far away to Sarablia, the Rsi's kin.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Now run ye forth your several ways: he is not here who kept you back. For hath not Indra sunk his bolt deep down in Vrtra's vital part?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: On-rushing with the speed of thought within the iron fort he pressed: The Falcon went to heaven and brought the Soma to the Thunderer.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Deep in the ocean lies the bolt with waters compassed round about, And in continuous onward flow the floods their tribute bring to it.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When, uttering words which no one comprehended, Vak, Queen of Gods, the Gladdener, was seated, The heaven's four regions drew forth drink and vigour: now whither hath her noblest portion vanished?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Deities generated Vak the Goddess, and animals of every figure speak her. May she, the Gladdener, yielding food and vigour, the Milch-cow Vak, approach us meetly lauded.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Step forth with wider stride, my comrade Visnu; make room, Dyaus, for the leaping of the lightning. Let us slay Vrtra, let us free the rivers let them flow loosed at the command of Indra.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: YEA, specially that mortal man hath toiled for service of the Gods, Who quickly hath brought near Mitra and Varuna. to share his sacrificial gifts.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Supreme in sovran power, far-sighted, Chiefs and Kings, most swift to hear from far away, Both, wondrously, set them in motion as with arms, in company with Surya's beams.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The rapid messenger who runs before you, Mitra-Varuna, with iron head, swift to the draught,
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He whom no man may question, none may summon back, who stands not still for colloquy,- From hostile clash with him keep ye us safe this day: keep us in safety with your arms.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To Aryaman and Mitra sing a reverent song, O pious one, A pleasant hymn that shall protect to Varuna: sing forth a laud unto the Kings.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The true, Red Treasure they have sent, one only Son born of the Three. They, the Immortal Ones, never deceived, survey the families of mortal men.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: My songs are lifted up, and acts most splendid are to be performed. Come hither, ye Nasatyas, with accordant mind, to meet and to enjoy my gifts.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Lords of great wealth, when we invoke your bounty which no demon checks, Both of you, furthering our eastward-offered praise, come, Chiefs whom Jamadagni lauds!
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come, Vayu, drawn by fair hymns, to our sacrifice that reaches heaven. Poured on the middle of the straining cloth, and cooked, this bright drink hath been offered chalice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He comes by straightest paths, as ministering Priest, to taste the sacrificial gifts. Then, Lord of harnessed teams I drink of the twofold draught, bright Soma mingled with the milk.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Verily, Surya, thou art great; truly, Aditya, thou art great. As thou art great indeed, thy greatness is admired: yea, verily, thou, God, art great.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Yea, Surya, thou art great in fame thou evermore, O God, art great. Thou by thy greatness art the Gods' High Priest, divine, far-spread unconquerable light.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: She yonder, bending lowly down, clothed in red hues and rich in rays, Is seen, advancing as it were with various tints, amid the ten surrounding arms.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Past and gone are three mortal generations: the fourth and last into the Sun hath entered. He mid the worlds his lofty place hath taken. Into green plants is gone the Purifying.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Rudras' Mother, Daughter of the Vasus, centre of nectar, the Adityas' Sister- To folk who understand will 1 proclaim it-injure not Aditi, the Cow, the sinless.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Weak-minded men have as a cow adopted me who came hither from the Gods, a Goddess, Who, skilled in eloquence, her voice uplifteth, who standeth near at hand with all devotions.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: LORD of the house, Sage, ever young, high power of life, O Agni, God, Thou givest to thy worshipper.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: So with our song that prays and serves, attentive, Lord of spreading light, Agni, bring hitherward the Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For, Ever-Youthful One, with thee, best Furtherer, as our ally, We overcome, to win the spoil.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As Aurva Bhrgu used, as Apnavana used, I call the pure Agni who clothes him with the sea.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: 1 call the Sage who sounds like wind, the Might that like Parjanya roars, Agni who clothes him with the sea.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As Savitar's productive Power, as him who sends down bliss, I call Agni who clothes him with the sea.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Hither, for powerful kinship, I call Agni, him Who prospers you, Most frequent at our solemn rites
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: That through this famed One's power, he may stand by us even as Tvastar comes Unto the forms that must he shaped.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: This Agni is the Lord supreme above all glories mid the Gods: May he come nigh to us with strength.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Here praise ye him the most renowned of all the ministering Priests, Agni, the Chief at sacrifice;
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Piercing, with purifying flame, enkindled in our homes, most high, Swiftest to hear from far away.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Sage, laud the Mighty One who wins the spoil of victory like a steed, And, Mitra like, unites the folk.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Still turning to their aim in thee, the oblation-bearer's sister hymns Have come to thee before the wind.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The waters find their place in him, for whom the threefold sacred grass Is spread unbound, unlimited.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The station of the Bounteous God hath, through his aid which none impair, A pleasant aspect like the Sun.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Blazing with splendour, Agni, God, through pious gifts of sacred oil, Bring thou the Gods and worship them.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Gods as mothers brought thee forth, the Immortal Sage, O Angiras, The bearer of our gifts to heaven.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Wise Agni, Gods established thee, the Seer, noblest messenger, As bearer of our sacred gifts.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: No cow have I to call mine own, no axe at hand wherewith to work, Yet what is here I bring to thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Agni, whatsoever be the fuel that we lay for thee, Be pleased therewith, Most Youthful God
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: That which the white-ant cats away, that over which the emmet crawls- May all of this be oil to thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When he enkindles Agni, man should with his heart attend the song: I with the priests have kindled him.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: THAT noblest Furtherer hath appeared, to whom men bring their holy works. Our songs of praise have risen aloft to Agni who was barn to give the Arya strength.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni of Divodasa turned, as 'twere in majesty, to the Gods. Onward he sped along the mother earth, and took his station in the height of heaven.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Him before whom the people shrink when he performs his glorious deeds, Him who wins thousands at the worship of the Gods, himself, that Agni, serve with son s.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The mortal man whom thou wouldst lead to opulence, O Vasu, he who brings thee gifts. He, Agni, wins himself a hero singing lauds, yea, one who feeds a thousand men.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He with the steed wins spoil even in the fenced fort, and gains imperishable fame. In thee, O Lord of wealth, continually we lay all precious offerings to the Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To him who dealeth out all wealth, who is the cheerful Priest of men, To him, like the first vessels filled with savoury juice, to Agni go the songs of praise.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Votaries, richly-gifted, deck him with their songs, even as the steed who draws the car. On both, Strong Lord of men! on child and grandson pour the bounties which our nobles give.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Sing forth to him, the Holy, most munificent, sublime with his refulgent glow, To Agni, ye Upastutas.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Worshipped with gifts, enkindled, splendid, Maghavan shall win himself heroic fame. And will not his most newly shown benevolence come to us with abundant strength?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Priest, presser of the juice! praise now the dearest Guest of all our friends, Agni, the driver of the cars.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Who, finder-out of treasures open and concealed, bringeth them hither, Holy One; Whose waves, as in a cataract, are hard to pass, when he, through song, would win him strength.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Let not the noble Guest, Agni, be wroth with us: by many a man his praise is sung, Good Herald, skilled in sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Vasu, Agni, let not them be harmed who come in any way with lauds to thee. Even the lowly, skilled in rites, with offered gifts, seeketh thee for the envoy's task.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Friend of the Maruts, Agni, come with Rudras to the Soma-draught, To Sobhar's fair song of praise, and be thou joyful in the light. VALAKHILYA
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: TO you will I sing Indra's praise who gives good gifts as well we know; The praise of Maghavan who, rich in treasure, aids his singers with wealth thousand fold.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As with a hundred hosts, he rushes boldly on, and for the offerer slays his foes. As from a mountain flow the water-brooks, thus flow his gifts who feedeth many a one.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The drops effused, the gladdening draughts, O Indra, Lover of the Son As waters seek the lake where they are wont to rest, fill thee, for bounty, Thunderer.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The matchless draught that strengthens and gives eloquence, the sweetest of the meath drink thou, That in thy joy thou may scatter thy gifts o'er us, plenteously, even as the dust.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come quickly to our laud, urged on by Soma-pressers like a horse- Laud, Godlike Indra, which milch-kine make sweet for thee: with Kanva's sons are gifts for thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With homage have we sought thee as a Hero, strong, preeminent, with unfailing wealth. O Thunderer, as a plenteous spring pours forth its stream, so, Indra, flow our songs to thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: If now thou art at sacrifice, or if thou art upon the earth, Come thence, high-thoughted! to our sacrifice with the Swift, come, Mighty with the Mighty Ones.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The active, fleet-foot, tawny Coursers that are thine are swift to victory, like the Wind, Wherewith thou goest round to visit Manus' seed, wherewith all heaven is visible.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra, from thee so great we crave prosperity in wealth of kine, As, Maghavan, thou favouredst Medhyatithi, and, in the fight, Nipatithi.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As, Maghavan, to Kanva, Trasadasyu, and to Paktha and Dasavraja; As, Indra, to Gosarya and Rjisvan, thou vouchsafedst wealth in kine and gold.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: SAKRA I praise, to win his aid, far-famed, exceeding bountiful, Who gives, as 'twere in thousands, precious wealth to him who sheds the juice and worships him.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Arrows with hundred points, unconquerable, are this Indra's mighty arms in war. He streams on liberal worshippers like a hill with springs, when juices poured have gladdened him.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: What time the flowing Soma-drops have gladdened with their taste the Friend, Like water, gracious Lord! were my libations made, like milch-kine to the worshipper.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To him the peerless, who is calling you to give you aid, forth flow the drops of pleasant meath. The Soma-drops which call on thee, O gracious Lord, have brought thee to our hymn of praise.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He rushes hurrying like a steed to Soma that adorns our rite, Which hymns make sweet to thee, lover of pleasant food. The call to Paura thou dost love.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Praise the strong, grasping Hero, winner of the spoil, ruling supreme o'er mighty wealth. Like a full spring, O Thunderer, from thy store hast thou poured on the worshipper evermore.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Now whether thou be far away, or in the heavens, or on the earth, O Indra, mighty- thoughted, harnessing thy Bays, come Lofty with the Lofty Ones.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Bays who draw thy chariot, Steeds who injure none, surpass the wind's impetuous strength- With whom thou silencest the enemy of man, with whom thou goest round the sky.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O gracious Hero, may we learn anew to know thee as thou art: As in decisive fight thou holpest Etasa, or Vasa 'gainst Dasavraja,
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As, Maghavan, to Kanva at the sacred feast, to Dirghanitha thine home-friend, As to Gosarya thou, Stone-darter, gavest wealth, give me a gold-bright stall of kine.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As with Manu Samvarani, Indra, thou drankest Soma juice, And, Maghavan, with Nipatithi, Medbyatithi, with Pustigu and Srustigu,-
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The son of Prsadvana was Praskaniva's host, who lay decrepit and forlorn. Aided by thee the Rsi Dasyavevrka strove to obtain thousands of kine.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Call hither with thy newest song Indra who lacks not hymns of praise, Him who observes and knows, inspirer of the sage, him who seems eager to enjoy.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He unto whom they sang the seven-headed hymn, three-parted, in the loftiest place, He sent his thunder down on all these living things, and so displayed heroic might.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: We invocate that Indra who bestoweth precious things on us. Now do we know his newest favour; may we gain a stable that is full of kine.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He whom thou aidest, gracious Lord, to give again, obtains great wealth to nourish him. We with our Soma ready, Lover of the Song! call, Indra Maghavan, on thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ne'er art thou fruitless, Indra ne'er dost thou desert the worshipper But now, O Maghavan, thy bounty as a God is poured forth ever more and more.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He who hath. overtaken Krvi with his might, and silenced Susna with deathbolts, When he supported yonder heaven and spread it out, then first the son of earth was born.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Good Lord of wealth is he to whom all Aryas, Dasas here belong. Directly unto thee, the pious Rusama Paviru, is that wealth brought nigh.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: In zealous haste the singers have sung forth a song distilling oil and rich in sweets. Riches have spread among us and heroic strength, with us are flowing Soma-drops.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As, Sakra, thou with Manu called Vivasvan drankest Soma juice, As, Indra, thou didst love the hymn by Trita's side, so dost thou joy with Ayu now.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As thou with Matarisvan, Medhya, Prsadhra, hast cheered thee Indra, with pressed juice, Drunk Soma with Rjunas, Syumarasmi, by Dasonya's Dasasipra's side.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: 'Tis he who made the lauds his own and boldly drank the Soma juice, He to whom Visnu came striding his three wide steps, as Mitra's statutes ordered it.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: In whose laud thou didst joy, Indra, at the great deed, O Satakratu, Mighty One! Seeking renown we call thee as the milkers call the cow who yields abundant milk.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He is our Sire who gives to us, Great, Mighty, ruling as he wills. Unsought, may he the Strong, Rich, Lord of ample wealth, give us of horses and of kine.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He to whom thou, Good Lord, givest that he may give increases wealth that nourishes. Eager for wealth we call on Indra, Lord of wealth, on Satakratu with our lauds.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Never art thou neglectful: thou guardest both races with thy care. The call on Indra, fourth Aditya! is thine own. Amrta is stablished in the heavens.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The offerer whom thou, Indra, Lover of the Song, liberal Maghavan, favourest,- As at the call of Kanva so, O gracious Lord, hear, thou our songs and eulogy.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Sung is the song of ancient time: to Indra have ye said the prayer. They have sung many a Brhati of sacrifice, poured forth the worshipper's many thoughts.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra hath tossed together mighty stores of wealth, and both the worlds, yea, and the Sun. Pure, brightly-shining, mingled with the milk, the draughts of Soma have made Indra glad.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As highest of the Maghavans, preeminent among the Bulls, Best breaker-down of forts, kine-winner, Lord of wealth, we seek thee, Indra Maghavan.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou who subduedst Ayu, Kutsa, Atithigva, waxing daily in thy might, As such, rousing thy power, we invocate thee now, thee Satakratu, Lord of Bays.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The pressing-stones shall pour for us the essence of the meath of all, Drops that have been pressed out afar among the folk, and those that have been pressed near us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Repel all enmities and keep them far away: let all win treasure for their own. Even among Sistas are the stalks that make thee glad, where thou with Soma satest thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come, Indra, very near to us with aids of firmly-based resolve; Come, most auspicious, with thy most auspicious help, good Kinsman, with good kinsmen, come!
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Bless thou with progeny the chief of men, the lord of heroes, victor in the fray. Aid with thy powers the men who sing thee lauds and keep their spirits ever pure and bright.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May we be such in battle as are surest to obtain thy grace: With holy offerings and invocations of the Gods, we mean, that we may win the spoil.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thine, Lord of Bays, am I. Prayer longeth for the spoil. Still with thy help I seek the fight. So, at the raiders' head, I, craving steeds and kine, unite myself with thee alone.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: INDRA, the poets with their hymns extol this hero might of thine: They strengthened, loud in song, thy power that droppeth oil. With hymns the Pauras came to thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Through piety they came to Indra for his aid, they whose libations give thee joy. As thou with, Krsa and Samvarta hast rejoiced, so, Indra, be thou glad with us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agreeing in your spirit, all ye Deities, come nigh to us. Vasus and Rudras shall come near to give us aid, and Maruts listen to our call.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May Pusan, Visnu, and Sarasvati befriend, and the Seven Streams, this call of mine: May Waters, Wind, the Mountains, and the Forest-Lord, and Earth give ear unto my cry.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra, with thine own bounteous gift, most liberal of the Mighty Ones, Be our boon benefactor, Vrtra-slayer, be our feast-companion for our weal.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Leader of heroes, Lord of battle, lead thou us to combat, thou Most Sapient One. High fame is theirs who win by invocations, feasts and entertainment of the Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Our hopes rest on the Faithful One: in Indra is the people's life. O Maghavan, come nigh that thou mayst give us aid: make plenteous food stream forth for us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thee would we worship, Indra, with our songs of praise: O Satakratu, be thou ours. Pour down upon Praskanva bounty vast and firm, exuberant, that shall never fail.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: GREAT, verily, is Indra's might. I have beheld, and hither comes Thy bounty, Dasyave-vrka!
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: A hundred oxen white of hue are shining like the stars in heaven, So tall, they seem to prop the sky.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Bamboos a hundred, a hundred dogs, a hundred skins of beasts well-tanned, A hundred tufts of Balbaja, four hundred red-hued mares are mine.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Blest by the Gods, Kinvayanas! be ye who spread through life on life: Like horses have ye stridden forth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Then men extolled the team of seven not yet full-grown, its fame is great. The dark mares rushed along the paths, so that no eye could follow them.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: THY bounty, Dasyave-vrka, exhaustless hath displayed itself: Its fulness is as broad as heaven.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ten thousand Dasyave-vrka, the son of Putakrata, hath From his own wealth bestowed on me.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: A hundred asses hath he given, a hundred head of fleecy sheep, A hundred slaves, and wreaths besides.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: There also was a mare led forth, picked out for Putakrata's sake, Not of the horses of the herd.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Observant Agni hath appeared, oblation-bearer with his car. Agni with his resplendent flame hath shone on high as shines the Sun, hath shone like Surya in the heavens.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: ENDOWED, O Gods, with your primeval wisdom, come quickly with your chariot, O ye Holy. Come with your mighty powers, O ye Nasatyas; come hither, drink ye this the third libation.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The truthful Deities, the Three-and-Thirty, saw you approach before the Ever-Truthful. Accepting this our worship and libation, O Asvins bright with fire, drink ye the Soma.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Asvins, that work of yours deserves our wonder,-the Bull of heaven and earth and air's mid region; Yea, and your thousand promises in battle, -to all of these come near and drink beside us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Here is your portion laid for you, ye Holy: come to these songs of ours, O ye Nasatyas. Drink among us the Soma full of sweetness, and with your powers assist the man who worships.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: HE whom the priests in sundry ways arranging the sacrifice, of one accord, bring hither, Who was appointed as a learned Brahman, what is the sacrificer's knowledge of him?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Kindled in many a spot, still One is Agni; Silrya is One though high o'er all he shineth. Illumining this All, still One is Usas. That which is One hath into All developed.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The chariot bright and radiant, treasure-laden, three-wheeled, with easy seat, and lightly rolling, Which She of Wondrous Wealth was born to harness,-this car of yours I call. Drink what remaineth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: IN offerings poured to you, O Indra-Varuna, these shares of yours stream forth to glorify your state. Ye haste to the libations at each sacrifice when ye assist the worshipper who sheds the juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The waters and the plants, O Indra-Varuna, had efficacious vigour, and attained to might: Ye who have gone beyond the path of middle air,-no godless man is worthy to be called your foe.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: True is your Krsa's word, Indra and Varuna: The seven holy voices pour a wave of meath. For their sake, Lords of splendour! aid the pious man who, unbewildered, keeps you ever in his thoughts.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Dropping oil, sweet with Soma, pouring forth their stream, are the Seven Sisters in the seat of sacrifice. These, dropping oil, are yours, O Indra-Varuna: with these enrich with gifts and help the worshipper.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To our great happiness have we ascribed to these Two Bright Ones truthfulness, great strength, and majesty. O Lords of splendour, aid us through the Three-times-Seven, as we pour holy oil, O Indra-Varuna.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: What ye in time of old Indra and Varuna, gave Rsis revelation, thought, and power of song, And places which the wise made, weaving sacrifice,-these through my spirit's fervid glow have I beheld.,
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indra-Varuna, grant to the worshippers cheerfulness void of pride, and wealth to nourish them.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: In sweetest and most gladdening stream flow pure, O Soma, on thy way, Pressed out for Indra, for his drink.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Fiend-queller, Friend of all men, he hath with the wood attained unto His place, his iron-fashioned home.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Be thou best Vrtra-slayer, best granter of bliss, most liberal: Promote our wealthy princes' gifts.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Flow onward with thy juice unto the banquet of the Mighty Gods: Flow hither for our strength and fame.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indu, we draw nigh to thee, with this one object day by day: To thee alone our prayers are said
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: By means of this eternal fleece may Surya's Daughter purify Thy Soma that is foaming forth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ten sister maids of slender form seize him within the press and hold Him firmly on the final day.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The virgins send him forth: they blow the the skin musician-like and fuse The triple foe-repelling meath.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Inviolable milch-kine round about him blend for Indra's drink, The fresh young Soma with their milk.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: In the wild raptures of this draught, Indra slays all the Vrtras: he, The Hero, pours his wealth on us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Soma, flow on, inviting Gods, speed to the purifying cloth: Pass into Indra, as a Bull.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As mighty food speed hitherward, Indu, as a most splendid Steer: Sit in thy place as one with strength.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The well-loved meath was made to flow, the stream of the creative juice ne Sage drew waters to himself.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The mighty waters, yea, the floods accompany thee Mighty One, When thou wilt clothe thee with the milk.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The lake is brightened in the floods. Soma, our Friend, heaven's prop and stay, Falls on the purifying cloth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The tawny Bull hath bellowed, fair as mighty Mitra to behold: He shines together with the Sun.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Songs, Indu, active in their might are beautified for thee, wherewith Thou deckest thee for our delight.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To thee who givest ample room we pray, to win the joyous draught: Great are the praise due to thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indu as, Indra's Friend, on us pour with a stream of sweetness, like Parjanya sender of the rain.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Winner of kine, Indu, art thou, winner of heroes, steeds, and strength Primeval Soul of sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: HERE present this Immortal God flies, like a bird upon her wings, To settle in the vats of wood.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: This God, made ready with the hymn, runs swiftly through the winding ways, Inviolable as he flows.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: This God while flowing is adorned, like a bay steed for war, by men Devout and skilled in holy songs.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He, like a warrior going forth with heroes, as he flows along Is fain to win all precious boons.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: This God, as he is flowing on, speeds like a car and gives his gifts: He lets his voice be heard of all
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Praised by the sacred bards, this God dives into waters, and bestows Rich gifts upon the worshipper.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Away he rushes with his stream, across the regions, into heaven, And roars as he is flowing on.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: While flowing, meet for sacrifice, he hath gone up to heaven across The regions, irresistible.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: After the 'way of ancient time, this God, pressed out for Deities, Flows tawny to the straining-cloth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: This Lord of many Holy Laws, even at his birth engendering strength, Effused, flows onward in a stream.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Soma flowing on thy way, win thou and conquer high renown; And make us better than we are.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Win thou the light, win heavenly light, and, Soma, all felicities; And make us better than we are.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Win skillful strength and mental power. O Soma, drive away our foes; And make us better than we are.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ye purifiers, purify Soma for Indra, for his drink: Make thou us better than we are.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Give us our portion in the Sun through thine own mental power and aids; And make us better than we are.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Through thine own mental power and aid long may we look upon the Sun; Make thou us better than we are.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Well-weaponed Soma, pour to us a stream of riches doubly great; And make us better than we are.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As one victorious unsubdued in battle pour forth wealth to us; And make us better than we are.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: By worship, Pavamana! men have strengthened thee to prop the Law: Make thou us better than we are.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indu, bring us wealth in steeds, manifold. quickening all life; And mate us better than we are.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: ENKINDLED, Pavamana, Lord, sends forth his light on, every side In friendly show, the bellowing Bull.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He, Pavamana, Self-produced, speeds onward sharpening his horns: He glitters through the firmament.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Brilliant like wealth, adorable, with splendour Pavamana shines, Mightily with the streams of meath.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The tawny Pavamana, who strews from of old the grass with might, Is worshipped, God amid the Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The golden, the Celestial Doors are lifted with their frames on high, By Pavamana glorified.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With passion Pavamana longs for the great lofty pair, well-formed Like beauteous maidens, Night and Dawn
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Both Gods who look on men I call, Celestial Heralds: Indra's Self Is Pavamana, yea, the Bull.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: This, Pavamana's sacrifice, shall the three beauteous Goddesses, Sarasvati and Bharati and Ila, Mighty One, attend.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: 1 summon Tvastar hither, our protector, champion, earliest-born, Indu is Indra, tawny Steer; Pavamana is Prajapati.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Pavamana, with the meath in streams anoint Vanaspati, The ever-green. the golden-hued, refulgent, with a thousand boughs.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come to the consecrating rite of Pavamana, all ye Gods,- Vayu, Surya, Brhaspati, Indra, and Agni, in accord.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: SOMA, flow on with pleasant stream, a Bull devoted to the Gods, Our Friend, unto the woolen sieve.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Pour hitherward, as Indra's Self, Indu, that gladdening stream of thine, And send us coursers full of strength.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Flow to the filter hitherward, pouring that ancient gladdening juice, Streaming forth power and high renown.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Hither the sparkling drops have flowed, like waters down a steep descent They have reached Indra purified.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Whom, having passed the filter, ten dames cleanse, as 'twere a vigorous steed, While he disports him in the wood,-
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The steer-strong juice with milk pour forth, for feast and service of the Gods, To him who bears away the draught.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Effused, the God flows onward with his stream to Indra, to the God, So that his milk may strengthen him.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Soul of the sacrifice, the juice effused flows quickly on: he keeps His ancient wisdom of a Sage.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: So pouring forth, as Indra's Friend, strong drink, best Gladdener! for the feast, Thou, even in secret, storest hymns.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: FORTH on their way the glorious drops have flowed for maintenance of Law, Knowing this sacrifice's course.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Down in the mighty waters sinks the stream of meath, most excellent, Oblation best of all in worth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: About the holy place, the Steer true, guileless, noblest, hath sent forth Continuous voices in the wood.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When, clothed in manly strength, the Sage flows in celestial wisdom round, The Strong would win the light of heaven.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When purified, he sits as King above the hosts, among his folk, What time the sages bring him nigh.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Dear, golden-coloured, in the fleece he sinks and settles in the wood: The Singer shows his zeal in hymns.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He goes to Indra, Vayu, to the Asvins, as his custom is, With gladdening juice which gives them joy.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Tle streams of pleasant Soma flow to Bhaga, Mitra-Varuna,- Well-knowing through his mighty powers. Heaven and Earth, riches of meath to win us wealth: Gain for us treasures and renown.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: OBEYING Indra's dear desire these Soma juices have flowed forth, Increasing his heroic might.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Laid in the bowl, pure-flowing on to Vayu and the Asvins, may These give us great heroic strength.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Soma, as thou art purified, incite to bounty Indra's heart, To sit in place of sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The ten swift fingers deck thee forth, seven ministers impel thee on: The sages have rejoiced in thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When through the filter thou art poured, we clothe thee with a robe of milk To be a gladdening draught for Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When purified within the jars, Soma, bright red and golden-hued, Hath clothed him with a robe of milk.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Flow on to us and make us rich. Drive all our enemies away. O Indu, flow into thy Friend.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Send down the rain from heaven, a stream of opulence from earth. Give us, O Soma, victory in war.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May we obtain thee, Indra's drink, who viewest men and findest light, Gain thee, and progeny and food.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: THE Sage of Heaven whose heart is wise, when laid between both hands and pressed, Sends us delightful powers of life.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: On, onward to a glorious home; dear to the people void of guile, With excellent enjoyment, flow.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He, the bright Son, when born illumed his Parents who had sprung to life, Great Son great Strengtheners of Law.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Urged by the seven devotions he hath stirred the guileless rivers which Have magnified the Single Eye.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: These helped to might the Youthful One, high over all, invincible, Even Indu, Indra! in thy law.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The immortal Courser, good to draw, looks down upon the Seven: the fount Hath satisfied the Goddesses
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Aid us in holy rites, O Man: O Pavamana, drive away Dark shades that must be met in fight.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Make the paths ready for a hymn newer and newer evermore: Make the lights shine as erst they shone.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Give, Pavamana, high renown, give kine and steeds and hero sons: Win for us wisdom, win the light.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: LIKE cars that thunder on their way, like coursers eager for renown, Have Soma-drops flowed forth for wealth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Forth have they rushed from holding hands, like chariots that are urged to speed, Like joyful songs of singing-men.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Somas deck themselves with milk, as Kings are graced with eulogies, And, with seven priests, the sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Pressed for the gladdening draught, the drops flow forth abundantly with song, The Soma juices in a stream.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Winning Vivasvan's glory and producing Morning's light, the Suns Pass through the openings of the cloth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The singing-men of ancient time open the doors of sacred songs,- Men, for the mighty to accept.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Combined in close society sit the seven priests, the brother-hood, Filling the station of the One.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He gives us kinship with the Gods, and with the Sun unites our eye: The Sage's offspring hath appeared.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Sun with his dear eye beholds that quarter of the heavens which priests Have placed within the sacred cell.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: SING forth to Indu, O ye men, to him who is purified, Fain to pay worship to the Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Together with thy pleasant juice the Atharvans have commingled milk, Divine, devoted to the God.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Bring, by thy flowing, weal to kine, weal to the people, weal to steeds. Weal, O thou King, to growing plants
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Sing a praise-song to Soma brown of hue, of independent might. The Red, who reaches up to heaven.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Purify Soma when effused with stones which bands move rapidly, And pour the sweet milk in the meath.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With humble homage draw ye nigh; blend the libation with the curds: To Indra offer Indu up.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Soma, foe-que chief o'er men, doing the will of pour forth Prosperity upon our kine.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Heart-knower, Sovran of the heart, thou art effused, O Soma, that Indra may drink thee and rejoice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Soma Pavamana, give us riches and heroic strength,- Indu! with. Indra for ally.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To Indra have the Soma drops, exceeding rich in sweets, been poured, Shed in the seat of sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As mother kine low to their calves, to Indra have the sages called, Called him to drink the Soma juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: In the stream's wave wise Soma dwells, distilling rapture, in his seat, Resting upon a wiId-cow's hide.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Far-sighted Soma, Sage and Seer, is worshipped in the central point Of heaven, the straining-cloth of wool.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: In close embraces Indu holds Soma when poured within the jars. And on the. purifying sieve.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indu sends forth a voice on high to regions of the sea of air, Shaking the vase that drops with meath.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Tree whose praises never fail yields heavenly milk among our hymns, Urging men's generations on.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Wise One, with the Sage's stream, the Soma urged to speed, flows on To the dear places of the sky.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Pavamana, bring us wealth bright with a thousand splendours. Yea. O Indu, give us ready help.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: PASSED through, the fleece in thousand streams the Soma, purified, flows on To Indra's, Viyu's special place.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Sing forth, ye men who long for help, to Pavamana, to the Sage, Effused to entertain the Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Soma-drops with thousand powers are purified for victory,
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Yea, as thou flowest bring great store of food that we may win the spoil Indu, bring splendid manly might.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May they in flowing give us wealth in thousands, and heroic power,- These Godlike Soma-drops effused.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Like coursers by their drivers urged, they were poured forth, for victory, Swift through the woollen straining-cloth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Noisily flow the Soma-drops, like milch-kine lowing to their calves: They have run forth from both the hands.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As Gladdener whom Indra loves, O Pavamana, with a roar Drive all our enemies away.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Pavamamas, driving off the godless, looking on the light, Sit in the place of sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: REPOSING on the river's wave the Sage hath widely flowed around, Bearing the hymn which many love.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When the Five kindred Companies, active in duty, with the song Establish him, the Powerful,
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Then in his juice whose strength is great, have all the Gods rejoiced themselves, When he hath clothed him in the milk.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Freeing himself he flows away, leaving his body's severed limbs, And meets his own Companion here.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He by the daughters of the priest, like a fair youth, hath been adorned, Making the milk, as 'twere, his robe.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O'er the fine fingers, through desire of milk, in winding course he goes, And utters voice which he hath found.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The nimble fingers have approached, adorning him the Lord of Strength: They grasp the vigorous Courser's back.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Comprising all the treasures that are in the heavens and on the earth, Come, Soma, as our faithful Friend.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: THROUGH the fine fingers, with the song, this Hero comes with rapid ears, Going to Indra's special place.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: In holy thought he ponders much for the great worship of the Gods. Where the Immortals have their seat.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Like a good horse is he led out, when on the path that shines with light The mettled steeds exert their strength.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He brandishes his horns on high, and whets them Bull who leads the herd, Doing with might heroic deeds.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He moves, a vigorous Steed, adorned with beauteous rays of shining gold, Becoming Sovran of the streams.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He, over places rough to pass, bringing rich treasures closely packed. Descends into the reservoirs.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Men beautify him in the vats, him worthy to be beautified, Him who brings forth abundant food.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Him, even him, the fingers ten and the seven songs make beautiful, Well-weaponed, best of gladdeners.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary
